<?php
/**
 * AdminActivityService
 *
 * Platform-wide study session & review log telemetry for the Admin Activity page.
 * Aggregates retention accuracy, response time (ms), active learners, 90-day trend series,
 * and filterable session history.
 */
class AdminActivityService
{
    public const PER_PAGE = 15;
    public const RANGES   = [7, 30, 90];

    private const SORTS = [
        'started'  => 'rs.started_at',
        'learner'  => 'u.first_name',
        'reviewed' => 'rs.total_reviewed',
        'accuracy' => 'rs.accuracy_percentage',
        'duration' => 'duration_sec',
    ];

    public static function parseFilters(array $get): array
    {
        $str  = fn($k) => is_string($get[$k] ?? null) ? trim($get[$k]) : '';
        $date = function (string $v): string {
            $d = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $v);
            return ($d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $v) ? $v : '';
        };
        $sort  = $str('sort');
        $state = $str('state');

        return [
            'q'     => mb_substr($str('q'), 0, 100),
            'state' => in_array($state, ['completed', 'in_progress', 'high_acc', 'low_acc'], true) ? $state : '',
            'from'  => $date($str('from')),
            'to'    => $date($str('to')),
            'sort'  => isset(self::SORTS[$sort]) ? $sort : 'started',
            'dir'   => $str('dir') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
            'page'  => max(1, (int) ($get['page'] ?? 1)),
        ];
    }

    public static function buildQuery(array $f, array $override = []): string
    {
        $f = array_merge($f, $override);
        $q = array_filter([
            'q'     => $f['q'],
            'state' => $f['state'],
            'from'  => $f['from'],
            'to'    => $f['to'],
            'sort'  => $f['sort'] !== 'started' ? $f['sort'] : '',
            'dir'   => $f['dir'] !== 'desc' ? $f['dir'] : '',
            'page'  => $f['page'] > 1 ? (string) $f['page'] : '',
        ], fn($v) => $v !== '');
        return $q ? '?' . http_build_query($q) : '';
    }

    public static function getSummary(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $out = [
            'sessions30d'    => 0,
            'sessionsToday'  => 0,
            'reviews30d'     => 0,
            'retention30d'   => 0.0,
            'avgResponseSec' => 0.0,
            'activeToday'    => 0,
            'active7d'       => 0,
        ];

        $sql = "SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS sessions_30d,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= CURDATE()) AS sessions_today,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS reviews_30d,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(remembered_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) * 100, 1), 0)
               FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS retention_30d,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(response_time_ms) / 1000, 2), 0)
               FROM review_logs WHERE response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS avg_resp_sec,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM review_sessions WHERE started_at >= CURDATE()) AS active_today,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM review_sessions WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS active_7d";

        $res = mysqli_query($conn, $sql);
        if ($res) {
            if ($r = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res)) {
                $out['sessions30d']    = (int) $r['sessions_30d'];
                $out['sessionsToday']  = (int) $r['sessions_today'];
                $out['reviews30d']     = (int) $r['reviews_30d'];
                $out['retention30d']   = (float) $r['retention_30d'];
                $out['avgResponseSec'] = (float) $r['avg_resp_sec'];
                $out['activeToday']    = (int) $r['active_today'];
                $out['active7d']       = (int) $r['active_7d'];
            }
            mysqli_free_result($res);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Daily series for the Activity chart (Remembered cards, Forgot cards, Retention %).
     *
     * @param int $days One of self::RANGES (defaults to 90 for client-side slicing).
     * @return array Keys: labels, remembered, forgot, retention.
     */
    public static function getTrend(mysqli $conn, int $days = 90): array
    {
        $days = in_array($days, self::RANGES, true) ? $days : 90;
        $out  = ['labels' => [], 'remembered' => [], 'forgot' => [], 'retention' => []];

        $today = null;
        if ($res = mysqli_query($conn, 'SELECT CURDATE()')) {
            $row   = mysqli_fetch_row($res);
            $today = $row[0] ?? null;
            mysqli_free_result($res);
        }
        if (!$today) {
            return $out;
        }

        $offset = $days - 1;
        $rows = self::fetchRows(
            $conn,
            "SELECT DATE(started_at) AS d,
                    COALESCE(SUM(remembered_count), 0) AS rem,
                    COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(total_reviewed - remembered_count, 0)), 0) AS fgt,
                    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(remembered_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) * 100, 1), 0) AS ret
               FROM review_sessions
              WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ? DAY
              GROUP BY d",
            'i',
            [$offset]
        );

        $byDay = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $byDay[$r['d']] = [
                'rem' => (int) $r['rem'],
                'fgt' => (int) $r['fgt'],
                'ret' => (float) $r['ret'],
            ];
        }

        $end = new DateTimeImmutable($today);
        for ($i = $offset; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $key = $end->modify("-$i days")->format('Y-m-d');
            $out['labels'][]     = $key;
            $out['remembered'][] = $byDay[$key]['rem'] ?? 0;
            $out['forgot'][]     = $byDay[$key]['fgt'] ?? 0;
            $out['retention'][]  = $byDay[$key]['ret'] ?? 0;
        }

        return $out;
    }

    public static function getList(mysqli $conn, array $f, bool $exportAll = false): array
    {
        $empty = [
            'available' => false, 'rows' => [], 'total' => 0,
            'page' => 1, 'pages' => 1, 'first' => 0, 'last' => 0,
        ];

        $where  = ['u.deleted_at IS NULL'];
        $types  = '';
        $params = [];

        if ($f['q'] !== '') {
            $like    = '%' . addcslashes($f['q'], '%_\\') . '%';
            $where[] = "(u.first_name LIKE ? OR u.last_name LIKE ? OR u.email LIKE ? OR CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) LIKE ?)";
            $types  .= 'ssss';
            array_push($params, $like, $like, $like, $like);
        }

        if ($f['state'] === 'completed') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL';
        } elseif ($f['state'] === 'in_progress') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NULL';
        } elseif ($f['state'] === 'high_acc') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND rs.accuracy_percentage >= 85';
        } elseif ($f['state'] === 'low_acc') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND rs.total_reviewed > 0 AND rs.accuracy_percentage < 60';
        }

        if ($f['from'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'rs.started_at >= ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = $f['from'] . ' 00:00:00';
        }
        if ($f['to'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'rs.started_at < ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = (new DateTimeImmutable($f['to']))->modify('+1 day')->format('Y-m-d') . ' 00:00:00';
        }

        $whereSql = implode(' AND ', $where);

        $c = self::fetchRows(
            $conn,
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM review_sessions rs JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id WHERE $whereSql",
            $types,
            $params
        );
        if (!$c) {
            return $empty;
        }

        $total  = (int) $c[0]['n'];
        $pages  = max(1, (int) ceil($total / self::PER_PAGE));
        $page   = min($f['page'], $pages);
        $offset = ($page - 1) * self::PER_PAGE;

        $col      = self::SORTS[$f['sort']] ?? 'rs.started_at';
        $dir      = $f['dir'] === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
        $limitSql = $exportAll ? '' : 'LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';

        $sql = "SELECT rs.id, rs.user_id, rs.started_at, rs.ended_at, rs.total_reviewed,
                       rs.remembered_count, rs.accuracy_percentage,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, COALESCE(rs.ended_at, NOW())) AS duration_sec,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, NOW()) AS age_seconds,
                       u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email
                  FROM review_sessions rs
                  JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id
                 WHERE $whereSql
                 ORDER BY $col $dir, rs.id DESC
                 $limitSql";

        $qTypes  = $exportAll ? $types : $types . 'ii';
        $qParams = $exportAll ? $params : array_merge($params, [self::PER_PAGE, $offset]);
        $rows    = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql, $qTypes, $qParams);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $name      = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
            $completed = $r['ended_at'] !== null;
            $durSec    = max(0, (int) $r['duration_sec']);
            $durLabel  = $durSec < 60 ? $durSec . 's' : floor($durSec / 60) . 'm ' . ($durSec % 60) . 's';

            $out[] = [
                'id'         => (int) $r['id'],
                'userId'     => (int) $r['user_id'],
                'name'       => $name !== '' ? $name : (string) $r['email'],
                'email'      => (string) $r['email'],
                'started'    => date('M j, Y g:i A', strtotime($r['started_at'])),
                'startedIso' => (string) $r['started_at'],
                'age'        => AdminOverviewService::timeAgo(max(0, (int) $r['age_seconds'])),
                'completed'  => $completed,
                'reviewed'   => (int) $r['total_reviewed'],
                'remembered' => (int) $r['remembered_count'],
                'forgot'     => max(0, (int) $r['total_reviewed'] - (int) $r['remembered_count']),
                'accuracy'   => (float) $r['accuracy_percentage'],
                'duration'   => $completed ? $durLabel : 'In progress',
            ];
        }

        return [
            'available' => true,
            'rows'      => $out,
            'total'     => $total,
            'page'      => $page,
            'pages'     => $pages,
            'first'     => $total ? $offset + 1 : 0,
            'last'      => $offset + count($out),
        ];
    }

    private static function fetchRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types = '', array $params = []): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return $rows;
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $res = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($res && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res))) {
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $rows;
    }
}

<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config/db.php';

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST'
    || empty($_SESSION['demo_pending_user_id'])
    || empty($_SESSION['demo_approval_token'])
    || empty($_POST['approval_token'])
    || !hash_equals($_SESSION['demo_approval_token'], $_POST['approval_token'])) {
    http_response_code(403);
    exit('Invalid or expired confirmation request.');
}

$user_id = (int) $_SESSION['demo_pending_user_id'];
$status = 'approved';
$sql = "UPDATE users SET account_status = ? WHERE id = ? AND account_status = 'pending'";
$stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'si', $status, $user_id);
$ok = mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);

mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
mysqli_close($conn);
unset($_SESSION['demo_pending_user_id'], $_SESSION['demo_approval_token']);

if (!$ok) {
    http_response_code(500);
    exit('Unable to confirm the account right now.');
}

header('Location: login.php?registered=approved#login');
exit;
?>

<?php
session_start();
require_once '../config/db.php';

if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    
    $email = trim($_POST['login-email'] ?? '');
    $password = $_POST['login-password'] ?? '';

    if (empty($email) || empty($password)) {
        header("Location: login.php?error=empty_fields");
        exit;
    }

    $sql  = "SELECT id, first_name, last_name, password_hash, account_status, role FROM users WHERE email = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL";
    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
    
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "s", $email);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $user_id, $first_name, $last_name, $hashed_password, $account_status, $role);
    
    if (mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt)) {
        if (password_verify($password, $hashed_password)) {
            if ($account_status !== 'approved') {
                mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
                mysqli_close($conn);
                // Rejected accounts get their own message; everything else is still pending.
                $reason = ($account_status === 'rejected') ? 'account_rejected' : 'pending_approval';
                header("Location: login.php?error=" . $reason . "#login");
                exit;
            }

            // Prevent Session Fixation
            session_regenerate_id(true);
            
            $_SESSION['user_id']    = $user_id;
            $_SESSION['first_name'] = $first_name;
            $_SESSION['last_name']  = $last_name;
            $_SESSION['logged_in']  = true;

            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
            mysqli_close($conn);

            // Admins go to the admin area; everyone else to the student app.
            // (The admin guard re-verifies the role in the database on every request.)
            header("Location: " . ($role === 'admin' ? "../admin/views/index.php" : "../app/views/index.php"));
            exit;
        }
    }

    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    mysqli_close($conn);
    
    // Invalid credentials back-route
    header("Location: login.php?error=invalid_credentials");
    exit;
}

    <script>
        // Form View Toggling
        function toggleView(view) {
            document.getElementById('login-view').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('signup-view').classList.remove('active');
            
            document.querySelectorAll('.input-error').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('input-error'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.error-text, .check-error-text').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            
            if(view === 'signup') {
                document.getElementById('signup-view').classList.add('active');
                document.getElementById('header-desc').innerText = 'Start learning smarter.';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('login-view').classList.add('active');
                document.getElementById('header-desc').innerText = 'Welcome back to your rhythm.';
            }
        }
        
        if (window.location.hash === '#signup') {
            toggleView('signup');
        } else if (window.location.hash === '#login') {
            toggleView('login');
        }

        const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

        function showError(inputId, errorId, show = true) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const errorMsg = document.getElementById(errorId);
            if (show) {
                if(input) input.classList.add('input-error');
                if(errorMsg) errorMsg.classList.add('active');
            } else {
                if(input) input.classList.remove('input-error');
                if(errorMsg) errorMsg.classList.remove('active');
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('form-login').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            let isValid = true;
            const email = document.getElementById('login-email').value.trim();
            const password = document.getElementById('login-password').value;

            showError('login-email', 'err-login-email', false);
            showError('login-password', 'err-login-password', false);

            if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
                showError('login-email', 'err-login-email');
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (password === '') {
                showError('login-password', 'err-login-password');
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (!isValid) e.preventDefault();
        });

        document.getElementById('form-signup').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            let isValid = true;
            
            const fname = document.getElementById('first-name').value.trim();
            const lname = document.getElementById('last-name').value.trim();
            const email = document.getElementById('signup-email').value.trim();
            const pass = document.getElementById('signup-password').value;
            const confirmPass = document.getElementById('confirm-password').value;
            const terms = document.getElementById('terms').checked;

            ['first-name', 'last-name', 'signup-email', 'signup-password', 'confirm-password'].forEach(id => {
                showError(id, 'err-' + id, false);
            });
            document.getElementById('err-terms').classList.remove('active');

            if (fname === '') { showError('first-name', 'err-first-name'); isValid = false; }
            if (lname === '') { showError('last-name', 'err-last-name'); isValid = false; }
            if (!emailRegex.test(email)) { showError('signup-email', 'err-signup-email'); isValid = false; }
            if (pass.length < 8) { showError('signup-password', 'err-signup-password'); isValid = false; }
            if (pass !== confirmPass || confirmPass === '') { 
                showError('confirm-password', 'err-confirm-password'); 
                isValid = false; 
            }
            if (!terms) { 
                document.getElementById('err-terms').classList.add('active'); 
                isValid = false; 
            }

            if (!isValid) e.preventDefault();
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('input', function() {
                this.classList.remove('input-error');
                const err = document.getElementById('err-' + this.id);
                if (err) err.classList.remove('active');
                
                if (this.id === 'terms') {
                    document.getElementById('err-terms').classList.remove('active');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>

FILE: authentication\logout.php

<?php
// 1. Initialize access to the active session data layer
session_start();

// 2. Unset all internal session state context arrays 
$_SESSION = array();

// 3. Destroy the session cookie on the user client web browser if present
if (ini_get("session.use_cookies")) {
    $params = session_get_cookie_params();
    setcookie(
        session_name(), 
        '', 
        time() - 42000,
        $params["path"], 
        $params["domain"],
        $params["secure"], 
        $params["httponly"]
    );
}

// 4. Wipe session storage data on the server completely
session_destroy();

// 5. Redirect cleanly back to the authentication portal login form view
header("Location: login.php");
exit;
?>

<?php
require_once '../config/db.php';

if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    if (!isset($_POST['terms'])) {
        die("You must agree to the Terms & Conditions.");
    }

    $first_name       = trim($_POST['first-name'] ?? '');
    $last_name        = trim($_POST['last-name'] ?? '');
    $email            = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
    $password         = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
    $confirm_password = $_POST['confirm-password'] ?? '';

    if (empty($first_name) || empty($last_name) || empty($email) || empty($password) || empty($confirm_password)) {
        die("All required fields must be filled out.");
    }

    if (strlen($password) < 8) {
        die("Password must be at least 8 characters long.");
    }

    if (!hash_equals($password, $confirm_password)) {
        die("The passwords do not match. Please go back and try again.");
    }

    if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
        die("Error: Invalid email format.");
    }

    $domain = substr(strrchr($email, "@"), 1);
    if (!checkdnsrr($domain, "MX")) {
        die("Error: The email domain does not exist or cannot receive mail.");
    }

    $check_sql  = "SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?";
    $check_stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $check_sql);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($check_stmt, "s", $email);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($check_stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_store_result($check_stmt);

    if (mysqli_stmt_num_rows($check_stmt) > 0) {
        die("Error: This email is already registered.");
    }
    mysqli_stmt_close($check_stmt);

    $hashed_password = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT);
    $initial_status  = 'pending';

    $insert_sql  = "INSERT INTO users (first_name, last_name, email, password_hash, account_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
    $insert_stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $insert_sql);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($insert_stmt, "sssss", $first_name, $last_name, $email, $hashed_password, $initial_status);

    if (mysqli_stmt_execute($insert_stmt)) {
        $new_user_id = mysqli_insert_id($conn);
        mysqli_stmt_close($insert_stmt);

        // Initialize default SRS user_settings row
        $settings_stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "INSERT IGNORE INTO user_settings (user_id) VALUES (?)");
        if ($settings_stmt) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($settings_stmt, "i", $new_user_id);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($settings_stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_close($settings_stmt);
        }

        mysqli_close($conn);

        session_start();
        $_SESSION['demo_pending_user_id'] = $new_user_id;
        $_SESSION['demo_approval_token']  = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        header("Location: registration-pending.php");
        exit;
    } else {
        die("System error occurred during registration.");
    }
}
?>

const authShell = document.querySelector("#auth-shell");
const signupForm = document.querySelector("#signup-form");
const loginForm = document.querySelector("#login-form");
const forgotPasswordLink = document.querySelector("#forgot-password-link");

function setAuthMode(mode) {
    const isLogin = mode === "login";
    authShell.classList.toggle("is-login", isLogin);
    authShell.classList.toggle("is-signup", !isLogin);
    document.querySelector(".login-view").setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(!isLogin));
    document.querySelector(".signup-view").setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(isLogin));
    document.querySelector(".story-copy-login").setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(!isLogin));
    document.querySelector(".story-copy-signup").setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(isLogin));
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", isLogin ? "#login" : "#signup");
}

document.querySelectorAll(".switch-to-login").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => setAuthMode("login")));
document.querySelectorAll(".switch-to-signup").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => setAuthMode("signup")));
forgotPasswordLink.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    window.alert("Forgot password is still in development.");
});

function setAuthModeFromHash() {
    setAuthMode(window.location.hash === "#signup" ? "signup" : "login");
}

window.addEventListener("hashchange", setAuthModeFromHash);
setAuthModeFromHash();

// Show/hide password controls (registration and login).
document.querySelectorAll("[data-toggle-password]").forEach((toggle) => {
    toggle.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const ids = toggle.dataset.togglePassword.split(",");
        ids.forEach((id) => {
            const field = document.getElementById(id.trim());
            if (field) field.type = toggle.checked ? "text" : "password";
        });
    });
});

// Client-side password confirmation. The PHP handler repeats this validation.
const registerPassword = document.getElementById("register-password");
const confirmPassword = document.getElementById("confirm-password");
const signupMessage = document.getElementById("signup-message");

if (signupForm && registerPassword && confirmPassword) {
    const validatePasswordMatch = () => {
        if (confirmPassword.value && registerPassword.value !== confirmPassword.value) {
            confirmPassword.setCustomValidity("Passwords do not match.");
            if (signupMessage) signupMessage.textContent = "Passwords do not match.";
        } else {
            confirmPassword.setCustomValidity("");
            if (signupMessage) signupMessage.textContent = "";
        }
    };
    registerPassword.addEventListener("input", validatePasswordMatch);
    confirmPassword.addEventListener("input", validatePasswordMatch);
    signupForm.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
        validatePasswordMatch();
        if (!signupForm.checkValidity()) {
            event.preventDefault();
            signupForm.reportValidity();
        }
    });
}

// Keep server-provided login errors visible when the login view is active.
if (window.location.search.includes("error=") && window.location.hash === "#login") {
    setAuthMode("login");
}


// Show/hide passwords on registration and login.
document.addEventListener("change", function (event) {
    const toggle = event.target.closest("[data-toggle-password]");
    if (!toggle) return;

    const show = toggle.checked;
    const ids = toggle.dataset.togglePassword.split(",");

    ids.forEach(function (id) {
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById(id.trim());

        if (passwordInput) {
            passwordInput.type = show ? "text" : "password";
        }
    });
});

FILE: config\active-user.php
================================================================================
<?php
/**
 * Re-checks the signed-in student against the database on every request, so an admin
 * rejecting or deleting an account takes effect immediately (not at the next login).
 *
 * Call it right after session_start() and config/db.php:
 *   require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/active-user.php';
 *   mempulseEnforceActiveUser($conn);          // pages
 *   mempulseEnforceActiveUser($conn, true);    // JSON endpoints (answers 401 instead of redirecting)
 *
 * Logged-out visitors are left to each page's own guard. If the lookup itself fails
 * (database hiccup) the request is allowed through rather than signing everyone out.
 */
function mempulseEnforceActiveUser(mysqli $conn, bool $json = false): void
{
    if (empty($_SESSION['logged_in']) || empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
        return;
    }

    $userId  = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
    $status  = null;
    $checked = false;

    if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, 'SELECT account_status FROM users WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL')) {
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $userId);
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $checked = true;
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $status);
            mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    }

    if (!$checked || $status === 'approved') {
        return;
    }

    // Account was rejected, is pending again, or was deleted: end the session.
    $_SESSION = [];
    if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
        $p = session_get_cookie_params();
        setcookie(session_name(), '', time() - 42000, $p['path'], $p['domain'], $p['secure'], $p['httponly']);
    }
    session_destroy();

    if ($json) {
        http_response_code(401);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Your session is no longer valid.']);
        exit;
    }

    $error = ($status === 'rejected') ? '?error=account_rejected#login' : '';
    header('Location: /mempulse/authentication/login.php' . $error);
    exit;
}

        <section class="faq-section" id="faq">
          <div class="faq-inner">
            <h2>Questions, answered</h2>
            <details>
              <summary>Can I use MemPulse for free?</summary>
              <p>Yes. The Free plan includes deck and flashcard creation, spaced repetition, daily review sessions, and basic progress tracking. You do not need a paid plan to build a study routine.</p>
            </details>
            <details>
              <summary>What is the difference between Plus and Pro?</summary>
              <p>Plus adds deeper insights and study planning for busy semesters. Pro is built for exam season and heavy course loads: it adds PDF capture, higher-limit AI card tools, exam-date adaptive scheduling, sharing, and full backups. Everything in Plus is included in Pro.</p>
            </details>
            <details>
              <summary>How much do I save with annual billing?</summary>
              <p>Plus is ₱79 per month or ₱599 for a year (about ₱50 per month, around 37% less than twelve monthly payments). Pro is ₱149 per month or ₱1,149 for a year (about ₱96 per month, around 36% less).</p>
            </details>
            <details>
              <summary>Are all paid features available today?</summary>
              <p>No. This page is a pricing concept. Features marked as planned need to be developed and tested before they are advertised as available in a live paid plan.</p>
            </details>
            <details>
              <summary>Can I pay on this page now?</summary>
              <p>Not yet. The paid-plan buttons demonstrate the selection flow only. A payment provider, secure server-side payment verification, and subscription management must be connected before checkout can go live.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

        const toast = document.getElementById('plan-toast');
        let cycle = 'annual';
        let selected = null;
        let toastTimer;

        function showToast(message) {
          toast.textContent = message;
          toast.classList.add('show');
          window.clearTimeout(toastTimer);
          toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 4500);
        }

        function setCta(button, on) {
          button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
          button.textContent = '';
          if (on) {
            const icon = document.createElement('span');
            icon.className = 'material-symbols-outlined';
            icon.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            icon.textContent = 'check';
            button.append(icon, ' Selected');
          } else {
            button.textContent = button.dataset.label;
          }
        }

        function render() {
          cycleButtons.forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.cycle === cycle)));
          cards.forEach((card) => {
            const id = card.dataset.plan;
            const d = PLANS[id][cycle];
            const on = selected === id;
            card.querySelector('[data-price]').textContent = d.price;
            card.querySelector('[data-period]').textContent = d.period;
            card.querySelector('[data-note]').textContent = d.note;
            const savings = card.querySelector('[data-savings]');
            savings.textContent = d.savings || '\u00a0';
            savings.classList.toggle('is-off', !d.savings);
            card.classList.toggle('is-selected', on);
            setCta(card.querySelector('[data-select]'), on);
          });
          grid.classList.toggle('has-selection', Boolean(selected));
          document.body.classList.toggle('has-selection', Boolean(selected));
          bar.classList.toggle('show', Boolean(selected));
          if (selected) {
            const d = PLANS[selected][cycle];
            barPlan.textContent = `MemPulse ${PLANS[selected].name} · ${cycle === 'annual' ? 'Annual' : 'Monthly'}`;
            barPrice.textContent = '';
            const strong = document.createElement('strong');
            strong.textContent = d.price;
            barPrice.append(strong, ` ${d.period} · ${d.note.split(' · ')[1] || d.note}`);
          }
        }

        cycleButtons.forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => { cycle = b.dataset.cycle; render(); }));
        cards.forEach((card) => card.querySelector('[data-select]').addEventListener('click', () => {
          selected = selected === card.dataset.plan ? null : card.dataset.plan;
          render();
        }));
        document.getElementById('selection-clear').addEventListener('click', () => { selected = null; render(); });
        document.getElementById('selection-continue').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const d = PLANS[selected][cycle];
          showToast(`MemPulse ${PLANS[selected].name} (${d.price} ${d.period}) selected. Checkout is not connected in this preview yet.`);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('.features-toggle').forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const card = btn.closest('.plan-card');
          const open = card.classList.toggle('is-expanded');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
          btn.textContent = open ? 'Show fewer features' : 'Show all features';
        }));
        render();

        // "On this page" scroll-spy
        const tocLinks = [...document.querySelectorAll('.toc a')];
        const sections = tocLinks.map((a) => document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'))).filter(Boolean);
        const setActive = (id) => tocLinks.forEach((a) => {
          if (a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id) a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
          else a.removeAttribute('aria-current');
        });
        if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && sections.length) {
          const inBand = new Map();
          const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((e) => inBand.set(e.target.id, e.isIntersecting));
            const first = sections.find((s) => inBand.get(s.id));
            if (first) setActive(first.id);
          }, { rootMargin: '-20% 0px -60% 0px' });
          sections.forEach((s) => io.observe(s));
          window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.innerHeight + window.scrollY >= document.documentElement.scrollHeight - 2) setActive(sections[sections.length - 1].id);
          }, { passive: true });
        }
      })();
    </script>

</body>

</html>

        <article class="science-page">
            <header class="article-header">
                <div class="article-meta">
                    <span>Learning guide</span><span class="meta-separator">/</span><span>6 min read</span>
                </div>
                <p class="article-kicker">The science of studying</p>
                <h1 class="article-title">The Science of Better Learning</h1>
                <p class="article-deck">How active recall and spaced repetition can help you practice remembering, make reviews more intentional, and build a consistent study routine.</p>
                <a class="toc-jump" href="#on-this-page">Jump to a section <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
            </header>

            <hr class="article-rule">

            <nav class="toc" id="on-this-page" aria-label="On this page">
                <h2>On this page</h2>
                <ol>
                    <li><a href="#introduction">Why study methods matter</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#active-recall">Active recall: practice remembering</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#spaced-repetition">Spaced repetition: review over time</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#forgetting-curve">The forgetting curve</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#combine-techniques">Why combine both techniques?</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#mempulse-workflow">Putting it into practice with MemPulse</a></li>
                </ol>
            </nav>

            <section class="article-section" id="introduction">
                <h2>Why study methods matter</h2>
                <p>When you have several subjects to prepare for, it can be tempting to reread notes for hours or leave most of the work until the night before an exam. These habits can make material feel familiar, but familiarity does not always mean you can recall or explain it when you need to.</p>
                <p>A more deliberate approach is to practice retrieving what you have learned and return to it across multiple study sessions. Two techniques that support this approach are <strong>active recall</strong> and <strong>spaced repetition</strong>.</p>
                <p>Active recall is about how you practice remembering. Spaced repetition is about when you practice again. Used together, they give your study sessions a clear structure.</p>
            </section>

            <section class="article-section" id="active-recall">
                <h2>1. Active recall: practice remembering</h2>
                <p>Active recall means trying to retrieve information from memory before checking the answer. Rather than looking at a definition and immediately rereading it, you ask yourself a question and make a genuine attempt to answer it first.</p>
                <h3>How to use active recall</h3>
                <ol class="article-steps">
                    <li><strong>Start with a prompt.</strong> Choose a question, concept, definition, or problem you want to learn.</li>
                    <li><strong>Try to answer from memory.</strong> Look away from your notes and give yourself time to think.</li>
                    <li><strong>Check your answer.</strong> Reveal the answer or consult your source and compare it with what you recalled.</li>
                    <li><strong>Notice the gaps.</strong> Identify missing details or misunderstandings that need another review.</li>
                </ol>
                <p>The goal is not to get every answer right on the first attempt. The goal is to find out what you can retrieve independently and where you still need practice.</p>
                <div class="article-callout"><strong>Example:</strong> Instead of rereading a biology definition, turn it into a question. Try to explain the concept in your own words before checking the textbook or flashcard answer.</div>
                <p>Flashcards are one practical way to use active recall. The question or prompt appears on the front; the answer stays hidden until you have tried to remember it.</p>
            </section>

            <section class="article-section" id="spaced-repetition">
                <h2>2. Spaced repetition: review over time</h2>
                <p>Spaced repetition means spreading review sessions over time instead of trying to learn everything in one sitting. You return to information at intervals, and the timing can be adjusted according to how well you remember it.</p>
                <h3>How it works</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li><strong>Learn:</strong> Study a concept and try to recall it.</li>
                    <li><strong>Review:</strong> Return to the concept after some time has passed.</li>
                    <li><strong>Extend the interval:</strong> If you remember the answer, schedule the next review farther into the future.</li>
                    <li><strong>Review sooner:</strong> If you forget the answer, bring it back earlier for more practice.</li>
                </ul>
                <p>Spaced repetition helps structure your study time. Instead of giving every card the same attention every day, you can focus on material that is due for review.</p>
                <p>There is no single interval pattern that is perfect for every learner or every subject. The useful principle is to return to material repeatedly over time and adjust your practice based on your performance.</p>
            </section>

            <section class="article-section" id="forgetting-curve">
                <h2>3. The forgetting curve: why review matters</h2>
                <p>The forgetting curve describes the general observation that newly learned information can become harder to recall as time passes, particularly when it is not revisited. How quickly this happens varies with the person, the material, prior knowledge, and the conditions in which learning took place.</p>
                <p>This is one reason a topic can seem easy immediately after studying but become difficult to explain a few days later. Seeing the same information again can create a feeling of familiarity, but that feeling is not the same as successfully retrieving it from memory.</p>
                <p>Testing yourself and returning to material over time gives you opportunities to practice retrieval and notice what has become difficult to remember. The aim is not to eliminate forgetting completely; it is to make review a deliberate part of learning.</p>
            </section>

            <section class="article-section" id="combine-techniques">
                <h2>4. Why combine active recall and spaced repetition?</h2>
                <p>The two techniques work on different parts of the study process. Active recall gives you a way to test what you can remember. Spaced repetition gives you a way to organize when you will practice again.</p>
                <p>Together, they create a repeatable cycle:</p>
                <ol class="article-steps">
                    <li><strong>Retrieve:</strong> Attempt to answer without looking.</li>
                    <li><strong>Evaluate:</strong> Check what you remembered and what you missed.</li>
                    <li><strong>Schedule:</strong> Decide when the material should be reviewed again.</li>
                    <li><strong>Repeat:</strong> Return to the material across future sessions.</li>
                </ol>
                <p>This routine can be useful when managing several courses because it provides a practical way to keep track of material that needs attention. It works best when paired with understanding, practice problems, and other methods appropriate to the subject—not as a replacement for them.</p>
            </section>

            <section class="article-section" id="mempulse-workflow">
                <h2>5. Putting it into practice with MemPulse</h2>
                <p>MemPulse brings active recall and spaced repetition into a flashcard workflow. You organize material into decks, attempt to answer each card, record whether you remembered it, and use the review schedule to decide what to study next.</p>
                <h3>Organize your material</h3>
                <p>Create a deck for each subject or topic. Add focused questions and answers so that each card tests a specific piece of knowledge.</p>
                <h3>Review what is due</h3>
                <p>Use the review hub to see which cards are due. Try to recall the answer before revealing it, then mark whether you remembered or forgot.</p>
                <h3>Let your responses guide the schedule</h3>
                <p>MemPulse adjusts each card's next review interval according to your response and your scheduling settings. With the default multipliers, a remembered card's interval grows by 2×, while a forgotten card's interval is reduced to 0.5×. The starting interval is one day, and the interval is capped at 365 days; these settings can be configured.</p>
                <h3>Review your progress</h3>
                <p>Your dashboard and reports show study activity such as cards due, cards reviewed, accuracy, streaks, and trends. Use this information to maintain a consistent routine and identify cards that continue to challenge you.</p>
                <div class="article-callout"><strong>A practical starting point:</strong> Make a small deck for one topic, test yourself before revealing each answer, and return to the cards when they are due. Consistency is more useful than trying to build a perfect routine all at once.</div>
            </section>

            <section class="article-cta" aria-labelledby="article-cta-title">
                <h2 id="article-cta-title">Make remembering part of your routine</h2>
                <p>Turn your study material into focused flashcards, practice recalling what you have learned, and build a review habit one session at a time.</p>
                <a href="../authentication/login.php" class="btn btn-primary">Start studying with MemPulse</a>
                <p class="article-footer-note">Learning techniques are tools, not guarantees. Choose review methods that fit your subject, learning goals, and study context.</p>
            </section>
        </article>
    </main>

<?php
/**
 * account-actions.php  (put in app/api/)
 *
 * Backend for the Profile, Security and Appearance tabs in Settings.
 *
 *   GET  -> returns the signed-in user's account details
 *   POST -> JSON body with an "action":
 *             update_profile   first_name, last_name, email, [current_password]
 *             change_password  current_password, new_password, confirm_password
 *             update_theme     theme (light | dark | system)
 */
session_start();

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');

function respond(int $status, array $data): void
{
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($data);
    exit;
}

if (($_SESSION['logged_in'] ?? false) !== true || !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    respond(401, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Please log in again.']);
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';

// Make every failed query throw, even if db.php turned that off.
mysqli_report(MYSQLI_REPORT_ERROR | MYSQLI_REPORT_STRICT);

const ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH = 8;
const ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MAX_BYTES  = 72;   // bcrypt ignores everything past 72 bytes
const ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MAX_TRIES  = 5;    // wrong "current password" guesses allowed
const ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_LOCK_SECS  = 900;  // then locked for 15 minutes

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Helpers                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function getAccount(mysqli $conn, int $userId): ?array
{
    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn,
        "SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.role,
                u.created_at, u.password_changed_at,
                COALESCE(s.theme, 'system')
         FROM users u
         LEFT JOIN user_settings s ON s.user_id = u.id
         WHERE u.id = ? AND u.deleted_at IS NULL");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $first, $last, $email, $role, $created, $pwChanged, $theme);

    if (!mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt)) {
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return null;
    }
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    return [
        'first_name'          => $first,
        'last_name'           => $last,
        'email'               => $email,
        'role'                => $role,
        'member_since'        => $created,
        'password_changed_at' => $pwChanged,
        'theme'               => $theme,
    ];
}

function cleanName($value): ?string
{
    if (!is_string($value)) {
        return null;
    }
    $value = preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $value);   // null if not valid UTF-8
    if ($value === null) {
        return null;
    }
    $value = trim($value);
    if ($value === '' || mb_strlen($value) > 100 || preg_match('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/u', $value)) {
        return null;
    }
    return $value;
}

/**
 * Stops the request unless $password is the user's current password.
 * Wrong guesses are counted in the session; after 5 the user is locked out for 15 minutes.
 */
function requireCurrentPassword(mysqli $conn, int $userId, string $password): void
{
    $lockedUntil = (int) ($_SESSION['account_pw_locked_until'] ?? 0);
    if ($lockedUntil > time()) {
        $minutes = (int) ceil(($lockedUntil - time()) / 60);
        respond(429, ['success' => false,
            'message' => "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in {$minutes} minute(s)."]);
    }

    if ($password === '') {
        respond(422, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Enter your current password.']);
    }

    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $hash);
    $found = mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    if ($found && password_verify($password, $hash)) {
        unset($_SESSION['account_pw_attempts'], $_SESSION['account_pw_locked_until']);
        return;
    }

    $attempts = (int) ($_SESSION['account_pw_attempts'] ?? 0) + 1;
    if ($attempts >= ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MAX_TRIES) {
        $_SESSION['account_pw_attempts'] = 0;
        $_SESSION['account_pw_locked_until'] = time() + ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_LOCK_SECS;
        respond(429, ['success' => false,
            'message' => 'Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.']);
    }
    $_SESSION['account_pw_attempts'] = $attempts;

    respond(422, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Your current password is incorrect.']);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Actions                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function handleUpdateProfile(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $data): void
{
    $first = cleanName($data['first_name'] ?? null);
    $last  = cleanName($data['last_name'] ?? null);
    $email = is_string($data['email'] ?? null) ? mb_strtolower(trim($data['email'])) : '';

    if ($first === null || $last === null) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false,
            'message' => 'Enter a first and last name, up to 100 characters each.']);
    }
    if ($email === '' || mb_strlen($email) > 255 || !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Enter a valid email address.']);
    }

    $account = getAccount($conn, $userId);
    if ($account === null) {
        respond(404, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Account not found.']);
    }

    // Changing the email address requires the current password.
    if ($email !== mb_strtolower($account['email'])) {
        $current = is_string($data['current_password'] ?? null) ? $data['current_password'] : '';
        requireCurrentPassword($conn, $userId, $current);

        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ? AND id <> ? LIMIT 1");
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'si', $email, $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        mysqli_stmt_store_result($stmt);
        $taken = mysqli_stmt_num_rows($stmt) > 0;
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

        if ($taken) {
            respond(409, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'That email address is already in use.']);
        }
    }

    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn,
        "UPDATE users SET first_name = ?, last_name = ?, email = ?
         WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'sssi', $first, $last, $email, $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    respond(200, [
        'success' => true,
        'message' => 'Profile saved.',
        'account' => getAccount($conn, $userId),
    ]);
}

function handleChangePassword(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $data): void
{
    $current = is_string($data['current_password'] ?? null) ? $data['current_password'] : '';
    $new     = is_string($data['new_password'] ?? null) ? $data['new_password'] : '';
    $confirm = is_string($data['confirm_password'] ?? null) ? $data['confirm_password'] : '';

    if ($new !== $confirm) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'The new passwords do not match.']);
    }
    if (mb_strlen($new) < ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false,
            'message' => 'Use at least ' . ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH . ' characters for the new password.']);
    }
    if (strlen($new) > ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MAX_BYTES) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false,
            'message' => 'The new password is too long. Use at most ' . ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_MAX_BYTES . ' bytes.']);
    }

    requireCurrentPassword($conn, $userId, $current);

    if (hash_equals($current, $new)) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false,
            'message' => 'Choose a password that is different from your current one.']);
    }

    $hash = password_hash($new, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);

    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn,
        "UPDATE users SET password_hash = ?, password_changed_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'si', $hash, $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    // New session id after a credential change; the user stays signed in here.
    session_regenerate_id(true);

    respond(200, [
        'success' => true,
        'message' => 'Password changed.',
        'account' => getAccount($conn, $userId),
    ]);
}

function handleUpdateTheme(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $data): void
{
    $theme = $data['theme'] ?? '';
    if (!in_array($theme, ['light', 'dark', 'system'], true)) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Choose light, dark, or system.']);
    }

    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn,
        "INSERT INTO user_settings (user_id, theme) VALUES (?, ?)
         ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE theme = VALUES(theme)");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'is', $userId, $theme);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    respond(200, ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Appearance saved.', 'theme' => $theme]);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Router                                                              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];

if ($method !== 'GET' && $method !== 'POST') {
    header('Allow: GET, POST');
    respond(405, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Method not allowed.']);
}

try {
    if ($method === 'GET') {
        $account = getAccount($conn, $userId);
        if ($account === null) {
            respond(404, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Account not found.']);
        }
        respond(200, ['success' => true, 'account' => $account]);
    }

    // POST: same CSRF token the learning-settings form already uses.
    $sentToken = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '';
    if (empty($_SESSION['settings_csrf']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['settings_csrf'], $sentToken)) {
        respond(403, ['success' => false,
            'message' => 'Security token invalid. Refresh the page and try again.']);
    }

    $data = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if (!is_array($data)) {
        respond(400, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid request data.']);
    }

    switch ($data['action'] ?? '') {
        case 'update_profile':
            handleUpdateProfile($conn, $userId, $data);
            break;
        case 'change_password':
            handleChangePassword($conn, $userId, $data);
            break;
        case 'update_theme':
            handleUpdateTheme($conn, $userId, $data);
            break;
        default:
            respond(400, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Unknown action.']);
    }
} catch (mysqli_sql_exception $e) {
    if ((int) $e->getCode() === 1062) {   // duplicate email (unique index)
        respond(409, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'That email address is already in use.']);
    }
    error_log('account-actions.php SQL error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    respond(500, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Something went wrong. Please try again.']);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('account-actions.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    respond(500, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Something went wrong. Please try again.']);
}

<?php
/**
 * ArchiveService
 *
 * Reusable archive / restore / permanent-delete / auto-purge logic built on the
 * soft-delete column (deleted_at). Register new entities in entity().
 */
class ArchiveService
{
    /** Days an archived record is kept before it is permanently purged. */
    public const RETENTION_DAYS = 30;

    /** Whitelisted entities. Ownership is always checked against the user. */
    private static function entity(string $type): ?array
    {
        switch ($type) {
            case 'flashcards':
                return [
                    'table' => 'flashcards',
                    'join'  => 'JOIN decks d ON d.id = t.deck_id',
                    'owner' => 'd.user_id = ?',
                ];
            case 'decks':
                return [
                    'table' => 'decks',
                    'join'  => '',
                    'owner' => 't.user_id = ?',
                ];
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static function run(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types, array $params): int
    {
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return 0;
        }
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $affected = mysqli_stmt_affected_rows($stmt);
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return max(0, (int) $affected);
    }

    /** Archive (soft delete). */
    public static function archive(mysqli $conn, string $type, int $id, int $userId): bool
    {
        $e = self::entity($type);
        if (!$e) return false;
        $sql = "UPDATE {$e['table']} t {$e['join']}
                   SET t.deleted_at = NOW()
                 WHERE t.id = ? AND {$e['owner']} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL";
        return self::run($conn, $sql, 'ii', [$id, $userId]) > 0;
    }

    /** Restore an archived record. */
    public static function restore(mysqli $conn, string $type, int $id, int $userId): bool
    {
        $e = self::entity($type);
        if (!$e) return false;
        $sql = "UPDATE {$e['table']} t {$e['join']}
                   SET t.deleted_at = NULL
                 WHERE t.id = ? AND {$e['owner']} AND t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL";
        return self::run($conn, $sql, 'ii', [$id, $userId]) > 0;
    }

    /** Permanently delete. Only works on records that are already archived. */
    public static function deletePermanently(mysqli $conn, string $type, int $id, int $userId): bool
    {
        $e = self::entity($type);
        if (!$e) return false;
        $sql = "DELETE t FROM {$e['table']} t {$e['join']}
                 WHERE t.id = ? AND {$e['owner']} AND t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL";
        return self::run($conn, $sql, 'ii', [$id, $userId]) > 0;
    }

    /** Permanently remove this user's records archived longer than RETENTION_DAYS. */
    public static function purgeExpired(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $types = ['flashcards']): void
    {
        foreach ($types as $type) {
            $e = self::entity($type);
            if (!$e) continue;
            $sql = "DELETE t FROM {$e['table']} t {$e['join']}
                     WHERE {$e['owner']}
                       AND t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                       AND t.deleted_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL ? DAY)";
            self::run($conn, $sql, 'ii', [$userId, self::RETENTION_DAYS]);
        }
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * DashboardService
 * 
 * Centralized service layer for handling database reads, user profiling,
 * spaced repetition metric analytics, and streak tracking.
 */
class DashboardService
{
    /**
     * Retrieve authenticated user profile details.
     * 
     * @param mysqli $conn Active database connection instance.
     * @param int $userId Authenticated user ID.
     * @return array Profile metadata containing display name.
     */
    public static function getUserProfile(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT first_name, last_name FROM users WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL";
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        
        if (!$stmt) {
            return ['displayName' => 'Active Learner'];
        }

        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $firstName, $lastName);
        mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

        $fullName = trim(($firstName ?? '') . ' ' . ($lastName ?? ''));
        
        return [
            'displayName' => !empty($fullName) ? $fullName : 'Active Learner'
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Fetch core flashcard and study session metrics.
     * 
     * @param mysqli $conn Active database connection instance.
     * @param int $userId Authenticated user ID.
     * @return array Calculated user metrics.
     */
    public static function getMetrics(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        // 1. Cards Due Today
        $due = self::fetchCount($conn, 
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f 
             JOIN decks d ON f.deck_id = d.id
             WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.next_review_at <= NOW()", 
            $userId
        );

        // 2. Mastered Cards (Interval >= 21 days)
        $mastered = self::fetchCount($conn, 
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f 
             JOIN decks d ON f.deck_id = d.id 
             WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.interval_days >= 21", 
            $userId
        );

        // 3. Tough Cards / Leeches (Lapses >= 8)
        $tough = self::fetchCount($conn, 
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f 
             JOIN decks d ON f.deck_id = d.id 
             WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.lapses >= 8", 
            $userId
        );

        // 4. Cards Reviewed Today
        $reviewedToday = self::fetchCount($conn, 
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) FROM review_sessions 
             WHERE user_id = ? AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(started_at) = CURDATE()", 
            $userId
        );

        // 5. Retention Rate Percentage
        $retentionRate = 0.0;
        $retentionSql = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remembered_count), 0), COALESCE(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) 
                         FROM review_sessions 
                         WHERE user_id = ? AND ended_at IS NOT NULL";
                         
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $retentionSql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $remembered, $reviewed);
            if (mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt) && $reviewed > 0) {
                $retentionRate = round(($remembered / $reviewed) * 100, 1);
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }

        return [
            'cardsDue' => $due,
            'masteredCards' => $mastered,
            'toughCards' => $tough,
            'cardsReviewedToday' => $reviewedToday,
            'retentionRate' => $retentionRate
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Compute activity history, streaks, and heatmap data.
     * 
     * @param mysqli $conn Active database connection instance.
     * @param int $userId Authenticated user ID.
     * @return array Streak counters and calendar heatmap data.
     */
    public static function getStreakAndHeatmapData(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $sessionSql = "SELECT DATE(started_at) as session_date, 
                              SUM(remembered_count) as total_remembered, 
                              SUM(total_reviewed) as total_reviewed
                       FROM review_sessions 
                       WHERE user_id = ? AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
                       GROUP BY DATE(started_at)
                       HAVING SUM(total_reviewed) > 0
                       ORDER BY session_date DESC";

        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sessionSql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return self::emptyStreakState();
        }

        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);

        $activityHistory = [];
        while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
            $activityHistory[$row['session_date']] = [
                'remembered' => (int) $row['total_remembered'],
                'reviewed' => (int) $row['total_reviewed']
            ];
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

        if (empty($activityHistory)) {
            return self::emptyStreakState();
        }

        // Streak Analytics Processing
        $todayStr = date('Y-m-d');
        $yesterdayStr = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-1 day'));
        
        $currentStreak = 0;
        $bestStreak = 0;
        $streakAccuracy = 0.0;
        
        $dates = array_keys($activityHistory);
        $latestDate = $dates[0];

        // Active Streak calculation
        if ($latestDate === $todayStr || $latestDate === $yesterdayStr) {
            $checkDate = new DateTime($latestDate);
            $streakRemembered = 0;
            $streakReviewed = 0;

            while (true) {
                $dateKey = $checkDate->format('Y-m-d');
                if (isset($activityHistory[$dateKey])) {
                    $currentStreak++;
                    $streakRemembered += $activityHistory[$dateKey]['remembered'];
                    $streakReviewed += $activityHistory[$dateKey]['reviewed'];
                    $checkDate->modify('-1 day');
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if ($streakReviewed > 0) {
                $streakAccuracy = round(($streakRemembered / $streakReviewed) * 100, 1);
            }
        }

        // Best Historical Streak calculation
        $tempStreak = 0;
        $expectedDate = null;

        foreach (array_reverse($dates) as $dateStr) {
            $currentDate = new DateTime($dateStr);
            if ($expectedDate === null || $currentDate == $expectedDate) {
                $tempStreak++;
            } else {
                if ($tempStreak > $bestStreak) {
                    $bestStreak = $tempStreak;
                }
                $tempStreak = 1;
            }
            $expectedDate = clone $currentDate;
            $expectedDate->modify('+1 day');
        }

        if ($tempStreak > $bestStreak) {
            $bestStreak = $tempStreak;
        }

        // Heatmap bounds calculation
        $heatmapEnd = new DateTime('today');
        $heatmapStart = (clone $heatmapEnd)->modify('-364 days');
        $heatmapData = [];
        $studyDays = 0;

        foreach ($activityHistory as $dateStr => $metrics) {
            $activityDate = DateTime::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $dateStr);
            if ($activityDate && $activityDate >= $heatmapStart && $activityDate <= $heatmapEnd && $metrics['reviewed'] > 0) {
                $heatmapData[$dateStr] = $metrics['reviewed'];
                $studyDays++;
            }
        }

        $calendarStart = clone $heatmapStart;
        $calendarStart->modify('monday this week');

        return [
            'currentStreak' => $currentStreak,
            'bestStreak' => $bestStreak,
            'streakAccuracy' => $streakAccuracy,
            'studyDays' => $studyDays,
            'heatmapData' => $heatmapData,
            'heatmapStart' => $heatmapStart,
            'heatmapEnd' => $heatmapEnd,
            'calendarStart' => $calendarStart
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve recent completed study sessions for the activity feed.
     * 
     * @param mysqli $conn Active database connection instance.
     * @param int $userId Authenticated user ID.
     * @param int $limit Max sessions to return.
     * @return array Session history items.
     */
    public static function getRecentSessions(mysqli $conn, int $userId, int $limit = 4): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT rs.id, d.title as deck_title, rs.total_reviewed as cards_reviewed, 
                       rs.accuracy_percentage as accuracy, rs.started_at 
                FROM review_sessions rs 
                JOIN decks d ON rs.deck_id = d.id 
                WHERE rs.user_id = ? AND rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL 
                ORDER BY rs.started_at DESC LIMIT ?";

        $sessions = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "ii", $userId, $limit);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);

            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $timeDiff = time() - strtotime($row['started_at']);
                if ($timeDiff < 3600) {
                    $formatted = floor($timeDiff / 60) . ' mins ago';
                } elseif ($timeDiff < 86400) {
                    $formatted = floor($timeDiff / 3600) . ' hours ago';
                } else {
                    $formatted = floor($timeDiff / 86400) . ' days ago';
                }

                $sessions[] = [
                    'deckTitle' => $row['deck_title'],
                    'cardsReviewed' => (int) $row['cards_reviewed'],
                    'accuracy' => (int) $row['accuracy'],
                    'formattedTime' => $formatted
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }

        return $sessions;
    }

        /**
     * Decks that currently have cards due, most due first.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{id:int,title:string,dueCount:int}>
     */
    public static function getDueByDeck(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT d.id, d.title, COUNT(*) AS due_count
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON f.deck_id = d.id
                WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.next_review_at <= NOW()
                GROUP BY d.id, d.title
                ORDER BY due_count DESC, d.title ASC";

        $decks = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $decks[] = [
                    'id'       => (int) $row['id'],
                    'title'    => $row['title'],
                    'dueCount' => (int) $row['due_count'],
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $decks;
    }

    /**
     * Seconds until the next card becomes due, or null if the user has no upcoming cards.
     * Computed in SQL so PHP/MySQL timezone differences cannot skew it.
     */
    public static function getNextDueSeconds(mysqli $conn, int $userId): ?int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), MIN(f.next_review_at))
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON f.deck_id = d.id
                WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.next_review_at > NOW()";

        $secs = null;
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $secs);
            mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $secs === null ? null : (int) $secs;
    }
    private static function fetchCount(mysqli $conn, string $query, int $userId): int
    {
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $query)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $count);
            mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
            return (int) $count;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static function emptyStreakState(): array
    {
        return [
            'currentStreak' => 0,
            'bestStreak' => 0,
            'streakAccuracy' => 0.0,
            'studyDays' => 0,
            'heatmapData' => [],
            'heatmapStart' => new DateTime('-364 days'),
            'heatmapEnd' => new DateTime('today'),
            'calendarStart' => (new DateTime('-364 days'))->modify('monday this week')
        ];
    }
}
