<?php
/**
 * ReportsService
 *
 * Read-only analytics queries for the Reports page.
 * Every query is scoped to the authenticated user and uses prepared statements.
 *
 * Conventions (same as DashboardService):
 *  - A "completed" session is one with ended_at IS NOT NULL.
 *  - Totals and accuracy come from review_sessions (they survive a card Reset).
 *  - review_logs is only for card-level detail (used by later tabs).
 */
class ReportsService
{
    public const RANGES = ['7d' => 7, '30d' => 30, '90d' => 90, 'all' => 0, 'custom' => 0];
    public const TABS   = ['overview', 'decks', 'cards', 'sessions'];

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  FILTERS                                                            */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Validate $_GET input into a safe filter array.
     */
    public static function parseFilters(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $get): array
    {
        $range = (string) ($get['range'] ?? '30d');
        if (!array_key_exists($range, self::RANGES)) {
            $range = '30d';
        }

        $today = new DateTimeImmutable('today');
        $from  = $today->modify('-29 days');
        $to    = $today;

        if ($range === '7d' || $range === '30d' || $range === '90d') {
            $from = $today->modify('-' . (self::RANGES[$range] - 1) . ' days');
        } elseif ($range === 'all') {
            $first = self::firstSessionDate($conn, $userId);
            if ($first !== null) {
                $from = $first;
            }
        } else { // custom
            $f = self::parseDate((string) ($get['from'] ?? ''));
            $t = self::parseDate((string) ($get['to'] ?? ''));
            if ($f !== null && $t !== null) {
                if ($f > $t) {
                    [$f, $t] = [$t, $f];
                }
                if ($t > $today) {
                    $t = $today;
                }
                if ($f > $t) {
                    $f = $t;
                }
                $from = $f;
                $to   = $t;
            } else {
                $range = '30d'; // incomplete custom range falls back safely
            }
        }

        // Deck filter: must belong to this user. An archived deck switches the archived toggle on.
        $deckId          = 0;
        $deckTitle       = 'All decks';
        $includeArchived = (($get['archived'] ?? '') === '1');
        $rawDeck         = (string) ($get['deck'] ?? '');

        if ($rawDeck !== '' && ctype_digit($rawDeck) && (int) $rawDeck > 0) {
            $deck = self::fetchDeckOwned($conn, $userId, (int) $rawDeck);
            if ($deck !== null) {
                $deckId    = (int) $deck['id'];
                $deckTitle = $deck['title'];
                if ($deck['deleted_at'] !== null) {
                    $includeArchived = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Drill-down deck (separate from the deck filter so the table keeps all decks).
        $focusId    = 0;
        $focusTitle = '';
        $rawFocus   = (string) ($get['focus'] ?? '');

        if ($rawFocus !== '' && ctype_digit($rawFocus) && (int) $rawFocus > 0) {
            $fd = self::fetchDeckOwned($conn, $userId, (int) $rawFocus);
            if ($fd !== null && ($deckId === 0 || $deckId === (int) $fd['id'])) {
                $focusId    = (int) $fd['id'];
                $focusTitle = $fd['title'];
                if ($fd['deleted_at'] !== null) {
                    $includeArchived = true;
                }
            }
        }

        $tab = (string) ($get['tab'] ?? 'overview');
        if (!in_array($tab, self::TABS, true)) {
            $tab = 'overview';
        }

        return [
            'range'           => $range,
            'from'            => $from->format('Y-m-d'),
            'to'              => $to->format('Y-m-d'),
            'fromDt'          => $from->format('Y-m-d') . ' 00:00:00',
            'toExclusive'     => $to->modify('+1 day')->format('Y-m-d') . ' 00:00:00',
            'days'            => (int) $from->diff($to)->days + 1,
            'deckId'          => $deckId,
            'deckTitle'       => $deckTitle,
            'includeArchived' => $includeArchived,
            'tab'             => $tab,
            'focusId'         => $focusId,
            'focusTitle'      => $focusTitle,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Decks for the filter dropdown.
     */
    public static function getDeckOptions(mysqli $conn, int $userId, bool $includeArchived): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT id, title, deleted_at FROM decks WHERE user_id = ?"
             . ($includeArchived ? "" : " AND deleted_at IS NULL")
             . " ORDER BY title ASC";
        $rows = self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, 'i', [$userId]);

        return array_map(fn($r) => [
            'id'       => (int) $r['id'],
            'title'    => $r['title'],
            'archived' => $r['deleted_at'] !== null,
        ], $rows);
    }

    /**
     * Build a query string that keeps the current filters (used by tab links and exports).
     */
    public static function buildQuery(array $f, array $override = []): string
    {
        $q = ['range' => $f['range']];
        if ($f['range'] === 'custom') {
            $q['from'] = $f['from'];
            $q['to']   = $f['to'];
        }
        if ($f['deckId'] > 0) {
            $q['deck'] = $f['deckId'];
        }
        if ($f['includeArchived']) {
            $q['archived'] = '1';
        }
        if (($f['focusId'] ?? 0) > 0) {
            $q['focus'] = $f['focusId'];
        }
        $q['tab'] = $f['tab'];

        return http_build_query(array_merge($q, $override));
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  OVERVIEW TAB                                                       */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    public static function getOverview(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        return [
            'kpis'     => self::getKpis($conn, $userId, $f),
            'timeline' => self::getTimeline($conn, $userId, $f),
            'forecast' => self::getForecast($conn, $userId, $f),
            'streak'   => self::getStreak($conn, $userId),
        ];
    }

    private static function getKpis(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::sessionScope($userId, $f);

        $sql = "SELECT
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN s.total_reviewed END), 0)   AS reviewed,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN s.remembered_count END), 0) AS remembered,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                                      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.started_at, s.ended_at) END), 0) AS seconds,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS completed,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NULL THEN 1 END)     AS abandoned,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND s.total_reviewed > 0
                                        THEN DATE(s.started_at) END)   AS active_days
                FROM review_sessions s
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $where";

        $row = self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params)[0] ?? [];

        $reviewed   = (int) ($row['reviewed'] ?? 0);
        $remembered = (int) ($row['remembered'] ?? 0);
        $completed  = (int) ($row['completed'] ?? 0);
        $abandoned  = (int) ($row['abandoned'] ?? 0);
        $started    = $completed + $abandoned;

        return [
            'totalReviews'   => $reviewed,
            'remembered'     => $remembered,
            'forgotten'      => max(0, $reviewed - $remembered),
            'accuracy'       => $reviewed > 0 ? round(($remembered / $reviewed) * 100, 1) : 0.0,
            'studySeconds'   => (int) ($row['seconds'] ?? 0),
            'sessions'       => $completed,
            'abandoned'      => $abandoned,
            'completionRate' => $started > 0 ? round(($completed / $started) * 100, 1) : 0.0,
            'activeDays'     => (int) ($row['active_days'] ?? 0),
            'rangeDays'      => (int) $f['days'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Reviews + accuracy per day (range <= 31 days) or per week (longer ranges).
     * Empty buckets are filled so the chart has a continuous axis.
     */
    private static function getTimeline(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::sessionScope($userId, $f);

        $granularity = ($f['days'] <= 31) ? 'day' : 'week';
        $bucketExpr  = ($granularity === 'day')
            ? "DATE(s.started_at)"
            : "DATE_SUB(DATE(s.started_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(s.started_at) DAY)";

        $sql = "SELECT $bucketExpr AS bucket,
                       SUM(s.total_reviewed)   AS reviewed,
                       SUM(s.remembered_count) AS remembered
                FROM review_sessions s
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $where AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY bucket
                ORDER BY bucket ASC";

        $byBucket = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $byBucket[$r['bucket']] = [(int) $r['reviewed'], (int) $r['remembered']];
        }

        $from = new DateTimeImmutable($f['from']);
        $to   = new DateTimeImmutable($f['to']);

        if ($granularity === 'week') {
            // Snap to Monday so keys match MySQL WEEKDAY() bucketing.
            $from = $from->modify('-' . ((int) $from->format('N') - 1) . ' days');
        }

        $step = ($granularity === 'day') ? '+1 day' : '+7 days';
        $labels = $reviewed = $accuracy = [];

        for ($cursor = $from; $cursor <= $to; $cursor = $cursor->modify($step)) {
            $key = $cursor->format('Y-m-d');
            [$rv, $rm] = $byBucket[$key] ?? [0, 0];

            $labels[]   = $cursor->format('M j');
            $reviewed[] = $rv;
            $accuracy[] = $rv > 0 ? round(($rm / $rv) * 100, 1) : null;
        }

        return [
            'granularity' => $granularity,
            'labels'      => $labels,
            'reviewed'    => $reviewed,
            'accuracy'    => $accuracy,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Cards coming due. Forward-looking, so the date range does not apply
     * (deck and archived filters do).
     */
    private static function getForecast(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        $where  = "d.user_id = ? AND f.deleted_at IS NULL";
        $types  = 'i';
        $params = [$userId];

        if ($f['deckId'] > 0) {
            $where   .= " AND d.id = ?";
            $types   .= 'i';
            $params[] = $f['deckId'];
        }
        if (!$f['includeArchived']) {
            $where .= " AND d.deleted_at IS NULL";
        }

        $sql = "SELECT CASE WHEN f.next_review_at <= NOW() THEN -1
                            ELSE DATEDIFF(DATE(f.next_review_at), CURDATE()) END AS day_offset,
                       COUNT(*) AS cnt
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
                WHERE $where AND f.next_review_at < (CURDATE() + INTERVAL 30 DAY)
                GROUP BY day_offset";

        $counts = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $counts[(int) $r['day_offset']] = (int) $r['cnt'];
        }

        $dueNow = $counts[-1] ?? 0;
        $next7  = $dueNow;
        $next30 = $dueNow;
        $labels = ['Due now'];
        $values = [$dueNow];
        $today  = new DateTimeImmutable('today');

        for ($i = 0; $i < 30; $i++) {
            $c = $counts[$i] ?? 0;
            $next30 += $c;
            if ($i < 7) {
                $next7   += $c;
                $labels[] = ($i === 0) ? 'Later today' : (($i === 1) ? 'Tomorrow' : $today->modify("+$i days")->format('D j'));
                $values[] = $c;
            }
        }

        return [
            'dueNow' => $dueNow,
            'next7'  => $next7,
            'next30' => $next30,
            'labels' => $labels,
            'values' => $values,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * All-time streaks (not affected by filters), reusing the dashboard logic.
     */
    private static function getStreak(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $s = DashboardService::getStreakAndHeatmapData($conn, $userId);

        return [
            'current' => (int) ($s['currentStreak'] ?? 0),
            'best'    => (int) ($s['bestStreak'] ?? 0),
        ];
    }

     /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  DECKS TAB                                                          */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
 
    /**
     * One row per deck: card stats (current state, not date-bound) plus
     * review activity inside the selected period.
     */
    public static function getDecksReport(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        // 1) Card stats per deck. LEFT JOIN so empty decks still appear.
        $where  = "d.user_id = ?";
        $types  = 'i';
        $params = [$userId];
 
        if ($f['deckId'] > 0) {
            $where   .= " AND d.id = ?";
            $types   .= 'i';
            $params[] = $f['deckId'];
        }
        if (!$f['includeArchived']) {
            $where .= " AND d.deleted_at IS NULL";
        }
 
        $sql = "SELECT d.id, d.title, d.deleted_at,
                       COUNT(f.id) AS cards,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at <= NOW()), 0) AS due_now,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.interval_days >= 21), 0)     AS mastered,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.lapses >= 8), 0)             AS leeches
                FROM decks d
                LEFT JOIN flashcards f ON f.deck_id = d.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE $where
                GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.deleted_at
                ORDER BY d.title ASC";
 
        $decks = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $id = (int) $r['id'];
            $decks[$id] = [
                'id'          => $id,
                'title'       => $r['title'],
                'archived'    => $r['deleted_at'] !== null,
                'cards'       => (int) $r['cards'],
                'dueNow'      => (int) $r['due_now'],
                'mastered'    => (int) $r['mastered'],
                'leeches'     => (int) $r['leeches'],
                'masteryPct'  => ((int) $r['cards']) > 0 ? (int) round(((int) $r['mastered'] / (int) $r['cards']) * 100) : 0,
                'reviews'     => 0,
                'remembered'  => 0,
                'sessions'    => 0,
                'seconds'     => 0,
                'accuracy'    => null,
                'lastStudied' => null,
            ];
        }
 
        if (empty($decks)) {
            return ['rows' => [], 'totals' => null, 'charts' => ['reviews' => null, 'mastery' => null]];
        }
 
        // 2) Completed-session activity inside the period.
        [$sWhere, $sTypes, $sParams] = self::sessionScope($userId, $f);
        $sql = "SELECT s.deck_id,
                       SUM(s.total_reviewed)   AS reviewed,
                       SUM(s.remembered_count) AS remembered,
                       COUNT(*)                AS sessions,
                       SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.started_at, s.ended_at)) AS seconds
                FROM review_sessions s
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $sWhere AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY s.deck_id";
 
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $sTypes, $sParams) as $r) {
            $id = (int) $r['deck_id'];
            if (!isset($decks[$id])) {
                continue;
            }
            $reviewed   = (int) $r['reviewed'];
            $remembered = (int) $r['remembered'];
 
            $decks[$id]['reviews']    = $reviewed;
            $decks[$id]['remembered'] = $remembered;
            $decks[$id]['sessions']   = (int) $r['sessions'];
            $decks[$id]['seconds']    = (int) $r['seconds'];
            $decks[$id]['accuracy']   = $reviewed > 0 ? round(($remembered / $reviewed) * 100, 1) : null;
        }
 
        // 3) Last studied: all time, not limited by the period.
        $sql = "SELECT s.deck_id, MAX(s.ended_at) AS last_at
                FROM review_sessions s
                WHERE s.user_id = ? AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY s.deck_id";
 
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, 'i', [$userId]) as $r) {
            $id = (int) $r['deck_id'];
            if (isset($decks[$id])) {
                $decks[$id]['lastStudied'] = $r['last_at'];
            }
        }
 
        $rows = array_values($decks);
 
        // Default order: most reviewed first, then by title.
        usort($rows, function ($a, $b) {
            return [$b['reviews'], $a['title']] <=> [$a['reviews'], $b['title']];
        });
 
        // Totals row.
        $totals = ['decks' => count($rows), 'cards' => 0, 'dueNow' => 0, 'mastered' => 0, 'leeches' => 0,
                   'reviews' => 0, 'remembered' => 0, 'sessions' => 0, 'seconds' => 0];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            foreach (['cards', 'dueNow', 'mastered', 'leeches', 'reviews', 'remembered', 'sessions', 'seconds'] as $key) {
                $totals[$key] += $r[$key];
            }
        }
        $totals['accuracy']   = $totals['reviews'] > 0 ? round(($totals['remembered'] / $totals['reviews']) * 100, 1) : null;
        $totals['masteryPct'] = $totals['cards'] > 0 ? (int) round(($totals['mastered'] / $totals['cards']) * 100) : 0;
 
        // Chart data (top 10 each).
        $byReviews = array_values(array_filter($rows, fn($r) => $r['reviews'] > 0));
        $byReviews = array_slice($byReviews, 0, 10);
 
        $byCards = array_values(array_filter($rows, fn($r) => $r['cards'] > 0));
        usort($byCards, fn($a, $b) => [$b['cards'], $a['title']] <=> [$a['cards'], $b['title']]);
        $byCards = array_slice($byCards, 0, 10);
 
        return [
            'rows'   => $rows,
            'totals' => $totals,
            'charts' => [
                'reviews' => $byReviews ? [
                    'labels'   => array_column($byReviews, 'title'),
                    'reviews'  => array_column($byReviews, 'reviews'),
                    'accuracy' => array_column($byReviews, 'accuracy'),
                ] : null,
                'mastery' => $byCards ? [
                    'labels'   => array_column($byCards, 'title'),
                    'mastered' => array_column($byCards, 'mastered'),
                    'rest'     => array_map(fn($r) => $r['cards'] - $r['mastered'], $byCards),
                ] : null,
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Drill-down for the focused deck: accuracy trend in the period + hardest cards.
     * Returns null when no deck is focused.
     */
    public static function getDeckDrilldown(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): ?array
    {
        if (($f['focusId'] ?? 0) <= 0) {
            return null;
        }

        // Same day/week bucketing as the Overview chart, scoped to the focused deck.
        $trend = self::getTimeline($conn, $userId, array_merge($f, ['deckId' => $f['focusId']]));

        $sql = "SELECT f.id, f.front, f.lapses, f.review_count, f.interval_days, f.next_review_at
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
                WHERE d.user_id = ? AND f.deck_id = ? AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.lapses > 0
                ORDER BY f.lapses DESC, f.review_count DESC, f.id ASC
                LIMIT 10";

        $cards = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, 'ii', [$userId, $f['focusId']]) as $r) {
            $cards[] = [
                'id'       => (int) $r['id'],
                'front'    => (string) $r['front'],
                'lapses'   => (int) $r['lapses'],
                'reviews'  => (int) $r['review_count'],
                'interval' => (int) $r['interval_days'],
                'next'     => $r['next_review_at'],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'trend'    => $trend,
            'hasTrend' => array_sum($trend['reviewed']) > 0,
            'cards'    => $cards,
        ];
    }

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  CARDS TAB                                                          */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    public static function getCardsReport(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        return [
            'maturity' => self::getMaturity($conn, $userId, $f),
            'leeches'  => self::getLeeches($conn, $userId, $f),
            'interval' => self::getIntervalGrowth($conn, $userId, $f),
            'response' => self::getResponseTimes($conn, $userId, $f),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * New = never reviewed. Learning < 7 days, Young 7-20, Mastered 21+.
     * Current state: the date range does not apply.
     */
    private static function getMaturity(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::cardScope($userId, $f);

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.review_count = 0), 0) AS new_cnt,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days < 7), 0) AS learning,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days >= 7 AND f.interval_days < 21), 0) AS young,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days >= 21), 0) AS mastered,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.lapses >= 8), 0) AS leeches
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
                WHERE $where";

        $row   = self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params)[0] ?? [];
        $total = (int) ($row['total'] ?? 0);

        $defs = [
            ['New',      'Never reviewed',       (int) ($row['new_cnt'] ?? 0),  '#94a3b8'],
            ['Learning', 'Interval under 7 days', (int) ($row['learning'] ?? 0), '#f59e0b'],
            ['Young',    'Interval 7-20 days',    (int) ($row['young'] ?? 0),    '#6366f1'],
            ['Mastered', 'Interval 21+ days',     (int) ($row['mastered'] ?? 0), '#14b8a6'],
        ];

        $segments = [];
        foreach ($defs as [$label, $rule, $count, $color]) {
            $segments[] = [
                'label' => $label,
                'rule'  => $rule,
                'count' => $count,
                'pct'   => $total > 0 ? (int) round(($count / $total) * 100) : 0,
                'color' => $color,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'total'       => $total,
            'segments'    => $segments,
            'leechTotal'  => (int) ($row['leeches'] ?? 0),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Cards with lapses >= 8 (same threshold as the dashboard). Top 25.
     */
    private static function getLeeches(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::cardScope($userId, $f);

        $sql = "SELECT f.id, f.front, f.lapses, f.review_count, f.interval_days,
                       d.id AS deck_id, d.title AS deck_title, d.deleted_at AS deck_deleted
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
                WHERE $where AND f.lapses >= 8
                ORDER BY f.lapses DESC, f.review_count DESC, f.id ASC
                LIMIT 25";

        $rows = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $rows[] = [
                'id'       => (int) $r['id'],
                'front'    => (string) $r['front'],
                'lapses'   => (int) $r['lapses'],
                'reviews'  => (int) $r['review_count'],
                'interval' => (int) $r['interval_days'],
                'deckId'   => (int) $r['deck_id'],
                'deck'     => $r['deck_title'],
                'archived' => $r['deck_deleted'] !== null,
            ];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * Average previous vs new interval per week (Monday buckets) from review_logs.
     */
    private static function getIntervalGrowth(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::logScope($userId, $f);

        $sql = "SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(l.reviewed_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(l.reviewed_at) DAY) AS bucket,
                       AVG(l.previous_interval) AS avg_prev,
                       AVG(l.new_interval)      AS avg_new,
                       COUNT(*)                 AS n
                FROM review_logs l
                JOIN review_sessions s ON s.id = l.session_id
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $where
                GROUP BY bucket
                ORDER BY bucket ASC";

        $byWeek = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $byWeek[$r['bucket']] = [round((float) $r['avg_prev'], 1), round((float) $r['avg_new'], 1), (int) $r['n']];
        }

        $from = new DateTimeImmutable($f['from']);
        $to   = new DateTimeImmutable($f['to']);
        $from = $from->modify('-' . ((int) $from->format('N') - 1) . ' days'); // snap to Monday

        $labels = $prev = $new = $counts = [];
        for ($cursor = $from; $cursor <= $to; $cursor = $cursor->modify('+7 days')) {
            $key = $cursor->format('Y-m-d');
            $labels[] = $cursor->format('M j');
            $prev[]   = $byWeek[$key][0] ?? null;
            $new[]    = $byWeek[$key][1] ?? null;
            $counts[] = $byWeek[$key][2] ?? 0;
        }

        return [
            'hasData' => !empty($byWeek),
            'labels'  => $labels,
            'prev'    => $prev,
            'new'     => $new,
            'counts'  => $counts,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Average and median response time (ms) by rating, plus the slowest cards.
     * Median uses window functions (MariaDB 10.2+ / MySQL 8). If the server
     * lacks them the query fails quietly and the median shows as n/a.
     */
    private static function getResponseTimes(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::logScope($userId, $f);

        $out = [];
        foreach (['remembered', 'forgot'] as $rating) {
            $out[$rating] = ['total' => 0, 'timed' => 0, 'avg' => null, 'median' => null];
        }

        // COUNT(col) and AVG(col) both skip NULL response times.
        $sql = "SELECT l.rating,
                       COUNT(*) AS total,
                       COUNT(l.response_time_ms) AS timed,
                       AVG(l.response_time_ms)   AS avg_ms
                FROM review_logs l
                JOIN review_sessions s ON s.id = l.session_id
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $where
                GROUP BY l.rating";

        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            if (!isset($out[$r['rating']])) {
                continue;
            }
            $out[$r['rating']]['total'] = (int) $r['total'];
            $out[$r['rating']]['timed'] = (int) $r['timed'];
            $out[$r['rating']]['avg']   = $r['avg_ms'] !== null ? (int) round((float) $r['avg_ms']) : null;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT t.rating, AVG(t.ms) AS med
                FROM (
                    SELECT l.rating, l.response_time_ms AS ms,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.rating ORDER BY l.response_time_ms) AS rn,
                           COUNT(*)     OVER (PARTITION BY l.rating) AS cnt
                    FROM review_logs l
                    JOIN review_sessions s ON s.id = l.session_id
                    JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                    WHERE $where AND l.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
                ) t
                WHERE t.rn IN (FLOOR((t.cnt + 1) / 2), FLOOR(t.cnt / 2) + 1)
                GROUP BY t.rating";

        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            if (isset($out[$r['rating']])) {
                $out[$r['rating']]['median'] = (int) round((float) $r['med']);
            }
        }

        // Slowest cards: average time per card, needs 2+ timed reviews.
        $sql = "SELECT f.id, f.front, fd.title AS deck_title,
                       AVG(l.response_time_ms) AS avg_ms, COUNT(*) AS n
                FROM review_logs l
                JOIN review_sessions s ON s.id = l.session_id
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                JOIN flashcards f ON f.id = l.card_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                JOIN decks fd ON fd.id = f.deck_id
                WHERE $where AND l.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY f.id, f.front, fd.title
                HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
                ORDER BY avg_ms DESC, f.id ASC
                LIMIT 10";

        $slowest = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $slowest[] = [
                'id'    => (int) $r['id'],
                'front' => (string) $r['front'],
                'deck'  => $r['deck_title'],
                'avg'   => (int) round((float) $r['avg_ms']),
                'n'     => (int) $r['n'],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'remembered' => $out['remembered'],
            'forgot'     => $out['forgot'],
            'hasData'    => ($out['remembered']['total'] + $out['forgot']['total']) > 0,
            'slowest'    => $slowest,
        ];
    }
 
        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  SESSIONS TAB                                                       */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    public static function getSessionsReport(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        $k = self::getKpis($conn, $userId, $f);   // same numbers as the Overview tab

        return [
            'completion' => [
                'completed' => $k['sessions'],
                'abandoned' => $k['abandoned'],
                'started'   => $k['sessions'] + $k['abandoned'],
                'rate'      => $k['completionRate'],
            ],
            'bestTime' => self::getBestTime($conn, $userId, $f),
            'history'  => self::getSessionHistory($conn, $userId, $f),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Reviews and accuracy by hour of day and by weekday (from review_logs.reviewed_at).
     */
    private static function getBestTime(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::logScope($userId, $f);

        $sql = "SELECT HOUR(l.reviewed_at) AS hr, WEEKDAY(l.reviewed_at) AS wd,
                       COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(l.rating = 'remembered') AS ok
                FROM review_logs l
                JOIN review_sessions s ON s.id = l.session_id
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $where
                GROUP BY hr, wd";

        $hourN = array_fill(0, 24, 0);
        $hourOk = array_fill(0, 24, 0);
        $dayN  = array_fill(0, 7, 0);
        $dayOk = array_fill(0, 7, 0);

        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $hr = (int) $r['hr'];
            $wd = (int) $r['wd'];   // 0 = Monday
            $hourN[$hr]  += (int) $r['n'];
            $hourOk[$hr] += (int) $r['ok'];
            $dayN[$wd]   += (int) $r['n'];
            $dayOk[$wd]  += (int) $r['ok'];
        }

        $acc = fn($ok, $n) => $n > 0 ? round(($ok / $n) * 100, 1) : null;

        $hourLabels = $hourAcc = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < 24; $i++) {
            $hourLabels[] = (($i % 12) === 0 ? 12 : $i % 12) . ($i < 12 ? 'a' : 'p');
            $hourAcc[]    = $acc($hourOk[$i], $hourN[$i]);
        }
        $dayAcc = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < 7; $i++) {
            $dayAcc[] = $acc($dayOk[$i], $dayN[$i]);
        }

        $dayNames   = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
        $minSample  = 20;

        // Index with the most reviews, or the best accuracy among buckets with enough reviews.
        $pick = function (array $n, array $ok, bool $byAccuracy) use ($minSample): ?int {
            $best = null;
            $bestVal = -1;
            foreach ($n as $i => $cnt) {
                if ($byAccuracy) {
                    if ($cnt < $minSample) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $val = $ok[$i] / $cnt;
                } else {
                    if ($cnt === 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $val = $cnt;
                }
                if ($val > $bestVal) {
                    $bestVal = $val;
                    $best    = $i;
                }
            }
            return $best;
        };

        $hourName = fn(int $h) => date('g A', mktime($h, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2000));

        $bh = $pick($hourN, $hourOk, false);
        $ah = $pick($hourN, $hourOk, true);
        $bd = $pick($dayN, $dayOk, false);
        $ad = $pick($dayN, $dayOk, true);

        return [
            'hasData'  => array_sum($hourN) > 0,
            'hours'    => ['labels' => $hourLabels, 'reviews' => $hourN, 'accuracy' => $hourAcc],
            'days'     => ['labels' => ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'], 'reviews' => $dayN, 'accuracy' => $dayAcc],
            'insights' => [
                'busiestHour'  => $bh === null ? null : ['label' => $hourName($bh), 'value' => number_format($hourN[$bh]) . ' reviews'],
                'accurateHour' => $ah === null ? null : ['label' => $hourName($ah), 'value' => $acc($hourOk[$ah], $hourN[$ah]) . '%'],
                'busiestDay'   => $bd === null ? null : ['label' => $dayNames[$bd], 'value' => number_format($dayN[$bd]) . ' reviews'],
                'accurateDay'  => $ad === null ? null : ['label' => $dayNames[$ad], 'value' => $acc($dayOk[$ad], $dayN[$ad]) . '%'],
            ],
            'minSample' => $minSample,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * One row per session in the period, newest first (latest 100) plus the total count.
     */
    private static function getSessionHistory(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::sessionScope($userId, $f);

        $count = self::fetchAll(
            $conn,
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM review_sessions s JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id WHERE $where",
            $types,
            $params
        );
        $total = (int) ($count[0]['c'] ?? 0);

        $sql = "SELECT s.id, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.total_reviewed, s.remembered_count,
                       d.title AS deck_title, d.deleted_at AS deck_deleted
                FROM review_sessions s
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = s.deck_id
                WHERE $where
                ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC
                LIMIT 100";

        $rows = [];
        foreach (self::fetchAll($conn, $sql, $types, $params) as $r) {
            $reviewed   = (int) $r['total_reviewed'];
            $remembered = (int) $r['remembered_count'];
            $done       = $r['ended_at'] !== null;

            $rows[] = [
                'id'         => (int) $r['id'],
                'startedAt'  => $r['started_at'],
                'completed'  => $done,
                'seconds'    => $done ? max(0, strtotime($r['ended_at']) - strtotime($r['started_at'])) : 0,
                'reviewed'   => $reviewed,
                'remembered' => $remembered,
                'accuracy'   => $reviewed > 0 ? round(($remembered / $reviewed) * 100, 1) : null,
                'deck'       => $r['deck_title'],
                'archived'   => $r['deck_deleted'] !== null,
            ];
        }

        return ['total' => $total, 'rows' => $rows];
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  HELPERS                                                            */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    public static function formatDuration(int $seconds): string
    {
        if ($seconds < 60) {
            return $seconds . 's';
        }
        $h = intdiv($seconds, 3600);
        $m = intdiv($seconds % 3600, 60);

        return $h > 0 ? "{$h}h {$m}m" : "{$m}m";
    }

    public static function h($value): string
    {
        return htmlspecialchars((string) $value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }

    /**
     * Shared WHERE clause for review_sessions s (joined to decks d).
     * Returns [sql, bindTypes, bindParams].
     */
    public static function sessionScope(int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        $sql    = "s.user_id = ? AND s.started_at >= ? AND s.started_at < ?";
        $types  = 'iss';
        $params = [$userId, $f['fromDt'], $f['toExclusive']];

        if ($f['deckId'] > 0) {
            $sql    .= " AND s.deck_id = ?";
            $types  .= 'i';
            $params[] = $f['deckId'];
        }
        if (!$f['includeArchived']) {
            $sql .= " AND d.deleted_at IS NULL";
        }

        return [$sql, $types, $params];
    }

        /**
     * WHERE for flashcards f (joined to decks d): current state, active cards only.
     */
    public static function cardScope(int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        $sql    = "d.user_id = ? AND f.deleted_at IS NULL";
        $types  = 'i';
        $params = [$userId];

        if ($f['deckId'] > 0) {
            $sql    .= " AND d.id = ?";
            $types  .= 'i';
            $params[] = $f['deckId'];
        }
        if (!$f['includeArchived']) {
            $sql .= " AND d.deleted_at IS NULL";
        }

        return [$sql, $types, $params];
    }

    /**
     * WHERE for review_logs l joined to review_sessions s and decks d (the session's deck).
     * Scoped to the user through the session; period applies to reviewed_at.
     */
    public static function logScope(int $userId, array $f): array
    {
        $sql    = "s.user_id = ? AND l.reviewed_at >= ? AND l.reviewed_at < ?";
        $types  = 'iss';
        $params = [$userId, $f['fromDt'], $f['toExclusive']];

        if ($f['deckId'] > 0) {
            $sql    .= " AND s.deck_id = ?";
            $types  .= 'i';
            $params[] = $f['deckId'];
        }
        if (!$f['includeArchived']) {
            $sql .= " AND d.deleted_at IS NULL";
        }

        return [$sql, $types, $params];
    }

    private static function parseDate(string $value): ?DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $d = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value);

        return ($d !== false && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $value) ? $d : null;
    }

    private static function firstSessionDate(mysqli $conn, int $userId): ?DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $rows = self::fetchAll($conn, "SELECT MIN(DATE(started_at)) AS first_day FROM review_sessions WHERE user_id = ?", 'i', [$userId]);
        $first = $rows[0]['first_day'] ?? null;

        return $first !== null ? self::parseDate((string) $first) : null;
    }

    private static function fetchDeckOwned(mysqli $conn, int $userId, int $deckId): ?array
    {
        $rows = self::fetchAll($conn, "SELECT id, title, deleted_at FROM decks WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", 'ii', [$deckId, $userId]);

        return $rows[0] ?? null;
    }

    private static function fetchAll(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types, array $params): array
    {
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return [];
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
        $rows   = $result ? mysqli_fetch_all($result, MYSQLI_ASSOC) : [];
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

        return $rows;
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * ReviewHubService
 *
 * Read-only data + formatting helpers for the Review Hub page (review.php, no deck_id).
 * All "seconds" values are computed in SQL (TIMESTAMPDIFF) so PHP/MySQL timezone
 * differences cannot skew them.
 *
 * Place next to FlashcardService.php (the api/ folder).
 */
class ReviewHubService
{
    /** Cards scheduled within this many days count as "upcoming". */
    public const UPCOMING_DAYS = 2;

    /**
     * Schema-derived card buckets used by the Due Now table.
     *
     * The schema has no explicit learning/young/mastered state column, so these
     * buckets are inferred from review_count and interval_days:
     * - new: never reviewed
     * - learning: reviewed and interval_days <= 1
     * - young: interval_days 2..20
     * - mastered: interval_days >= 21
     *
     * Adjust these thresholds if the application defines different SRS rules.
     */
    public const YOUNG_MAX_INTERVAL_DAYS = 20;
    public const MASTERED_MIN_INTERVAL_DAYS = 21;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Queries
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Every non-archived deck that has cards due now or coming up soon.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{
     *   id:int, title:string, totalCards:int, dueCount:int, upcomingCount:int,
     *   newDueCount:int, learningDueCount:int, youngDueCount:int, masteredDueCount:int,
     *   overdueSeconds:?int, nextDueSeconds:?int
     * }>
     */
    public static function getHubDecks(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $days = (int) self::UPCOMING_DAYS;
        $youngMax = (int) self::YOUNG_MAX_INTERVAL_DAYS;
        $masteredMin = (int) self::MASTERED_MIN_INTERVAL_DAYS;

        $sql = "SELECT d.id, d.title,
                       COUNT(f.id) AS total_cards,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at <= NOW()), 0) AS due_count,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at <= NOW() AND f.review_count = 0), 0) AS new_due_count,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at <= NOW()
                                    AND f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days <= 1), 0) AS learning_due_count,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at <= NOW()
                                    AND f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days BETWEEN 2 AND $youngMax), 0) AS young_due_count,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at <= NOW()
                                    AND f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days >= $masteredMin), 0) AS mastered_due_count,
                       COALESCE(SUM(f.next_review_at > NOW()
                                    AND f.next_review_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL $days DAY)), 0) AS upcoming_count,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,
                           MIN(CASE WHEN f.next_review_at <= NOW() THEN f.next_review_at END),
                           NOW()) AS overdue_seconds,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(),
                           MIN(CASE WHEN f.next_review_at > NOW()
                                     AND f.next_review_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL $days DAY)
                                    THEN f.next_review_at END)) AS next_due_seconds
                FROM decks d
                LEFT JOIN flashcards f ON f.deck_id = d.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
                GROUP BY d.id, d.title
                HAVING due_count > 0 OR upcoming_count > 0";

        $decks = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $decks[] = [
                    'id'             => (int) $row['id'],
                    'title'          => (string) $row['title'],
                    'totalCards'     => (int) $row['total_cards'],
                    'dueCount'       => (int) $row['due_count'],
                    'newDueCount'    => (int) $row['new_due_count'],
                    'learningDueCount' => (int) $row['learning_due_count'],
                    'youngDueCount'  => (int) $row['young_due_count'],
                    'masteredDueCount' => (int) $row['mastered_due_count'],
                    'upcomingCount'  => (int) $row['upcoming_count'],
                    'overdueSeconds' => $row['overdue_seconds'] === null ? null : (int) $row['overdue_seconds'],
                    'nextDueSeconds' => $row['next_due_seconds'] === null ? null : (int) $row['next_due_seconds'],
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $decks;
    }

    /**
     * Decks that have at least one active card, for the Random Practice picker.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{id:int, title:string, activeCount:int}>
     */
    public static function getPracticeDecks(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT d.id, d.title, COUNT(f.id) AS active_count
                FROM decks d
                JOIN flashcards f ON f.deck_id = d.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
                GROUP BY d.id, d.title
                HAVING active_count > 0
                ORDER BY d.title ASC";

        $decks = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $decks[] = [
                    'id'          => (int) $row['id'],
                    'title'       => (string) $row['title'],
                    'activeCount' => (int) $row['active_count'],
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $decks;
    }

    /**
     * Seconds until the user's next card becomes due (no 48h limit), or null
     * when there are no scheduled cards at all.
     */
    public static function getNextDueSeconds(mysqli $conn, int $userId): ?int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), MIN(f.next_review_at))
                FROM flashcards f
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
                WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.next_review_at > NOW()";

        $secs = null;
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $secs);
            mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $secs === null ? null : (int) $secs;
    }

    /**
     * Latest completed sessions: scheduled reviews plus Random Practice
     * (stored separately in random_practice_sessions).
     *
     * @return array<int, array{
     *   sessionType:string, sessionLabel:string, sessionID:int, deckId:int,
     *   deckTitle:string, cardsReviewed:int, rememberedCount:int,
     *   accuracy:int, durationSeconds:?int, formattedTime:string
     * }>
     */
    public static function getRecentSessions(mysqli $conn, int $userId, int $limit = 8): array
    {
        $limit = max(1, min($limit, 50));

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM (
                    SELECT 'srs' AS session_type, 'Review' AS session_label,
                           rs.id AS session_id, rs.deck_id, d.title AS deck_title,
                           rs.total_reviewed AS cards, rs.remembered_count,
                           rs.accuracy_percentage AS accuracy,
                           TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, rs.ended_at) AS duration_seconds,
                           rs.ended_at,
                           TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.ended_at, NOW()) AS ended_ago_seconds
                    FROM review_sessions rs
                    JOIN decks d ON d.id = rs.deck_id
                    WHERE rs.user_id = ? AND rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT 'random', rp.label,
                           rp.id, rp.deck_id, d.title,
                           rp.total_rated, rp.remembered_count,
                           rp.accuracy_percentage,
                           rp.duration_seconds,
                           rp.ended_at,
                           TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rp.ended_at, NOW())
                    FROM random_practice_sessions rp
                    JOIN decks d ON d.id = rp.deck_id
                    WHERE rp.user_id = ?
                ) t
                ORDER BY ended_at DESC, session_id DESC
                LIMIT ?";

        $sessions = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "iii", $userId, $userId, $limit);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $sessions[] = [
                    'sessionType'     => (string) $row['session_type'],
                    'sessionLabel'    => (string) $row['session_label'],
                    'sessionID'       => (int) $row['session_id'],
                    'deckId'          => (int) $row['deck_id'],
                    'deckTitle'       => (string) $row['deck_title'],
                    'cardsReviewed'   => (int) $row['cards'],
                    'rememberedCount' => (int) $row['remembered_count'],
                    'accuracy'        => (int) $row['accuracy'],
                    'durationSeconds' => $row['duration_seconds'] === null ? null : (int) $row['duration_seconds'],
                    'formattedTime'   => self::formatAgo((int) $row['ended_ago_seconds']),
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $sessions;
    }

    /**
     * Cards reviewed today and the current study-day streak.
     * Same rules as the dashboard: a day counts when a completed session
     * reviewed at least one card; the streak is alive if the latest study day
     * is today or yesterday.
     *
     * @return array{reviewedToday:int, currentStreak:int}
     */
    public static function getStreakInfo(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT DATE(started_at) AS study_date, SUM(total_reviewed) AS reviewed
                FROM review_sessions
                WHERE user_id = ? AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY DATE(started_at)
                HAVING SUM(total_reviewed) > 0
                ORDER BY study_date DESC";

        $days = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $days[$row['study_date']] = (int) $row['reviewed'];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }

        $today     = date('Y-m-d');
        $yesterday = date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-1 day'));

        $streak = 0;
        if (isset($days[$today]) || isset($days[$yesterday])) {
            $cursor = new DateTime(isset($days[$today]) ? $today : $yesterday);
            while (isset($days[$cursor->format('Y-m-d')])) {
                $streak++;
                $cursor->modify('-1 day');
            }
        }

        return [
            'reviewedToday' => $days[$today] ?? 0,
            'currentStreak' => $streak,
        ];
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Table helpers (pure PHP, no DB)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Decks with cards due, most due first (oldest overdue breaks ties). */
    public static function dueDecks(array $hubDecks): array
    {
        $due = array_values(array_filter($hubDecks, fn($d) => $d['dueCount'] > 0));
        usort($due, function ($a, $b) {
            return [$b['dueCount'], $b['overdueSeconds'] ?? 0]
               <=> [$a['dueCount'], $a['overdueSeconds'] ?? 0];
        });
        return $due;
    }

    /** Decks with cards coming up soon, soonest first. */
    public static function upcomingDecks(array $hubDecks): array
    {
        $up = array_values(array_filter($hubDecks, fn($d) => $d['upcomingCount'] > 0));
        usort($up, fn($a, $b) => ($a['nextDueSeconds'] ?? PHP_INT_MAX) <=> ($b['nextDueSeconds'] ?? PHP_INT_MAX));
        return $up;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Formatting
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** "5 min", "3 h", "2 d" (never shows 0). */
    public static function formatSpan(int $seconds): string
    {
        $seconds = max(0, $seconds);
        if ($seconds < 3600)  return max(1, (int) floor($seconds / 60)) . ' min';
        if ($seconds < 86400) return (int) floor($seconds / 3600) . ' h';
        return (int) floor($seconds / 86400) . ' d';
    }

    /** "just now", "5 mins ago", "1 hour ago", "3 days ago". */
    public static function formatAgo(int $seconds): string
    {
        $seconds = max(0, $seconds);
        if ($seconds < 60) return 'just now';

        if ($seconds < 3600) {
            $n = (int) floor($seconds / 60);
            return $n . ($n === 1 ? ' min ago' : ' mins ago');
        }
        if ($seconds < 86400) {
            $n = (int) floor($seconds / 3600);
            return $n . ($n === 1 ? ' hour ago' : ' hours ago');
        }
        $n = (int) floor($seconds / 86400);
        return $n . ($n === 1 ? ' day ago' : ' days ago');
    }

    /** "45s", "4m 12s", "1h 5m", or an em dash when unknown. */
    public static function formatDuration(?int $seconds): string
    {
        if ($seconds === null || $seconds <= 0) return '—';
        if ($seconds < 60) return $seconds . 's';
        if ($seconds < 3600) {
            $m = (int) floor($seconds / 60);
            $s = $seconds % 60;
            return $s > 0 ? "{$m}m {$s}s" : "{$m}m";
        }
        $h = (int) floor($seconds / 3600);
        $m = (int) floor(($seconds % 3600) / 60);
        return $m > 0 ? "{$h}h {$m}m" : "{$h}h";
    }

    /** Tailwind classes for an accuracy badge (matches the deck grid thresholds). */
    public static function accuracyBadgeClass(int $accuracy): string
    {
        if ($accuracy >= 80) return 'text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200/80';
        if ($accuracy >= 50) return 'text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200/80';
        return 'text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200/80';
    }

    /** Shorthand for htmlspecialchars with the project's flags. */
    public static function h($value): string
    {
        return htmlspecialchars((string) $value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }
}

<?php
session_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

// Make every failed query throw, no matter how config/db.php set things up.
// Without this, a failed INSERT INTO review_logs is silently ignored.
mysqli_report(MYSQLI_REPORT_ERROR | MYSQLI_REPORT_STRICT);

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    http_response_code(405);

if (!isset($_SESSION['logged_in']) || $_SESSION['logged_in'] !== true || !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {

}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';
mysqli_report(MYSQLI_REPORT_ERROR | MYSQLI_REPORT_STRICT); // db.php may have switched it off

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
$input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);

if (!is_array($input)) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request.']);

if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token']) || !is_string($token) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $token)) {
    http_response_code(403);

/**
 * Load the user's SRS settings, falling back to the same defaults
 * used by settings-actions.php / the user_settings table.
 */
function loadSrsSettings(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array {
    $defaults = [
        'remember_multiplier'   => 2.00,
        'forgot_multiplier'     => 0.50,
        'initial_interval_days' => 1,
        'maximum_interval_days' => 365,
    ];

    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT remember_multiplier, forgot_multiplier,
                                          initial_interval_days, maximum_interval_days
                                   FROM user_settings WHERE user_id = ?");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $remember, $forgot, $initial, $maximum);

    if (!mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt)) {
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $defaults;
    }
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    $initial = max(1, (int) $initial);
    return [
        'remember_multiplier'   => (float) $remember,
        'forgot_multiplier'     => (float) $forgot,
        'initial_interval_days' => $initial,
        'maximum_interval_days' => max($initial, (int) $maximum),
    ];
}

$deckId = filter_var($input['deck_id'] ?? null, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
$results = $input['results'] ?? null;
$durationSeconds = filter_var($input['duration_seconds'] ?? 0, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
$durationSeconds = ($durationSeconds === false) ? 0 : max(0, min($durationSeconds, 6 * 3600));

if (!$deckId || $deckId < 1 || !is_array($results) || empty($results)) {
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'saved' => 0, 'msg' => 'No data to save or invalid deck.']);
    exit;
}
if (count($results) > 1000) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Batch size limited to 1000.']);
    exit;
}

try {
    // Verify ownership
    $ownStmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT id FROM decks WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($ownStmt, "ii", $deckId, $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($ownStmt);
    mysqli_stmt_store_result($ownStmt);
    $ownsDeck = mysqli_stmt_num_rows($ownStmt) === 1;
    mysqli_stmt_close($ownStmt);

    if (!$ownsDeck) {
        http_response_code(404);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Deck not found or access denied.']);
        exit;
    }

    $settings = loadSrsSettings($conn, $userId);
    $rememberMult = $settings['remember_multiplier'];
    $forgotMult   = $settings['forgot_multiplier'];
    $minInterval  = $settings['initial_interval_days'];
    $maxInterval  = $settings['maximum_interval_days'];

    // 1. Sanitize IDs
    $requested = [];
    foreach ($results as $cardId => $status) {
        $cid = filter_var($cardId, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        if ($cid && ($status === 'remembered' || $status === 'forgotten')) {
            $requested[$cid] = $status;
        }
    }
    if (empty($requested)) {
        echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'saved' => 0, 'msg' => 'No valid cards to save.']);
        exit;
    }

    // 2. Keep only cards that really belong to this deck (and fetch their intervals)
    $idString = implode(',', array_map('intval', array_keys($requested)));
    $cardData = [];
    $res = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT id, interval_days FROM flashcards
                                WHERE id IN ($idString) AND deck_id = " . (int) $deckId . " AND deleted_at IS NULL");
    while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res)) {
        $cardData[(int) $row['id']] = (int) $row['interval_days'];
    }

    $toSave = array_intersect_key($requested, $cardData);
    if (empty($toSave)) {
        echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'saved' => 0, 'msg' => 'No matching cards found in this deck.']);
        exit;
    }

    // Totals come from what will actually be saved (not from what the browser sent)
    $savedCount      = count($toSave);
    $rememberedCount = count(array_filter($toSave, fn($s) => $s === 'remembered'));
    $accuracy        = (int) round(($rememberedCount / $savedCount) * 100);

    mysqli_begin_transaction($conn);

    // 3. Insert session record
    $sessStmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "INSERT INTO review_sessions
        (user_id, deck_id, total_reviewed, remembered_count, started_at, ended_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? SECOND), NOW())");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($sessStmt, "iiiii", $userId, $deckId, $savedCount, $rememberedCount, $durationSeconds);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($sessStmt);
    $sessionId = mysqli_insert_id($conn);
    mysqli_stmt_close($sessStmt);

    // 4. Update each card + write its log row
    $stmtCard = mysqli_prepare($conn, "UPDATE flashcards
        SET review_count = review_count + 1, lapses = lapses + ?, interval_days = ?,
            next_review_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY), updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = ? AND deck_id = ?");

    $stmtLog = mysqli_prepare($conn, "INSERT INTO review_logs
        (session_id, card_id, rating, previous_interval, new_interval)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");

    foreach ($toSave as $cid => $status) {
        $prevInterval = $cardData[$cid];
        $isLapse      = ($status === 'forgotten') ? 1 : 0;

        $multiplier  = ($status === 'remembered') ? $rememberMult : $forgotMult;
        $newInterval = (int) round($prevInterval * $multiplier);

        // Never below the initial interval, never above the maximum.
        $newInterval = max($minInterval, min($maxInterval, $newInterval));

        // The review_logs.rating ENUM is ('remembered', 'forgot'), NOT 'forgotten'
        $dbRating = ($status === 'remembered') ? 'remembered' : 'forgot';
        
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmtCard, "iiiii", $isLapse, $newInterval, $newInterval, $cid, $deckId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmtCard);

        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmtLog, "iisii", $sessionId, $cid, $dbRating, $prevInterval, $newInterval);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmtLog);
    }

    mysqli_stmt_close($stmtCard);
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmtLog);

    mysqli_commit($conn);
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'saved' => $savedCount, 'session_id' => $sessionId]);

} catch (Throwable $e) {
    // Only roll back if a transaction was started; harmless otherwise
    try { mysqli_rollback($conn); } catch (Throwable $ignored) {}
    error_log('save-session.php error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Database exception occurred']);
}

<?php
class SessionService
{
    /**
     * Get metadata for a specific session.
     */
    public static function getSessionDetails(mysqli $conn, int $sessionId, int $userId): ?array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT rs.*, d.title AS deck_title,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, rs.ended_at) AS duration_seconds
                FROM review_sessions rs
                JOIN decks d ON rs.deck_id = d.id
                WHERE rs.id = ? AND rs.user_id = ?";

        $session = null;
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "ii", $sessionId, $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            if ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $session = [
                    'id'               => (int) $row['id'],
                    'deckId'           => (int) $row['deck_id'],
                    'deckTitle'        => (string) $row['deck_title'],
                    'startedAt'        => $row['started_at'],
                    'totalReviewed'    => (int) $row['total_reviewed'],
                    'rememberedCount'  => (int) $row['remembered_count'],
                    // int, because ReviewHubService::accuracyBadgeClass() expects an int
                    'accuracy'         => (int) round((float) $row['accuracy_percentage']),
                    'durationSeconds'  => $row['duration_seconds'] === null ? null : (int) $row['duration_seconds'],
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $session;
    }

    /**
     * Get the individual card logs for a session.
     */
    public static function getSessionLogs(mysqli $conn, int $sessionId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT rl.rating, rl.previous_interval, rl.new_interval, rl.reviewed_at,
                       f.front, f.back, f.next_review_at, f.deleted_at,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), f.next_review_at) AS next_due_seconds
                FROM review_logs rl
                LEFT JOIN flashcards f ON rl.card_id = f.id
                WHERE rl.session_id = ?
                ORDER BY rl.reviewed_at ASC";

        $logs = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $sessionId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $logs[] = [
                    'front'             => (string) $row['front'],
                    'back'              => (string) $row['back'],
                    'rating'            => (string) $row['rating'],
                    'previousInterval'  => (int) $row['previous_interval'],
                    'newInterval'       => (int) $row['new_interval'],
                    'nextDueSeconds'    => $row['next_due_seconds'] !== null ? (int) $row['next_due_seconds'] : null,
                    'isDeleted'         => $row['deleted_at'] !== null
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $logs;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Session History (list page)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Shared WHERE clause for the history list and its count.
     *
     * Supported filters (all optional):
     *   q           deck title contains this text
     *   from / to   Y-m-d, inclusive, matched against the session start date
     *   minAccuracy 0-100, sessions at or above this accuracy
     *
     * @return array{0:string,1:string,2:array}  [where sql, bind types, bind values]
     */
    private static function historyWhere(int $userId, array $filters): array
    {
        $where  = "rs.user_id = ? AND rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL";
        $types  = "i";
        $params = [$userId];

        $q = trim((string) ($filters['q'] ?? ''));
        if ($q !== '') {
            $where   .= " AND d.title LIKE ?";
            $types   .= "s";
            $params[] = '%' . addcslashes($q, '%_\\') . '%';
        }

        $from = (string) ($filters['from'] ?? '');
        if ($from !== '' && strtotime($from) !== false) {
            $where   .= " AND rs.started_at >= ?";
            $types   .= "s";
            $params[] = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($from)) . ' 00:00:00';
        }

        $to = (string) ($filters['to'] ?? '');
        if ($to !== '' && strtotime($to) !== false) {
            $where   .= " AND rs.started_at < ?";
            $types   .= "s";
            $params[] = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($to . ' +1 day')) . ' 00:00:00';
        }

        $minAccuracy = (int) ($filters['minAccuracy'] ?? 0);
        if ($minAccuracy > 0) {
            $where   .= " AND rs.accuracy_percentage >= ?";
            $types   .= "i";
            $params[] = min($minAccuracy, 100);
        }

        return [$where, $types, $params];
    }

    /**
     * Number of completed sessions for a user (used for pagination).
     * Uses the same "completed" rule as the Review Hub (ended_at IS NOT NULL).
     * Joins decks so the count always matches the rows getSessionHistory() can return.
     */
    public static function countCompletedSessions(mysqli $conn, int $userId, array $filters = []): int
    {
        [$where, $types, $params] = self::historyWhere($userId, $filters);

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM review_sessions rs
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = rs.deck_id
                WHERE $where";

        $total = 0;
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $total);
            mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return (int) $total;
    }

    /**
     * One page of completed sessions, newest first.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{
     *   id:int, deckId:int, deckTitle:string, startedAt:string,
     *   totalReviewed:int, rememberedCount:int, accuracy:int, durationSeconds:?int
     * }>
     */
    public static function getSessionHistory(mysqli $conn, int $userId, int $limit = 15, int $offset = 0, array $filters = []): array
    {
        $limit  = max(1, min($limit, 100));
        $offset = max(0, $offset);

        [$where, $types, $params] = self::historyWhere($userId, $filters);
        $types   .= "ii";
        $params[] = $limit;
        $params[] = $offset;

        $sql = "SELECT rs.id, rs.deck_id, d.title AS deck_title, rs.started_at,
                       rs.total_reviewed, rs.remembered_count, rs.accuracy_percentage,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, rs.ended_at) AS duration_seconds
                FROM review_sessions rs
                JOIN decks d ON d.id = rs.deck_id
                WHERE $where
                ORDER BY rs.ended_at DESC, rs.id DESC
                LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";

        $sessions = [];
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
                $sessions[] = [
                    'id'              => (int) $row['id'],
                    'deckId'          => (int) $row['deck_id'],
                    'deckTitle'       => (string) $row['deck_title'],
                    'startedAt'       => (string) $row['started_at'],
                    'totalReviewed'   => (int) $row['total_reviewed'],
                    'rememberedCount' => (int) $row['remembered_count'],
                    'accuracy'        => (int) round((float) $row['accuracy_percentage']),
                    'durationSeconds' => $row['duration_seconds'] === null ? null : (int) $row['duration_seconds'],
                ];
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        return $sessions;
    }
}

<?php
session_start();

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

if (
    ($_SESSION['logged_in'] ?? false) !== true ||
    !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])
) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Please log in again.']);
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];

function respond(int $status, array $data): void {
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($data);
    exit;
}

function getSettings(mysqli $conn, int $userId): array {
    $sql = "SELECT remember_multiplier, forgot_multiplier,
                   initial_interval_days, maximum_interval_days
            FROM user_settings WHERE user_id = ?";

    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_result(
        $stmt, $remember, $forgot, $initial, $maximum
    );

    if (!mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt)) {
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

        return [
            'remember_multiplier' => 2.00,
            'forgot_multiplier' => 0.50,
            'initial_interval_days' => 1,
            'maximum_interval_days' => 365
        ];
    }

    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

    return [
        'remember_multiplier' => (float) $remember,
        'forgot_multiplier' => (float) $forgot,
        'initial_interval_days' => (int) $initial,
        'maximum_interval_days' => (int) $maximum
    ];
}

if ($method === 'GET') {
    respond(200, [
        'success' => true,
        'settings' => getSettings($conn, $userId)
    ]);
}

if ($method !== 'POST') {
    header('Allow: GET, POST');
    respond(405, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Method not allowed.']);
}

if (
    !isset($_SESSION['settings_csrf']) ||
    !hash_equals(
        $_SESSION['settings_csrf'],
        $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ''
    )
) {
    respond(403, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Security token invalid. Refresh the page and try again.']);
}

$data = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);

if (!is_array($data)) {
    respond(400, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid request data.']);
}

$required = [
    'remember_multiplier',
    'forgot_multiplier',
    'initial_interval_days',
    'maximum_interval_days'
];

foreach ($required as $key) {
    if (!isset($data[$key]) || !is_numeric($data[$key])) {
        respond(422, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Enter valid values for all settings.']);
    }
}

$remember = (float) $data['remember_multiplier'];
$forgot = (float) $data['forgot_multiplier'];
$initial = filter_var($data['initial_interval_days'], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
$maximum = filter_var($data['maximum_interval_days'], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);

if (
    !is_finite($remember) || !is_finite($forgot) ||
    $remember < 0.01 || $remember > 10 ||
    $forgot < 0.01 || $forgot > 10 ||
    $initial === false || $maximum === false ||
    $initial < 1 || $maximum < $initial || $maximum > 36500
) {
    respond(422, [
        'success' => false,
        'message' => 'Check the multipliers and interval limits.'
    ]);
}

$sql = "INSERT INTO user_settings
            (user_id, remember_multiplier, forgot_multiplier,
             initial_interval_days, maximum_interval_days)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
            remember_multiplier = VALUES(remember_multiplier),
            forgot_multiplier = VALUES(forgot_multiplier),
            initial_interval_days = VALUES(initial_interval_days),
            maximum_interval_days = VALUES(maximum_interval_days)";

$stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
mysqli_stmt_bind_param(
    $stmt, 'iddii', $userId, $remember, $forgot, $initial, $maximum
);

if (!mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    respond(500, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Unable to save settings.']);
}

mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

respond(200, [
    'success' => true,
    'message' => 'Learning settings saved.',
    'settings' => getSettings($conn, $userId)
]);
