<script>
    window.MemPulseHeaderSearchData = {
        baseUrl: <?= json_encode(BASE_URL) ?>,
        decks: <?= json_encode($headerSearchDecks, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>,
        cards: <?= json_encode($headerSearchCards, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>
    };

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const sidebar = document.querySelector("#sidebar");
        const mainContent = document.querySelector("main");
        const toggleBtn = document.querySelector("#sidebar-toggle");
        
        // Mobile elements (Trigger inside Header)
        const floatingToggleBtn = document.querySelector("#floating-mobile-toggle");
        const mobileToggleIcon = document.querySelector("#mobile-toggle-icon");
        const mobileOverlay = document.querySelector("#mobile-sidebar-overlay");
        const reviewDot = document.querySelector("#review-dot");

        if (!sidebar) return;

        // Body-level fixed tooltip for collapsed desktop sidebar
        let floatingTooltip = document.getElementById("sidebar-floating-tooltip");
        if (!floatingTooltip) {
            floatingTooltip = document.createElement("div");
            floatingTooltip.id = "sidebar-floating-tooltip";
            floatingTooltip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
            document.body.appendChild(floatingTooltip);
        }

        let tooltipTarget = null;
        function hideSidebarTooltip() {
            floatingTooltip.classList.remove("is-visible");
            tooltipTarget = null;
        }
        function showSidebarTooltip(target) {
            const label = target.getAttribute("data-tooltip") || target.getAttribute("aria-label");
            if (!label || !sidebar.classList.contains("collapsed") || window.innerWidth < 768) {
                hideSidebarTooltip();
                return;
            }
            tooltipTarget = target;
            floatingTooltip.textContent = label;
            floatingTooltip.style.left = "0px";
            floatingTooltip.style.top = "0px";
            floatingTooltip.classList.add("is-visible");
            const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
            const tipRect = floatingTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
            const gap = 12;
            let left = rect.right + gap;
            if (left + tipRect.width > window.innerWidth - 8) {
                left = Math.max(8, rect.left - tipRect.width - gap);
                floatingTooltip.classList.add("tooltip-left");
            } else {
                floatingTooltip.classList.remove("tooltip-left");
            }
            const top = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 8, Math.max(8, rect.top + rect.height / 2));
            floatingTooltip.style.left = `${left}px`;
            floatingTooltip.style.top = `${top}px`;
        }

        sidebar.querySelectorAll(".sidebar-tooltip").forEach((item) => {
            item.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showSidebarTooltip(item));
            item.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideSidebarTooltip);
            item.addEventListener("focus", () => showSidebarTooltip(item));
            item.addEventListener("blur", hideSidebarTooltip);
        });
        sidebar.addEventListener("scroll", hideSidebarTooltip, true);
        window.addEventListener("resize", hideSidebarTooltip);
        window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
            if (tooltipTarget) showSidebarTooltip(tooltipTarget);
        }, true);

        const toggleIcon = toggleBtn ? toggleBtn.querySelector(".material-symbols-outlined") : null;

        // Apply visual collapsed state on desktop
        const sidebarCollapsed = localStorage.getItem("sidebarCollapsed") === "true";
        if (sidebarCollapsed && window.innerWidth >= 768) {
            sidebar.classList.add("collapsed");
            if (mainContent) mainContent.classList.add("collapsed");
            if (toggleIcon) toggleIcon.textContent = "left_panel_open";
            if (reviewDot) reviewDot.classList.remove("hidden");
        }

        // Desktop Border Toggle Interaction
        if (toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
                const isCollapsed = sidebar.classList.toggle("collapsed");
                
                document.documentElement.classList.toggle(
                    "sidebar-collapsed",
                    isCollapsed
                );
                
                hideSidebarTooltip();
                if (mainContent) {
                    mainContent.classList.toggle("collapsed", isCollapsed);
                }
                if (toggleIcon) {
                    toggleIcon.textContent = isCollapsed ? "left_panel_open" : "left_panel_close";
                }
                if (reviewDot) {
                    isCollapsed ? reviewDot.classList.remove("hidden") : reviewDot.classList.add("hidden");
                }
                localStorage.setItem("sidebarCollapsed", isCollapsed);
            });
        }

        // Mobile Sidebar Drawer Toggle (Inside Header)
        function isMobileSidebarOpen() {
            return !sidebar.classList.contains("-translate-x-full");
        }

        function openMobileSidebar() {
            sidebar.classList.remove("-translate-x-full", "collapsed");
            mobileOverlay.classList.remove("hidden");
            if (floatingToggleBtn) floatingToggleBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
            if (mobileToggleIcon) mobileToggleIcon.textContent = "close";
            setTimeout(() => mobileOverlay.classList.remove("opacity-0"), 10);
        }

        function closeMobileSidebar() {
            sidebar.classList.add("-translate-x-full");
            mobileOverlay.classList.add("opacity-0");
            if (floatingToggleBtn) floatingToggleBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            if (mobileToggleIcon) mobileToggleIcon.textContent = "menu";
            setTimeout(() => mobileOverlay.classList.add("hidden"), 300);
        }

        if (floatingToggleBtn) {
            floatingToggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
                if (isMobileSidebarOpen()) {
                    closeMobileSidebar();
                } else {
                    openMobileSidebar();
                }
            });
        }
        if (mobileOverlay) mobileOverlay.addEventListener("click", closeMobileSidebar);

        // --- Header Search Dropdown Logic ---
        const searchContainer = document.getElementById('header-search-container');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('header-search-input');
        const searchClear = document.getElementById('header-search-clear');
        const searchDropdown = document.getElementById('header-search-dropdown');
        const searchResults = document.getElementById('header-search-results');

        const searchData = window.MemPulseHeaderSearchData || { baseUrl: '/mempulse/app/', decks: [], cards: [] };
        const baseUrl = searchData.baseUrl;

        const quickPages = [
            { title: 'Home Dashboard', subtitle: 'Overview & streak metrics', icon: 'home', href: `${baseUrl}views/index.php` },
            { title: 'Decks', subtitle: 'Manage your flashcard collections', icon: 'style', href: `${baseUrl}views/decks.php` },
            { title: 'Create Flashcards', subtitle: 'Add new cards to your decks', icon: 'edit_note', href: `${baseUrl}views/decks.php?add_card=1` },
            { title: 'Review', subtitle: 'Practice due flashcards now', icon: 'pace', href: `${baseUrl}views/review.php` },
            { title: 'Reports', subtitle: 'View accuracy & learning analytics', icon: 'monitoring', href: `${baseUrl}views/reports.php` },
            { title: 'Memory Science', subtitle: 'How spaced repetition works', icon: 'psychology', href: `${baseUrl}views/science.php` },
            { title: 'Account Settings', subtitle: 'Profile, email & security', icon: 'manage_accounts', action: 'account' },
            { title: 'System Settings', subtitle: 'SRS intervals & multipliers', icon: 'settings', action: 'system' }
        ];

        let activeSearchIndex = -1;

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = str ?? '';
            return div.innerHTML;
        }

        function closeSearchDropdown() {
            if (!searchDropdown || !searchInput) return;
            searchDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
            searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            activeSearchIndex = -1;
        }

        function openSearchDropdown() {
            if (!searchDropdown || !searchInput) return;
            renderSearchResults(searchInput.value.trim());
            searchDropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
            searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }

        function resultRow({ href, action, icon, title, meta }) {
            return `
                <a href="${href ? escapeHtml(href) : '#'}" role="option"
                   ${action ? `data-search-settings="${escapeHtml(action)}"` : ''}
                   class="search-result-item flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-low hover:text-on-surface transition-colors">
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] flex-shrink-0">${escapeHtml(icon)}</span>
                    <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 truncate">${escapeHtml(title)}</span>
                    ${meta ? `<span class="text-xs font-normal text-on-surface-variant/80 truncate max-w-[40%] flex-shrink-0">${escapeHtml(meta)}</span>` : ''}
                </a>
            `;
        }

        function resultGroup(label, rows) {
            if (rows.length === 0) return '';
            return `
                <div>
                    <p class="px-4 pt-1.5 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold text-on-surface-variant/70">${escapeHtml(label)}</p>
                    ${rows.join('')}
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderSearchResults(query) {
            if (!searchResults) return;
            const q = query.toLowerCase();
            activeSearchIndex = -1;

            const matchedPages = q === ''
                ? quickPages.slice(0, 5)
                : quickPages.filter(p => p.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.subtitle.toLowerCase().includes(q));

            const matchedDecks = q === ''
                ? (searchData.decks || []).slice(0, 4)
                : (searchData.decks || []).filter(d => (d.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 6);

            const matchedCards = q === ''
                ? []
                : (searchData.cards || []).filter(c =>
                    (c.front || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (c.back || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (c.deckTitle || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
                ).slice(0, 6);

            const groups = [
                resultGroup(q === '' ? 'Quick links' : 'Pages', matchedPages.map(p => resultRow({
                    href: p.href, action: p.action, icon: p.icon, title: p.title
                }))),
                resultGroup('Decks', matchedDecks.map(d => resultRow({
                    href: `${baseUrl}views/deck.php?deck_id=${d.id}&id=${d.id}`,
                    icon: 'style',
                    title: d.title,
                    meta: `${d.count} ${d.count === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards'}`
                }))),
                resultGroup('Flashcards', matchedCards.map(c => resultRow({
                    href: `${baseUrl}views/deck.php?deck_id=${c.deckId}&id=${c.deckId}`,
                    icon: 'quiz',
                    title: c.front,
                    meta: c.deckTitle
                })))
            ].filter(Boolean);

            if (groups.length === 0) {
                searchResults.innerHTML = `
                    <p class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                        No results for "${escapeHtml(query)}"
                    </p>
                `;
                return;
            }

            searchResults.innerHTML = groups.join('<div class="h-px bg-outline-variant/20 my-1"></div>');

            searchResults.querySelectorAll('[data-search-settings]').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    const tab = el.getAttribute('data-search-settings');
                    closeSearchDropdown();
                    openSettingsModal(tab);
                });
            });
        }

        function updateSearchHighlight(items) {
            items.forEach((el, idx) => {
                if (idx === activeSearchIndex) {
                    el.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low');
                    el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
                } else {
                    el.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low');
                }
            });
        }

        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.addEventListener('focus', openSearchDropdown);
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
                const val = searchInput.value;
                searchClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', val.length === 0);
                openSearchDropdown();
            });

            searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (!searchDropdown || searchDropdown.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
                const items = Array.from(searchResults.querySelectorAll('.search-result-item'));
                if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (items.length > 0) {
                        activeSearchIndex = (activeSearchIndex + 1) % items.length;
                        updateSearchHighlight(items);
                    }
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (items.length > 0) {
                        activeSearchIndex = (activeSearchIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
                        updateSearchHighlight(items);
                    }
                } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && activeSearchIndex >= 0 && items[activeSearchIndex]) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    items[activeSearchIndex].click();
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeSearchDropdown();
                    searchInput.blur();
                }
            });
        }

        if (searchClear) {
            searchClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
                searchInput.value = '';
                searchClear.classList.add('hidden');
                searchInput.focus();
                renderSearchResults('');
            });
        }

        // Global CTRL+K / CMD+K shortcut to focus header search
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
                e.preventDefault();
                searchInput?.focus();
                searchInput?.select();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (searchContainer && !searchContainer.contains(e.target)) {
                closeSearchDropdown();
            }
        });

        // --- Sidebar menu (gear icon): Settings + Logout ---
        const sidebarMenuBtn = document.getElementById('sidebar-menu-btn');
        const sidebarMenu = document.getElementById('sidebar-menu');

        function setSidebarMenuOpen(isOpen) {
            if (!sidebarMenu || !sidebarMenuBtn) return;
            if (isOpen) {
                closeSearchDropdown();
                hideSidebarTooltip();
                const rect = sidebarMenuBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
                const railMode = sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed') && window.innerWidth >= 768;
                sidebarMenu.style.left = (railMode ? rect.right + 12 : Math.max(8, rect.left)) + 'px';
                sidebarMenu.style.bottom = (railMode
                    ? Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - rect.bottom)
                    : window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8) + 'px';
            }
            sidebarMenu.classList.toggle('hidden', !isOpen);
            sidebarMenuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
        }

        sidebarMenuBtn?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setSidebarMenuOpen(sidebarMenu?.classList.contains('hidden'));
        });
        sidebarMenu?.addEventListener('click', () => setSidebarMenuOpen(false));
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (sidebarMenu && !sidebarMenu.contains(e.target) && !sidebarMenuBtn?.contains(e.target)) {
                setSidebarMenuOpen(false);
            }
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') setSidebarMenuOpen(false);
        });
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => setSidebarMenuOpen(false));

        // --- Settings Modal Logic ---
        const settingsDialog = document.getElementById('settings-dialog');
        const settingsClose = document.getElementById('settings-close');
        const settingsCancel = document.getElementById('settings-cancel');

        const settingsTabs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-tab]');
        const settingsOpeners = document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-settings]');

        function switchSettingsTab(tabName) {
            document.getElementById('settings-save')?.classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'system');
            settingsTabs.forEach((tab) => {
                const active = tab.dataset.settingsTab === tabName;

                tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
                tab.classList.toggle('border-primary', active);
                tab.classList.toggle('text-primary', active);
                tab.classList.toggle('font-semibold', active);
                tab.classList.toggle('border-transparent', !active);
                tab.classList.toggle('text-on-surface-variant', !active);
                tab.classList.toggle('font-medium', !active);

                const panel = document.getElementById(
                    `settings-panel-${tab.dataset.settingsTab}`
                );

                if (panel) {
                    panel.classList.toggle('hidden', !active);
                }
            });
        }

        const settingsSave = document.getElementById('settings-save');
        const settingsStatus = document.getElementById('settings-status');

        const settingsFields = {
            remember_multiplier: document.getElementById('remember-multiplier'),
            forgot_multiplier: document.getElementById('forgot-multiplier'),
            initial_interval_days: document.getElementById('initial-interval'),
            maximum_interval_days: document.getElementById('maximum-interval')
        };

        const settingsApi = <?= json_encode(BASE_URL . 'api/settings-actions.php') ?>;

        function showSettingsStatus(message, isError = false) {
            if (!settingsStatus) return;

            settingsStatus.textContent = message;
            settingsStatus.classList.toggle('text-error', isError);
            settingsStatus.classList.toggle('text-primary', !isError);
        }

        function displaySettings(settings) {
            Object.entries(settingsFields).forEach(([key, input]) => {
                if (input) input.value = settings[key];
            });
        }

        async function loadSettings() {
            showSettingsStatus('Loading settings...');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(settingsApi, {
                    credentials: 'same-origin'
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                    throw new Error(result.message || 'Could not load settings.');
                }

                displaySettings(result.settings);
                showSettingsStatus('');
            } catch (error) {
                showSettingsStatus(error.message, true);
            }
        }

        async function saveSettings() {
            const payload = {};

            for (const [key, input] of Object.entries(settingsFields)) {
                if (!input || !input.checkValidity()) {
                    input?.reportValidity();
                    return;
                }

                payload[key] = input.value;
            }

            const initialValue = Number(payload.initial_interval_days);
            const maximumValue = Number(payload.maximum_interval_days);
            if (maximumValue < initialValue) {
                settingsFields.maximum_interval_days.setCustomValidity('Maximum interval must be at least the initial interval.');
                settingsFields.maximum_interval_days.reportValidity();
                settingsFields.maximum_interval_days.setCustomValidity('');
                return;
            }

            settingsSave.disabled = true;
            showSettingsStatus('Saving settings...');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(settingsApi, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-Token': settingsDialog.dataset.csrf
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                    throw new Error(result.message || 'Could not save settings.');
                }

                displaySettings(result.settings);
                showSettingsStatus(result.message);
            } catch (error) {
                showSettingsStatus(error.message, true);
            } finally {
                settingsSave.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        settingsSave?.addEventListener('click', saveSettings);

        function openSettingsModal(tabName) {
            switchSettingsTab(tabName);

            if (settingsDialog) {
                if (!settingsDialog.open) {
                    settingsDialog.showModal();
                }
                loadSettings();
            }
        }

        settingsOpeners.forEach((button) => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                openSettingsModal(button.dataset.openSettings);
            });
        });

        settingsTabs.forEach((tab) => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                switchSettingsTab(tab.dataset.settingsTab);
            });
        });

        function closeSettings() {
            if (settingsDialog?.open) {
                settingsDialog.close();
            }
        }

        settingsClose?.addEventListener('click', closeSettings);
        settingsCancel?.addEventListener('click', closeSettings);

        settingsDialog?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            if (event.target === settingsDialog) {
                closeSettings();
            }
        });

        // Logout Dialog Logic
        const logoutBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-logout]');
        const logoutDialog = document.getElementById('logout-dialog');
        const logoutCancel = document.getElementById('logout-cancel');

        if (logoutBtns.length && logoutDialog) {
            logoutBtns.forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (window.innerWidth < 768) closeMobileSidebar();
                logoutDialog.showModal();
            }));

            if (logoutCancel) {
                logoutCancel.addEventListener('click', () => logoutDialog.close());
            }

            logoutDialog.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const rect = logoutDialog.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (e.clientX < rect.left || e.clientX > rect.right || e.clientY < rect.top || e.clientY > rect.bottom) {
                    logoutDialog.close();
                }
            });
        }
    });
</script>

<?php
/**
 * MemPulse SRS schedule preview (interactive).
 *
 * Put this file in app/includes/ and include it where you want the preview.
 *
 * Basic use (renders its own four inputs, sandbox only, nothing is saved):
 *
 *   $srsPreview = [
 *       'remember' => 2.0,   // Remember multiplier
 *       'forgot'   => 0.5,   // Forgot multiplier
 *       'initial'  => 1,     // initial_interval_days
 *       'max'      => 365,   // maximum_interval_days
 *   ];
 *   include __DIR__ . '/../includes/srs-preview.php';
 *
 * Use on the Settings page (no extra inputs; follows your real fields live):
 *
 *   $srsPreview = [ ...current saved values... ];
 *   $srsPreviewBind = [
 *       'remember' => '#your-remember-input-selector',
 *       'forgot'   => '#your-forgot-input-selector',
 *       'initial'  => '#your-initial-input-selector',
 *       'max'      => '#your-max-input-selector',
 *   ];
 *   include __DIR__ . '/../includes/srs-preview.php';
 *
 * Intervals are whole days: round(current * multiplier), never below 1 and never above max.
 * Keep this in line with how save-session.php / SessionService.php schedule real cards.
 */

$__srspDefaults = ['remember' => 2.0, 'forgot' => 0.5, 'initial' => 1, 'max' => 365];
$__srspCfg  = array_merge($__srspDefaults, (isset($srsPreview) && is_array($srsPreview)) ? $srsPreview : []);
$__srspBind = (isset($srsPreviewBind) && is_array($srsPreviewBind)) ? $srsPreviewBind : null;
$__srspId   = 'srsp' . substr(md5(uniqid('', true)), 0, 8);
$__srspData = ['defaults' => $__srspCfg, 'bind' => $__srspBind];

// Clean values for the input fields.
$__srspRemember = rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float) $__srspCfg['remember'], 2, '.', ''), '0'), '.');
$__srspForgot   = rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float) $__srspCfg['forgot'], 2, '.', ''), '0'), '.');

$__srspInputClass = 'w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant/60 bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2 text-sm text-on-surface focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary';

if (!defined('SRSP_STYLE_PRINTED')) {
    define('SRSP_STYLE_PRINTED', true);
    ?>
<style>
    @keyframes srsp-pop {
        from { transform: scale(.7); opacity: 0; }
        to   { transform: scale(1);  opacity: 1; }
    }
    .srsp-new { animation: srsp-pop .25s ease-out; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .srsp-new { animation: none; }
    }
</style>
<?php } ?>

<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var ID = <?php echo json_encode($__srspId); ?>;
    var CFG = <?php echo json_encode($__srspData, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP); ?>;

    var root = document.getElementById(ID);
    if (!root) { return; }

    var q = function (sel) { return root.querySelector(sel); };
    var timelineEl = q('[data-role="timeline"]');
    var scrollerEl = q('[data-role="scroller"]');
    var statusEl = q('[data-role="status"]');
    var warnEl = q('[data-role="warn"]');
    var srEl = q('[data-role="sr"]');
    var btnRemember = q('[data-act="remember"]');
    var btnForgot = q('[data-act="forgot"]');
    var btnReset = q('[data-act="reset"]');

    var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    var MAX_GRADES = 30;
    var grades = [];

    // Find inputs: bound Settings fields if provided, otherwise this component's own inputs.
    var inputs = {};
    ['remember', 'forgot', 'initial', 'max'].forEach(function (k) {
        var bound = CFG.bind && CFG.bind[k] ? document.querySelector(CFG.bind[k]) : null;
        inputs[k] = bound || q('[data-in="' + k + '"]');
    });

    function num(el, fallback) {
        var v = el ? parseFloat(el.value) : NaN;
        return isFinite(v) ? v : fallback;
    }

    function fmt(n) { return (Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toString(); }
    function dayLabel(n) { return n + (n === 1 ? ' day' : ' days'); }

    function settings() {
        var warn = [];
        var r = num(inputs.remember, CFG.defaults.remember);
        if (r < 1) { warn.push('Remember multiplier should be 1 or more.'); r = 1; }
        var f = num(inputs.forgot, CFG.defaults.forgot);
        if (f <= 0 || f > 1) { warn.push('Forgot multiplier should be above 0 and no more than 1.'); f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0.05, f)); }
        var ini = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(inputs.initial, CFG.defaults.initial)));
        var mx = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(inputs.max, CFG.defaults.max)));
        if (ini > mx) { warn.push('Initial interval is above the maximum, so the maximum is used.'); ini = mx; }
        return { r: r, f: f, ini: ini, max: mx, warn: warn };
    }

    // Rebuilds the whole path from the grades so far, so editing a setting updates every step.
    function build(s) {
        var cur = s.ini, day = 0;
        var nodes = [{ type: 'added', day: 0 }];
        var steps = [];
        for (var i = 0; i <= grades.length; i++) {
            day += cur;
            var g = grades[i];
            nodes.push({ type: g || 'pending', day: day, wait: cur });
            if (g) {
                var m = g === 'remember' ? s.r : s.f;
                var raw = cur * m;
                var next = Math.min(s.max, Math.max(1, Math.round(raw)));
                steps.push({ grade: g, from: cur, mult: m, raw: raw, to: next });
                cur = next;
            }
        }
        return { nodes: nodes, steps: steps, day: day };
    }

    var NODE = {
        added:   { cls: 'border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 text-primary', icon: 'add',   label: 'Added' },
        remember:{ cls: 'border-teal-500/50 bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-300', icon: 'check', label: '' },
        forgot:  { cls: 'border-error/50 bg-error/10 text-error', icon: 'close', label: '' },
        pending: { cls: 'border-dashed border-outline bg-surface-container-lowest text-transparent', icon: 'check', label: '' }
    };

    function nodeHtml(n, isNew) {
        var d = NODE[n.type];
        var caption = n.type === 'added' ? 'Added' : (n.type === 'pending' ? 'Next review' : 'Day ' + n.day);
        var capCls = n.type === 'pending' ? 'text-on-surface-variant' : 'text-on-surface-variant/80';
        return '<div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 shrink-0 ' + (isNew ? 'srsp-new' : '') + '" style="width:3.25rem;">' +
               '<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center ' + d.cls + '">' +
               '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">' + d.icon + '</span></div>' +
               '<span class="text-[10px] leading-tight text-center ' + capCls + '">' + caption + '</span></div>';
    }

    function segHtml(wait, isNew) {
        return '<div class="relative h-10 shrink-0 ' + (isNew ? 'srsp-new' : '') + '" style="width:4.75rem;">' +
               '<span class="absolute left-0 right-0 text-center text-xs text-on-surface-variant tabular-nums" style="bottom:55%;">' + dayLabel(wait) + '</span>' +
               '<svg class="absolute left-0 right-0 text-outline" style="top:50%; margin-top:2px;" width="100%" height="8" viewBox="0 0 76 8" preserveAspectRatio="none" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.25">' +
               '<line x1="2" y1="4" x2="72" y2="4"/><polyline points="68,1 73,4 68,7"/></svg></div>';
    }

    function render(pop) {
        var s = settings();
        var b = build(s);
        var html = '', sr = [];

        b.nodes.forEach(function (n, i) {
            var isLast = i === b.nodes.length - 1;
            if (i > 0) { html += segHtml(n.wait, pop && isLast); sr.push('wait ' + dayLabel(n.wait)); }
            html += nodeHtml(n, pop && isLast);
            sr.push(n.type === 'added' ? 'card added' : (n.type === 'pending' ? 'next review' : (n.type === 'remember' ? 'remembered' : 'forgot')) + (n.type === 'pending' ? '' : ' on day ' + n.day));
        });
        timelineEl.innerHTML = html;
        srEl.textContent = sr.join(', ') + '.';

        // Status line
        var last = b.steps[b.steps.length - 1];
        var nextWait = b.nodes[b.nodes.length - 1].wait;
        if (!last) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'First review is due ' + (nextWait === 1 ? 'in 1 day' : 'in ' + nextWait + ' days') + '. Press Remember or Forgot to simulate it.';
        } else {
            var note = '';
            if (Math.round(last.raw) < 1) { note = ' (rounded up to the 1-day minimum)'; }
            else if (Math.round(last.raw) > s.max) { note = ' (capped at your maximum)'; }
            statusEl.textContent = (last.grade === 'remember' ? 'Remember' : 'Forgot') + ': ' +
                last.from + ' \u00d7 ' + fmt(last.mult) + ' = ' + last.to + (last.to === 1 ? ' day' : ' days') + note +
                '. Next review in ' + dayLabel(nextWait) + '.';
        }

        warnEl.textContent = s.warn.join(' ');

        var atLimit = grades.length >= MAX_GRADES;
        [btnRemember, btnForgot].forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.disabled = atLimit;
            btn.classList.toggle('opacity-50', atLimit);
            btn.classList.toggle('cursor-not-allowed', atLimit);
            btn.title = atLimit ? 'Reset to start again' : '';
        });

        if (pop) {
            scrollerEl.scrollTo({ left: scrollerEl.scrollWidth, behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
        }
    }

    btnRemember.addEventListener('click', function () { if (grades.length < MAX_GRADES) { grades.push('remember'); render(true); } });
    btnForgot.addEventListener('click', function () { if (grades.length < MAX_GRADES) { grades.push('forgot'); render(true); } });
    btnReset.addEventListener('click', function () { grades = []; render(false); scrollerEl.scrollLeft = 0; });

    Object.keys(inputs).forEach(function (k) {
        if (inputs[k]) {
            inputs[k].addEventListener('input', function () { render(false); });
            inputs[k].addEventListener('change', function () { render(false); });
        }
    });

    render(false);
})();
</script>

<?php
// 1. Initialize user session tracking
session_start();

// 2. Route Protection: Redirect to login view if user credentials are uninitialized
if (!isset($_SESSION['logged_in']) || $_SESSION['logged_in'] !== true || !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    header("Location: ../../authentication/login.php");
    exit;
}

// 3. Connect to database module and load business services
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../api/FlashcardService.php';

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

ArchiveService::purgeExpired($conn, $userId);

// 4. Validate and sanitize input deck ID parameter
$deckId = isset($_GET['deck_id']) && ctype_digit((string) $_GET['deck_id']) ? (int) $_GET['deck_id'] : 0;

// 5. Fetch target deck details and verify user ownership
$deck = FlashcardService::getDeckDetails($conn, $deckId, $userId);

// Redirect to deck list if the requested deck is missing or unauthorized
if (!$deck) {
    header("Location: decks.php");
    exit;
}

// 6. Fetch all active flashcards belonging to the deck
$flashcards = FlashcardService::getDeckFlashcards($conn, $deckId);
$archivedFlashcards = FlashcardService::getDeckFlashcards($conn, $deckId, '', true);

// 6.5 Fetch user's active decks for the Move dialog
$userDecks = FlashcardService::getUserDecks($conn, $userId);
$otherDecks = array_filter($userDecks, fn($d) => $d['id'] !== $deckId);

// 7. CSRF token initialization for card mutation requests (Add / Edit / Delete)
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

$pageTitle   = $deck['title'] . " - Flashcards";
$currentPage = "decks";
?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<?php include __DIR__ . '/../includes/head.php'; ?>

<!-- BODY: Main App Background & Styling Root -->
<body class="bg-background font-body-md text-on-surface antialiased min-h-screen selection:bg-primary-fixed selection:text-on-primary-fixed">

    <?php include __DIR__ . '/../includes/sidebar.php'; ?>

    <!-- MAIN: Viewport Shell Offset for Mobile/Desktop Navigation Bar -->
    <main id="main-content" 
    class="pl-0 md:pl-72 pt-16 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out">
        <?php include __DIR__ . '/deck-view.php'; ?>
    </main>

    <!-- 1. DATA INJECTION: Server-side PHP variables passed safely to client-side JS -->
    <script>
        window.MemPulseDeckData = Object.assign(window.MemPulseDeckData || {}, {
            csrfToken: <?= json_encode($_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '') ?>,
            deckId: <?= $deckId ?>,
            cardCount: <?= (int) $deck['card_count'] ?>,
            dueCount: <?= (int) $deck['due_count'] ?>,
            archivedCount: <?= (int) $deck['archived_count'] ?>,
            retentionDays: <?= ArchiveService::RETENTION_DAYS ?>,
            otherDecks: <?= json_encode(array_values($otherDecks)) ?>
        });
    </script>

    <!-- 2. CLIENT-SIDE ASSET IMPORTS: Separated standalone JavaScript module -->
    <script src="../assets/js/archive-ui.js" defer></script>
    <script src="../assets/js/deck.js" defer></script>
</body>
</html>

 * Helper function for Heatmap grid CSS class matching review intensity (Green Palette).
 */

    function heatmap_level_style(int $reviews): string {
        if ($reviews <= 0) return 'background-color: #F6F6FD; border: 1px solid rgba(150,150,150,0.2);';
        if ($reviews <= 7) return 'background-color: #86efac;';
        if ($reviews <= 14) return 'background-color: #4ade80;';
        if ($reviews <= 21) return 'background-color: #16a34a;';

         * Global Dashboard UI Manager

        const MemPulseDashboard = {
            updateAll(payload) {
                if (!payload) return;
                this.syncHeader(payload.user);
                this.syncSidebarProfile(payload.user);
                this.syncMetrics(payload.stats);
            },

            syncHeader(user) {
                if (!user || !user.displayName) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('[data-user-name]').forEach((el) => {
                    el.textContent = user.displayName;
                });
            },

            syncSidebarProfile(user) {
                if (!user || !user.displayName) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('[data-user-name]').forEach((el) => {
                    el.textContent = user.displayName;
                });
            },

            syncMetrics(stats) {
                if (!stats) return;
                this.setElText('stat-cards-due', stats.cardsDue);
                this.setElText('stat-mastered', stats.masteredCards);
                this.setElText('stat-tough', stats.toughCards);
                this.setElText('stat-current-streak', stats.currentStreak);
                this.setElText('stat-best-streak', stats.bestStreak);
                this.setElText('stat-streak-accuracy', stats.streakAccuracy);
            },

            setElText(id, value) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.textContent = value ?? '--';
            }
        };

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            MemPulseDashboard.updateAll(window.MemPulseHomeData);

            const heatmapScroller = document.getElementById("heatmap-scroll");

<?php
/**
 * PDF Reviewer (offline, printable study sheet)
 *
 * Two entry points:
 *   1. Deck page bulk-actions bar (selected cards only):
 *        pdf-reviewer.php?deck_id=12&cards=5,9,3[&layout=beside|end][&autoprint=1]
 *   2. Review Hub (every active card of the deck, no selection):
 *        pdf-reviewer.php?deck_id=12&all=1&src=hub[&layout=beside|end][&autoprint=1]
 *
 * - Read-only: nothing is saved and no schedule data is touched.
 * - Standalone: loads only pdf-reviewer.css / pdf-reviewer.js (no app chrome).
 * - Cards are re-fetched server-side, so ownership and "active only" are enforced here,
 *   whatever ids the URL carries.
 */

// 1. Session + route protection (same as deck.php)
session_start();
if (!isset($_SESSION['logged_in']) || $_SESSION['logged_in'] !== true || !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    header("Location: ../../authentication/login.php");
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../api/FlashcardService.php';

// Private study data: never cache it
header('Cache-Control: private, no-store');

const PDF_REVIEWER_MAX_CARDS = 300;    // selected cards (ids travel in the URL); keep in sync with PDF_MAX in deck.js
const PDF_REVIEWER_MAX_ALL   = 1000;   // "all active cards" mode (Review Hub): no ids in the URL, server-side safety cap

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

// 2. Deck (ownership verified by getDeckDetails)
$deckId = isset($_GET['deck_id']) && ctype_digit((string) $_GET['deck_id']) ? (int) $_GET['deck_id'] : 0;
$deck   = FlashcardService::getDeckDetails($conn, $deckId, $userId);
if (!$deck) {
    header("Location: decks.php");
    exit;
}

// 3. Which cards?
//    all=1  -> every active card of the deck (Review Hub), oldest first
//    cards= -> the selected ids from the deck page: positive ints, unique, URL order kept, capped
$allMode = isset($_GET['all']) && $_GET['all'] === '1';
$fromHub = $allMode && isset($_GET['src']) && $_GET['src'] === 'hub';

if ($allMode) {
    $cards = FlashcardService::getActiveCardsForPrint($conn, $deckId, $userId, PDF_REVIEWER_MAX_ALL);
} else {
    $ids = [];
    foreach (explode(',', (string) ($_GET['cards'] ?? '')) as $part) {
        $part = trim($part);
        if ($part !== '' && ctype_digit($part) && (int) $part > 0) {
            $ids[(int) $part] = true;
        }
    }
    $ids   = array_slice(array_keys($ids), 0, PDF_REVIEWER_MAX_CARDS);
    $cards = $ids ? FlashcardService::getCardsForPrint($conn, $deckId, $userId, $ids) : [];
}
$total = count($cards);

// 4. Options (the page also lets the student change them live)
$layoutFromUrl = isset($_GET['layout']) && in_array($_GET['layout'], ['beside', 'end'], true);
$layout        = $layoutFromUrl ? $_GET['layout'] : 'beside';
$autoPrint     = (isset($_GET['autoprint']) && $_GET['autoprint'] === '1') ? '1' : '0';

// Chrome/Edge use <title> as the default PDF file name
$docTitle  = $deck['title'] . ' - MemPulse reviewer';
$h         = fn($v) => FlashcardService::h($v);
$backUrl   = $fromHub ? 'review.php' : 'deck.php?deck_id=' . $deckId;
$backLabel = $fromHub ? 'Back to Review' : 'Back to deck';
$dateLabel = date('F j, Y');
$cardWord  = $total === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards';
?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
    <title><?= $h($docTitle) ?></title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../assets/css/pdf-reviewer.css">
</head>

<body class="pr-body"
      data-autoprint="<?= $autoPrint ?>"
      data-layout-source="<?= $layoutFromUrl ? 'url' : 'default' ?>">

    <!-- TOOLBAR (screen only) -->
    <header class="pr-toolbar pr-no-print">
        <a class="pr-back" href="<?= $h($backUrl) ?>">&larr; <?= $h($backLabel) ?></a>

        <?php if ($total > 0): ?>
        <div class="pr-options">
            <fieldset class="pr-seg">
                <legend class="pr-sr">Where should the answers go?</legend>
                <label class="pr-seg-opt">
                    <input type="radio" name="pr-layout" value="beside" <?= $layout === 'beside' ? 'checked' : '' ?>>
                    <span>Answers beside</span>
                </label>
                <label class="pr-seg-opt">
                    <input type="radio" name="pr-layout" value="end" <?= $layout === 'end' ? 'checked' : '' ?>>
                    <span>Answers at the end</span>
                </label>
            </fieldset>

            <label class="pr-toggle" id="pr-lines-wrap" <?= $layout === 'beside' ? 'hidden' : '' ?>>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pr-lines" checked>
                <span>Space to write answers</span>
            </label>

        <button type="button" id="pr-print-btn" class="pr-print-btn">Print / Save as PDF</button>

 *

 */

/**
 * reports-decks.php
 *
 * Decks tab: reviews/accuracy per deck, mastery per deck, sortable deck table.
 * Expects: $decksReport (from ReportsService::getDecksReport), $filters
 */
$rows   = $decksReport['rows'];
$totals = $decksReport['totals'];
$charts = $decksReport['charts'];

$accuracyBadge = function (?float $acc): string {
    if ($acc === null) {
        return '<span class="text-on-surface-variant/60">—</span>';
    }
    $tone = $acc >= 80 ? 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border-teal-200'
          : ($acc >= 50 ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200'
                        : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200');
    $txt  = rtrim(rtrim(number_format($acc, 1), '0'), '.') . '%';

    return '<span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border text-xs font-bold ' . $tone . '">' . $txt . '</span>';
};

$chartHeight = function (?array $chart): int {
    return $chart ? max(160, 56 + 30 * count($chart['labels'])) : 0;
};
?>

$accuracyBadge = function (?float $acc): string {
    if ($acc === null) {
        return '<span class="text-on-surface-variant/60">—</span>';
    }
    $tone = $acc >= 80 ? 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border-teal-200'
          : ($acc >= 50 ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200'
                        : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200');
    $txt  = rtrim(rtrim(number_format($acc, 1), '0'), '.') . '%';

    return '<span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border text-xs font-bold ' . $tone . '">' . $txt . '</span>';
};

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-modal]').forEach(function (btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', function () { var m = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.openModal); if (m) { m.classList.remove('hidden'); m.classList.add('flex'); var focus = m.querySelector('button,select'); if (focus) focus.focus(); } }); });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-modal]').forEach(function (btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', function () { var m = btn.closest('[role="dialog"]'); if (m) { m.classList.add('hidden'); m.classList.remove('flex'); } }); });
  document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]').forEach(function (m) { m.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === m) { m.classList.add('hidden'); m.classList.remove('flex'); } }); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]:not(.hidden)').forEach(function (m) { m.classList.add('hidden'); m.classList.remove('flex'); }); });
  var form = document.getElementById('random-practice-form');
  if (form) form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var id = document.getElementById('random-practice-deck').value; if (id) window.location.href = 'review.php?mode=random&deck_id=' + encodeURIComponent(id); });
  var pdfForm = document.getElementById('pdf-reviewer-form');
  if (pdfForm) pdfForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var id = document.getElementById('pdf-reviewer-deck').value;
    if (!id) return;
    var url = 'pdf-reviewer.php?deck_id=' + encodeURIComponent(id) + '&all=1&src=hub';
    var win = window.open(url, '_blank');
    if (win) { win.opener = null; } else { window.location.href = url; }   // popup blocked: open in this tab
    var m = document.getElementById('pdf-reviewer-modal');
    if (m) { m.classList.add('hidden'); m.classList.remove('flex'); }
  });
});
</script>

<?php
session_start();

if (!isset($_SESSION['logged_in']) || $_SESSION['logged_in'] !== true || !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    header("Location: ../authentication/login.php");
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../api/ReviewHubService.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../api/PracticeService.php';

// Anti-CSRF token, sent along with the batch save in review.js
if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
    $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
$deckId = isset($_GET['deck_id']) && ctype_digit((string) $_GET['deck_id']) ? (int) $_GET['deck_id'] : null;

$isReviewing = false;
$dueCards = [];
$hubDecks = [];
$practiceDecks = [];

// PRACTICE MODE (read-only): replay chosen cards without touching the schedule.
//   review.php?deck_id=12&mode=practice&from=deck&cards=5,9,14
//   review.php?mode=practice&from=sessions&session_id=88
$mode = (string) ($_GET['mode'] ?? '');
$isRandomPractice = ($mode === 'random');
$isPractice   = ($mode === 'practice' || $isRandomPractice);
$practiceSkipped = 0;
$returnUrl    = 'review.php';
$practiceSessionId = 0;

if ($isRandomPractice) {
    $isReviewing = true;
    $from = 'hub';
    $deckName = null;
    if (!$deckId || $deckId < 1) {
        header('Location: review.php');
        exit;
    }
    $sql = "SELECT f.id, f.front, f.back, f.interval_days, f.next_review_at
            FROM flashcards f
            JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
            WHERE f.deck_id = ? AND d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY f.id ASC";
    if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'ii', $deckId, $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
        while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) { $dueCards[] = $row; }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    }
    if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT title FROM decks WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL")) {
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'ii', $deckId, $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $row = mysqli_fetch_assoc(mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt));
        $deckName = $row['title'] ?? null;
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    }
    if ($deckName === null) { header('Location: review.php'); exit; }
    $returnUrl = 'review.php';
} elseif ($isPractice) {
    $isReviewing = true;
    $from = (string) ($_GET['from'] ?? '');
    $practiceSessionId = isset($_GET['session_id']) && ctype_digit((string) $_GET['session_id']) ? (int) $_GET['session_id'] : 0;

    if ($practiceSessionId > 0) {
        // From session history: all cards of that session, in the order they were reviewed
        $info = PracticeService::sessionInfo($conn, $userId, $practiceSessionId);
        if ($info === null) {
            header("Location: review.php");
            exit;
        }
        $deckId   = $info['deckId'];
        $deckName = $info['deckTitle'];
        $dueCards = PracticeService::cardsFromSession($conn, $userId, $practiceSessionId);
        $practiceSkipped = max(0, $info['requested'] - count($dueCards));
    } else {
        // From the deck page: the selected card ids, in grid order
        $ids = PracticeService::parseIds($_GET['cards'] ?? '');
        if (!$deckId || !$ids) {
            header("Location: review.php");
            exit;
        }
        $deckName = null;
        if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT title FROM decks WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL")) {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "ii", $deckId, $userId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            $row = mysqli_fetch_assoc(mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt));
            $deckName = $row['title'] ?? null;
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        }
        if ($deckName === null) {
            header("Location: review.php");
            exit;
        }
        $dueCards = PracticeService::cardsByIds($conn, $userId, $deckId, $ids);
        $practiceSkipped = max(0, count($ids) - count($dueCards));
    }
    $returnUrl = PracticeService::returnUrl($from, $deckId ?? 0, $practiceSessionId);

} elseif ($deckId) {
    // ACTIVE REVIEW STATE: Fetch due cards for the specific deck
    $isReviewing = true;
    // Ownership check: only this user's non-archived decks, non-archived cards
    $sql = "SELECT f.id, f.front, f.back, f.interval_days, f.next_review_at
            FROM flashcards f
            JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id
            WHERE f.deck_id = ? AND d.user_id = ? AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.next_review_at <= NOW()
            ORDER BY f.next_review_at ASC";
    if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "ii", $deckId, $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
        while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
            $dueCards[] = $row;
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    }
    $deckName = null;
    if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT title FROM decks WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL")) {
        mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "ii", $deckId, $userId);
        mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
        $row = mysqli_fetch_assoc(mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt));
        $deckName = $row['title'] ?? null;
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    }
    if ($deckName === null) {
        header("Location: review.php");
        exit;
    }
} else {
    // HUB STATE: table data + call-to-action data
    $hubDecks       = ReviewHubService::getHubDecks($conn, $userId);
    $dueDecks       = ReviewHubService::dueDecks($hubDecks);
    $upcomingDecks  = ReviewHubService::upcomingDecks($hubDecks);
    $recentSessions = ReviewHubService::getRecentSessions($conn, $userId, 8);
    $practiceDecks = ReviewHubService::getPracticeDecks($conn, $userId);

    $streakInfo     = ReviewHubService::getStreakInfo($conn, $userId);
    $curStreak      = $streakInfo['currentStreak'];
    $reviewedToday  = $streakInfo['reviewedToday'];

    $dueTotal       = array_sum(array_column($dueDecks, 'dueCount'));
    $nextDueSecs    = $dueTotal === 0 ? ReviewHubService::getNextDueSeconds($conn, $userId) : null;
}

$pageTitle = $isReviewing ? "Active Review" : "Review Hub"; 
$currentPage = "review";

<?php
/**
 * Session History (list of all completed review sessions)
 * Subpage of Review Hub:  Review Hub > Session History
 * Each row links to session-details.php?id=X
 */
session_start();

if (!isset($_SESSION['logged_in']) || $_SESSION['logged_in'] !== true || !isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    header("Location: ../../authentication/login.php");
    exit;
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../api/SessionService.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../api/ReviewHubService.php';

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

// ---- Filters (GET) ----
$validDate = function ($v): string {
    $v = (string) $v;
    $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $v);
    return ($d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $v) ? $v : '';
};
$accOptions = [0 => 'Any accuracy', 50 => '50% or higher', 60 => '60% or higher', 70 => '70% or higher', 80 => '80% or higher', 90 => '90% or higher'];

$q      = mb_substr(trim((string) ($_GET['q'] ?? '')), 0, 100);
$from   = $validDate($_GET['from'] ?? '');
$to     = $validDate($_GET['to'] ?? '');
$minAcc = (isset($_GET['acc']) && ctype_digit((string) $_GET['acc']) && isset($accOptions[(int) $_GET['acc']])) ? (int) $_GET['acc'] : 0;
if ($from !== '' && $to !== '' && $from > $to) { [$from, $to] = [$to, $from]; }

$filters    = ['q' => $q, 'from' => $from, 'to' => $to, 'minAccuracy' => $minAcc];
$hasFilters = $q !== '' || $from !== '' || $to !== '' || $minAcc > 0;
$advActive  = ($from !== '' ? 1 : 0) + ($to !== '' ? 1 : 0) + ($minAcc > 0 ? 1 : 0); // filters hidden inside the panel

// ---- Pagination ----
$perPage    = 15;
$totalCount = SessionService::countCompletedSessions($conn, $userId, $filters);
$totalPages = max(1, (int) ceil($totalCount / $perPage));
$page       = isset($_GET['page']) && ctype_digit((string) $_GET['page']) ? (int) $_GET['page'] : 1;
$page       = min(max(1, $page), $totalPages);
$offset     = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

$sessions = SessionService::getSessionHistory($conn, $userId, $perPage, $offset, $filters);

$pageTitle   = "Session History";
$currentPage = "review"; // keep sidebar highlight on Review Hub
$h = [ReviewHubService::class, 'h'];

// Page URLs keep the active filters
$baseQuery = array_filter([
    'q' => $q, 'from' => $from, 'to' => $to, 'acc' => $minAcc > 0 ? (string) $minAcc : '',
], fn($v) => $v !== '');
$pgUrl = function (int $p) use ($baseQuery): string {
    $qs = $baseQuery + ($p > 1 ? ['page' => $p] : []);
    return 'sessions.php' . ($qs ? '?' . http_build_query($qs) : '');
};

$input = 'w-full rounded-xl border border-outline-variant/40 bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2 text-sm text-on-surface placeholder:text-on-surface-variant/60 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30 focus:border-primary/40';

// ---- Rows for the Tabulator grid (text is pre-formatted here; JS escapes it) ----
$sessionRows = [];
foreach ($sessions as $s) {
    $sessionRows[] = [
        'title'       => (string) $s['deckTitle'],
        'detailsUrl'  => 'session-details.php?id=' . (int) $s['id'],
        // Practice again (read-only replay); sessions with no cards have nothing to replay
        'practiceUrl' => ((int) $s['totalReviewed'] > 0)
            ? 'review.php?mode=practice&from=sessions&session_id=' . (int) $s['id'] : '',
        'date'        => date('M j, Y, g:i A', strtotime($s['startedAt'])),
        'cards'       => (int) $s['totalReviewed'],
        'remembered'  => (int) $s['rememberedCount'],
        'accuracy'    => (int) $s['accuracy'],
        'accuracyCls' => ReviewHubService::accuracyBadgeClass((int) $s['accuracy']),
        'duration'    => ReviewHubService::formatDuration($s['durationSeconds']),
    ];
}
unset($s);
?>

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        var dataEl = document.getElementById('sessions-table-data');
        if (!dataEl || !document.getElementById('sessions-table')) return;
        var rows = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent);
        var esc = MPTable.esc;
        var muted = 'text-on-surface-variant tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap';
        var right = { hozAlign: 'right', headerHozAlign: 'right' };
        var mutedCell = function (c) { return '<span class="' + muted + '">' + esc(c.getValue()) + '</span>'; };

        MPTable.applyTokens(document.getElementById('mp-token-probe'));
        MPTable.ensure(function () {
            MPTable.make('#sessions-table', rows, [
                { title: 'Deck', field: 'title', widthGrow: 3, minWidth: 120, responsive: 0,
                  formatter: function (c) {
                      var r = c.getRow().getData();
                      return '<a href="' + esc(r.detailsUrl) + '" title="' + esc(r.title) + '" class="block truncate font-semibold text-on-surface hover:text-primary transition-colors">' + esc(r.title) + '</a>';
                  } },
                { title: 'Date', field: 'date', minWidth: 130, responsive: 1, formatter: mutedCell },
                Object.assign({ title: 'Cards', field: 'cards', minWidth: 65, responsive: 2, formatter: mutedCell }, right),
                Object.assign({ title: 'Remembered', field: 'remembered', minWidth: 95, responsive: 4, formatter: mutedCell }, right),
                Object.assign({ title: 'Accuracy', field: 'accuracy', minWidth: 80, responsive: 0,
                  formatter: function (c) {
                      var r = c.getRow().getData();
                      return '<span class="inline-block text-xs font-bold border px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md tabular-nums ' + esc(r.accuracyCls) + '">' + esc(r.accuracy) + '%</span>';
                  } }, right),
                Object.assign({ title: 'Duration', field: 'duration', minWidth: 75, responsive: 3, formatter: mutedCell }, right),
                Object.assign({ title: '', field: 'practiceUrl', minWidth: 115, responsive: 0, formatter: function (c) {
                      var r = c.getRow().getData();
                      if (!r.practiceUrl) return '';
                      return '<a href="' + esc(r.practiceUrl) + '" title="Practice these cards again without affecting spaced repetition history" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-primary text-on-primary text-xs shadow-sm hover:bg-primary-container transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px]">visibility</span><span>Preview</span></a>';
                  } }, right),
            ], {
                rowClick: function (e, row) {
                    if (e.target.closest('a')) return;
                    window.location.href = row.getData().detailsUrl;
                }
            });
        });
    });

   PDF Reviewer  (app/views/pdf-reviewer.php)
   Standalone: does not depend on app.css, Tailwind or any icon font, so the

   Ideas borrowed from reports.css: print-color-adjust, break-inside: avoid,

================================================================================

/**
 * account-settings.js  (put in app/assets/js/)
 *
 * Runs the Appearance, Profile and Security tabs of the Settings modal.
 * Loaded by includes/sidebar.php.
 */
(() => {
    'use strict';

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
       Theme: light | dark | system
       --------------------------------------------------------------- */
    const THEME_KEY = 'mempulseTheme';
    const THEMES = ['light', 'dark', 'system'];
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const darkQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

    function readStoredTheme() {
        try {
            const value = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
            return THEMES.includes(value) ? value : 'system';
        } catch (e) {
            return 'system';
        }
    }

    function storeTheme(pref) {
        try { localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, pref); } catch (e) { /* storage blocked */ }
    }

    function applyTheme(pref) {
        const isDark = pref === 'dark' || (pref === 'system' && darkQuery.matches);
        root.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
        root.dataset.themePref = pref;
        root.style.colorScheme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    }

    let currentTheme = readStoredTheme();
    applyTheme(currentTheme);

    // "System" follows the device live, e.g. when the OS switches at sunset.
    darkQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (currentTheme === 'system') applyTheme('system');
    });

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
       Settings modal
       --------------------------------------------------------------- */
    function init() {
        const dialog = document.getElementById('settings-dialog');
        if (!dialog) return;

        const api = dialog.dataset.accountApi;
        const csrf = dialog.dataset.csrf;
        const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

        // The account's saved theme wins (matters on a device you haven't used before).
        const savedTheme = dialog.dataset.theme;
        if (THEMES.includes(savedTheme) && savedTheme !== currentTheme) {
            currentTheme = savedTheme;
            storeTheme(currentTheme);
            applyTheme(currentTheme);
        }

        /* ---- shared helpers ---- */
        function showStatus(el, message, isError = false) {
            if (!el) return;
            el.textContent = message;
            el.classList.toggle('text-error', isError);
            el.classList.toggle('text-primary', !isError);
        }

        async function request(options = {}) {
            const response = await fetch(api, { credentials: 'same-origin', ...options });
            let result = null;
            try { result = await response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not JSON */ }

            if (!response.ok || !result || !result.success) {
                throw new Error((result && result.message) || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
            }
            return result;
        }

        const post = (payload) => request({
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        function formatDate(value) {
            const date = new Date(String(value).replace(' ', 'T'));
            return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
                ? ''
                : date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
        }

        /* ---- Appearance ---- */
        const themeRadios = dialog.querySelectorAll('input[name="appearance"]');
        const appearanceStatus = $('appearance-status');

        themeRadios.forEach((radio) => { radio.checked = radio.value === currentTheme; });

        themeRadios.forEach((radio) => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', async () => {
                if (!radio.checked) return;

                currentTheme = radio.value;
                storeTheme(currentTheme);
                applyTheme(currentTheme);          // instant, no waiting for the server

                showStatus(appearanceStatus, 'Saving...');
                try {
                    await post({ action: 'update_theme', theme: currentTheme });
                    showStatus(appearanceStatus, 'Appearance saved.');
                } catch (error) {
                    showStatus(appearanceStatus,
                        'Applied on this device, but not saved to your account: ' + error.message, true);
                }
            });
        });

        /* ---- Profile ---- */
        const profileForm = $('profile-form');
        const firstName = $('profile-first-name');
        const lastName = $('profile-last-name');
        const email = $('profile-email');
        const emailPasswordWrap = $('profile-password-wrap');
        const emailPassword = $('profile-password');
        const profileMeta = $('profile-meta');
        const profileStatus = $('profile-status');
        const profileSave = $('profile-save');

        const passwordMeta = $('pw-meta');
        let account = null;

        function updatePasswordMeta(data) {
            if (!passwordMeta) return;
            const when = data.password_changed_at ? formatDate(data.password_changed_at) : '';
            passwordMeta.textContent = when
                ? 'Password last changed on ' + when + '.'
                : 'Your password has not been changed since you signed up.';
        }

        function fillAccount(data) {
            account = data;

            firstName.value = data.first_name;
            lastName.value = data.last_name;
            email.value = data.email;

            emailPassword.value = '';
            emailPassword.required = false;
            emailPasswordWrap.classList.add('hidden');

            const since = data.member_since ? formatDate(data.member_since) : '';
            profileMeta.textContent = since ? 'Member since ' + since + '.' : '';

            updatePasswordMeta(data);

            // Keep the sidebar name in sync without a page reload.
            const fullName = (data.first_name + ' ' + data.last_name).trim();
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-user-name]').forEach((el) => { el.textContent = fullName; });
        }

        async function loadAccount() {
            try {
                const result = await request();
                fillAccount(result.account);
            } catch (error) {
                showStatus(profileStatus, error.message, true);
            }
        }

        // Ask for the password only when the email address was actually changed.
        email.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const changed = !!account &&
                email.value.trim().toLowerCase() !== account.email.toLowerCase();
            emailPasswordWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', !changed);
            emailPassword.required = changed;
            if (!changed) emailPassword.value = '';
        });

        profileForm.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!profileForm.checkValidity()) {
                profileForm.reportValidity();
                return;
            }

            profileSave.disabled = true;
            showStatus(profileStatus, 'Saving...');
            try {
                const result = await post({
                    action: 'update_profile',
                    first_name: firstName.value,
                    last_name: lastName.value,
                    email: email.value,
                    current_password: emailPassword.value
                });
                fillAccount(result.account);
                showStatus(profileStatus, result.message);
            } catch (error) {
                showStatus(profileStatus, error.message, true);
            } finally {
                profileSave.disabled = false;
            }
        });

        /* ---- Security: change password ---- */
        const passwordForm = $('password-form');
        const pwCurrent = $('pw-current');
        const pwNew = $('pw-new');
        const pwConfirm = $('pw-confirm');
        const pwShow = $('pw-show');
        const pwStatus = $('pw-status');
        const pwSave = $('pw-save');
        const pwFields = [pwCurrent, pwNew, pwConfirm];

        pwShow.addEventListener('change', () => {
            pwFields.forEach((input) => { input.type = pwShow.checked ? 'text' : 'password'; });
        });

        passwordForm.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();

            if (pwNew.value.length < 8) {
                showStatus(pwStatus, 'Use at least 8 characters for the new password.', true);
                pwNew.focus();
                return;
            }
            if (new TextEncoder().encode(pwNew.value).length > 72) {
                showStatus(pwStatus, 'The new password is too long. Use at most 72 bytes.', true);
                pwNew.focus();
                return;
            }
            if (pwNew.value !== pwConfirm.value) {
                showStatus(pwStatus, 'The new passwords do not match.', true);
                pwConfirm.focus();
                return;
            }

            pwSave.disabled = true;
            showStatus(pwStatus, 'Changing password...');
            try {
                const result = await post({
                    action: 'change_password',
                    current_password: pwCurrent.value,
                    new_password: pwNew.value,
                    confirm_password: pwConfirm.value
                });
                resetPasswordForm();
                updatePasswordMeta(result.account);
                account = account ? { ...account, ...result.account } : result.account;
                showStatus(pwStatus, result.message);
            } catch (error) {
                showStatus(pwStatus, error.message, true);
            } finally {
                pwSave.disabled = false;
            }
        });

        function resetPasswordForm() {
            passwordForm.reset();
            pwFields.forEach((input) => { input.type = 'password'; });
        }

        /* ---- open / close ---- */
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-settings]').forEach((button) => {
            button.addEventListener('click', loadAccount);
        });

        dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
            resetPasswordForm();
            [appearanceStatus, profileStatus, pwStatus].forEach((el) => showStatus(el, ''));
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();

/**
 * MemPulse shared archive UI helpers (toast + retention label).
 * Used by the deck page (cards) and reusable by the decks page (decks).
 * Reads retentionDays from window.MemPulseDeckData or window.MemPulseArchiveConfig.
 */
(function () {
    const cfg = window.MemPulseDeckData || window.MemPulseArchiveConfig || {};
    const RETENTION_DAYS = Number(cfg.retentionDays) || 30;

    function retentionLabel(daysLeft) {
        if (daysLeft === null || daysLeft === undefined) return '';
        if (daysLeft <= 0) return 'Today';
        return daysLeft + (daysLeft === 1 ? ' day' : ' days');
    }

    function toast(message, opts = {}) {
        const { actionLabel, onAction, type = 'info', duration = 6000 } = opts;

        let root = document.getElementById('mp-toast-root');
        if (!root) {
            root = document.createElement('div');
            root.id = 'mp-toast-root';
            root.className = 'fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[100] flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-4';
            document.body.appendChild(root);
        }

        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        el.className = 'flex items-center gap-3 pl-4 pr-2 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-xl text-sm font-medium '
            + (type === 'error' ? 'bg-rose-700 text-white' : 'bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface');

        const text = document.createElement('span');
        text.textContent = message;
        el.appendChild(text);

        const remove = () => el.remove();

        if (actionLabel && typeof onAction === 'function') {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.textContent = actionLabel;
            btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold text-primary-fixed-dim hover:bg-white/10';
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => { remove(); onAction(); });
            el.appendChild(btn);
        }

        root.appendChild(el);
        setTimeout(remove, duration);
    }

    window.MemPulseArchive = { RETENTION_DAYS, retentionLabel, toast };
})();

    async function sendCardAction(payload) {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('../api/flashcard-actions.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, csrf_token: CSRF_TOKEN, deck_id: DECK_ID })
            });
            let data = {};
            try { data = await res.json(); } catch (_) { }

            if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
                throw new Error(data.error || `Database communication error (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
            }
            return data;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Database connection failure:", error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    function formatDateTimeForInput(dateString) {

        return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
    }

    function formatDateTimeDisplay(dateString) {

        const d = new Date(dateString);
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateString;
        const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
        return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
    }

    // Button labels follow the mode: a blank form creates, a loaded card saves changes

        if (modalCancelBtn) modalCancelBtn.textContent = modalNew ? 'Done' : 'Cancel';

    // Read-only support for archived cards
    function setEditorReadOnly(readOnly) {

        if (sidebarCardDue) sidebarCardDue.disabled = readOnly;
        if (modalCardDue) modalCardDue.disabled = readOnly;

    // Editor collapse: hides the editor, grid goes full width, a peek tab shows on the right edge
