/**
 * MemPulse Decks Module
 * Handles view toggles, kebab menu dropdowns, modal dialogs, and AJAX actions.
 */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const config = window.MemPulseDeckData || {};
    const CSRF_TOKEN = config.csrfToken || '';

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. View toggle (grid vs list), remembered in localStorage
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const viewGridBtn = document.getElementById('view-grid-btn');
    const viewListBtn = document.getElementById('view-list-btn');
    const gridView = document.getElementById('decks-grid-view');
    const listView = document.getElementById('decks-list-view');

    const VIEW_KEY = 'mempulse_decks_view';
    const activeBtn = "flex items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-lowest text-primary font-semibold shadow-xs transition-all";
    const idleBtn = "flex items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-lg text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-colors";

    function setView(mode) {
        const isGrid = mode !== 'list';
        if (gridView) gridView.classList.toggle('hidden', !isGrid);
        if (listView) listView.classList.toggle('hidden', isGrid);
        if (viewGridBtn) {
            viewGridBtn.className = isGrid ? activeBtn : idleBtn;
            viewGridBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isGrid));
        }
        if (viewListBtn) {
            viewListBtn.className = isGrid ? idleBtn : activeBtn;
            viewListBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isGrid));
        }
    }

    function saveView(mode) {
        try { localStorage.setItem(VIEW_KEY, mode); } catch (_) { }
    }

    if (viewGridBtn && viewListBtn && gridView && listView) {
        let saved = null;
        try { saved = localStorage.getItem(VIEW_KEY); } catch (_) { }
        setView(saved === 'list' ? 'list' : 'grid');

        viewGridBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { setView('grid'); saveView('grid'); });
        viewListBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { setView('list'); saveView('list'); });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper: Toast Notifications inside Archived Modal
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const archivedToast = document.getElementById('archived-toast');
    const archivedToastMsg = document.getElementById('archived-toast-message');

    function showArchivedToast(message, isSuccess = true) {
        if (!archivedToast || !archivedToastMsg) return;
        archivedToastMsg.textContent = message;
        archivedToast.className = isSuccess
            ? "px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-between bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200"
            : "px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-between bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200";
        archivedToast.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // Trigger pulse highlight animation on Archived Decks button
    function triggerArchiveButtonPulse() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('open-archived-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        btn.classList.add('animate-archive-pulse', 'bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary-container', 'ring-2', 'ring-primary/40');
        setTimeout(() => {
            btn.classList.remove('animate-archive-pulse', 'bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary-container', 'ring-2', 'ring-primary/40');
        }, 1500);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Deck Kebab Menu & Modals Logic
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const deckMenu = document.getElementById('deck-menu');
    const renameDialog = document.getElementById('rename-dialog');
    const renameForm = document.getElementById('rename-form');
    const renameInput = document.getElementById('rename-input');
    const renameError = document.getElementById('rename-error');
    const renameSave = document.getElementById('rename-save');

    const archiveDialog = document.getElementById('archive-dialog') || document.getElementById('delete-dialog');
    const archiveName = document.getElementById('archive-name') || document.getElementById('delete-name');
    const archiveError = document.getElementById('archive-error') || document.getElementById('delete-error');
    const archiveConfirm = document.getElementById('archive-confirm') || document.getElementById('delete-confirm');
    const countBadge = document.getElementById('deck-count-badge');

    let activeDeckId = null;
    let menuButton = null;

    const archivedDecksDialog = document.getElementById('archived-decks-dialog');
    const openArchivedBtn = document.getElementById('open-archived-btn');

    if (openArchivedBtn && archivedDecksDialog) {
        openArchivedBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            archivedDecksDialog.showModal();
        });
    }

    // Restore Deck Action Handler
    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        const restoreBtn = e.target.closest('[data-restore-deck]');
        if (!restoreBtn) return;

        const deckId = restoreBtn.getAttribute('data-restore-deck');
        const itemEl = document.querySelector(`[data-archived-item="${deckId}"]`);
        const deckTitleEl = document.querySelector(`[data-archived-title="${deckId}"]`);
        const deckTitle = deckTitleEl ? deckTitleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Deck';

        restoreBtn.disabled = true;
        restoreBtn.textContent = "Restoring...";

        try {
            await sendDeckAction({ action: 'restore', deck_id: deckId });

            if (itemEl) itemEl.remove();

            const listContainer = document.getElementById('archived-decks-list-container');
            if (listContainer && listContainer.children.length === 0) {
                listContainer.innerHTML = '<p id="no-archived-msg" class="text-on-surface-variant text-center py-6 text-sm">No archived decks found.</p>';
            }

            showArchivedToast(`"${deckTitle}" has been restored to active decks.`, true);
            window.needMainReload = true;
        } catch (err) {
            showArchivedToast("Failed to restore deck: " + err.message, false);
            restoreBtn.disabled = false;
            restoreBtn.textContent = "Restore";
        }
    });

    // Permanent Delete Handler for Archived Decks
    const permDeleteDialog = document.getElementById('permanent-delete-dialog');
    const permDeleteName = document.getElementById('perm-delete-name');
    const permDeleteError = document.getElementById('perm-delete-error');
    const permDeleteConfirm = document.getElementById('perm-delete-confirm');
    let targetDeleteDeckId = null;

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const deleteBtn = e.target.closest('[data-delete-archived]');
        if (!deleteBtn) return;

        targetDeleteDeckId = deleteBtn.getAttribute('data-delete-archived');
        const deckTitleEl = document.querySelector(`[data-archived-title="${targetDeleteDeckId}"]`);
        const deckTitle = deckTitleEl ? deckTitleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Deck';

        if (permDeleteName) permDeleteName.textContent = `"${deckTitle}"`;
        if (permDeleteError) permDeleteError.classList.add('hidden');
        if (permDeleteDialog) permDeleteDialog.showModal();
    });

    if (permDeleteConfirm) {
        permDeleteConfirm.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if (!targetDeleteDeckId) return;

            permDeleteConfirm.disabled = true;
            try {
                const deckTitleEl = document.querySelector(`[data-archived-title="${targetDeleteDeckId}"]`);
                const deckTitle = deckTitleEl ? deckTitleEl.textContent.trim() : 'Deck';

                await sendDeckAction({ action: 'permanent_delete', deck_id: targetDeleteDeckId });

                const itemEl = document.querySelector(`[data-archived-item="${targetDeleteDeckId}"]`);
                if (itemEl) itemEl.remove();

                const listContainer = document.getElementById('archived-decks-list-container');
                if (listContainer && listContainer.children.length === 0) {
                    listContainer.innerHTML = '<p id="no-archived-msg" class="text-on-surface-variant text-center py-6 text-sm">No archived decks found.</p>';
                }

                if (permDeleteDialog) permDeleteDialog.close();
                showArchivedToast(`"${deckTitle}" has been permanently deleted.`, false);
            } catch (err) {
                if (permDeleteError) {
                    permDeleteError.textContent = err.message;
                    permDeleteError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            } finally {
                permDeleteConfirm.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    if (archivedDecksDialog) {
        archivedDecksDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
            if (window.needMainReload) {
                window.location.reload();
            }
        });
    }

    function getDeckTitle(id) {
        const el = document.querySelector('[data-deck-title="' + id + '"]');
        return el ? el.textContent.trim() : '';
    }

    function closeMenu() {
        if (!deckMenu) return;
        deckMenu.classList.add('hidden');
        if (menuButton) menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        menuButton = null;
    }

    function openMenu(btn) {
        closeMenu();
        if (!deckMenu) return;
        menuButton = btn;
        activeDeckId = btn.dataset.deckId;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        deckMenu.classList.remove('hidden');

        const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        const w = deckMenu.offsetWidth;
        const h = deckMenu.offsetHeight;
        const left = Math.min(Math.max(8, rect.right - w), window.innerWidth - w - 8);
        let top = rect.bottom + 6;
        if (top + h > window.innerHeight - 8) top = rect.top - h - 6;
        deckMenu.style.left = left + 'px';
        deckMenu.style.top = Math.max(8, top) + 'px';
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-deck-menu]');
        if (btn) {
            if (menuButton === btn) closeMenu(); else openMenu(btn);
        } else if (deckMenu && !deckMenu.contains(e.target)) {
            closeMenu();
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu(); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', closeMenu);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', closeMenu, true);

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-dialog]').forEach((b) => {
        b.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const dlg = b.closest('dialog');
            if (dlg) dlg.close();
        });
    });

    async function sendDeckAction(payload) {
        const res = await fetch('../api/deck-actions.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, csrf_token: CSRF_TOKEN })
        });
        let data = {};
        try { data = await res.json(); } catch (_) { }
        if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
            const err = new Error(data.error || 'Request failed (HTTP ' + res.status + ').');
            err.suggestion = data.suggestion || null;
            throw err;
        }
        return data;
    }

    if (deckMenu) {
        deckMenu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const item = e.target.closest('[data-menu-action]');
            if (!item || !activeDeckId) return;
            const action = item.dataset.menuAction;
            closeMenu();

            if (action === 'rename' && renameDialog) {
                if (renameInput) renameInput.value = getDeckTitle(activeDeckId);
                if (renameError) renameError.classList.add('hidden');
                renameDialog.showModal();
                if (renameInput) renameInput.select();
            } else if ((action === 'delete' || action === 'archive') && archiveDialog) {
                if (archiveName) archiveName.textContent = '"' + getDeckTitle(activeDeckId) + '"';
                if (archiveError) archiveError.classList.add('hidden');
                archiveDialog.showModal();
            } else if (action === 'add-card') {
                openCardDialog(activeDeckId);
            } else if (action === 'edit-banner' && bannerDialog) {
                selectedBannerPath = null;
                if (bannerError) bannerError.classList.add('hidden');

                // Highlight current selection if any
                document.querySelectorAll('.banner-option').forEach(b => {
                    b.classList.remove('border-primary');
                    b.classList.add('border-transparent');
                });

                bannerDialog.showModal();
            }
        });
    }

    if (renameForm) {
        renameForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const title = renameInput ? renameInput.value.trim() : '';
            if (title === '') {
                if (renameError) {
                    renameError.textContent = 'Deck name cannot be empty.';
                    renameError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
                return;
            }
            if (renameSave) renameSave.disabled = true;
            try {
                const data = await sendDeckAction({ action: 'rename', deck_id: activeDeckId, title });
                document.querySelectorAll('[data-deck-title="' + activeDeckId + '"]').forEach((el) => {
                    el.textContent = data.title;
                });
                if (renameDialog) renameDialog.close();
            } catch (err) {
                showFieldError(renameError, renameInput, err);
            } finally {
                if (renameSave) renameSave.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Inline Archiving Action (Animates Card Out & Updates Archive List)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (archiveConfirm) {
        archiveConfirm.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            archiveConfirm.disabled = true;
            try {
                const action = archiveConfirm.id === 'delete-confirm' ? 'delete' : 'archive';
                const deckTitle = getDeckTitle(activeDeckId) || 'Deck';

                // Get metadata from active card element
                const activeCard = document.querySelector(`[data-deck-card="${activeDeckId}"]`);
                let cardCount = '0';
                let accuracy = 'N/A';

                if (activeCard) {
                    const cardCountEl = activeCard.querySelector('.font-semibold.text-on-surface');
                    if (cardCountEl) cardCount = cardCountEl.textContent.trim();

                    // Safely find the accuracy badge element without invalid query selector syntax
                    const accEl = activeCard.querySelector('[class*="badge"]') ||
                        Array.from(activeCard.querySelectorAll('span')).find(el => el.textContent.includes('%'));
                    if (accEl) accuracy = accEl.textContent.trim();
                }

                await sendDeckAction({ action, deck_id: activeDeckId });

                if (archiveDialog) archiveDialog.close();

                // Fade out card elements in grid & list view
                const cardsToRemove = document.querySelectorAll(`[data-deck-card="${activeDeckId}"]`);
                cardsToRemove.forEach(card => {
                    card.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                    card.style.opacity = '0';
                    card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
                    setTimeout(() => card.remove(), 300);
                });

                // Dynamically insert into Archived Decks Modal
                const listContainer = document.getElementById('archived-decks-list-container');
                if (listContainer) {
                    const noMsg = document.getElementById('no-archived-msg');
                    if (noMsg) noMsg.remove();

                    const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
                    const newItemHTML = `
                        <div data-archived-item="${activeDeckId}" class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-xl border border-outline-variant/40 bg-surface gap-4 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors">
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="font-bold text-on-surface text-[15px]" data-archived-title="${activeDeckId}">${deckTitle}</h4>
                                <div class="text-[13px] text-on-surface-variant mt-1.5 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-1">
                                    <span><strong>Cards:</strong> ${cardCount}</span>
                                    <span><strong>Accuracy:</strong> ${accuracy}</span>
                                    <span><strong>Archived:</strong> ${today}</span>
                                    <span><strong>Reviewed:</strong> Just now</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                                <button type="button" data-restore-deck="${activeDeckId}" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container hover:bg-primary hover:text-on-primary text-sm font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap shadow-sm">
                                    Restore
                                </button>
                                <button type="button" data-delete-archived="${activeDeckId}" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap" title="Delete Permanently">
                                    Delete
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    listContainer.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', newItemHTML);
                }

                // Trigger Archive Button Highlight Animation
                triggerArchiveButtonPulse();

                // Update remaining deck badge count
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const remaining = document.querySelectorAll('#decks-grid-view [data-deck-card]').length;
                    if (remaining === 0) {
                        window.location.reload();
                    } else if (countBadge) {
                        countBadge.textContent = remaining + (remaining === 1 ? ' Deck' : ' Decks');
                    }
                }, 350);

            } catch (err) {
                if (archiveError) {
                    archiveError.textContent = err.message;
                    archiveError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            } finally {
                archiveConfirm.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Create Deck Dialog Handler
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const createDialog = document.getElementById('create-dialog');
    const createForm = document.getElementById('create-form');
    const createInput = document.getElementById('create-input');
    const createError = document.getElementById('create-error');
    const createSave = document.getElementById('create-save');

    let creatingDeckForCard = false;
    let suppressCardResume = false;

    function openCreateDialog(fromCard = false) {
        creatingDeckForCard = fromCard;

        if (fromCard && typeof cardDialog !== 'undefined' && cardDialog && cardDialog.open) {
            suppressCardResume = true;
            cardDialog.close();
            suppressCardResume = false;
        }

        if (createInput) createInput.value = '';
        if (createError) createError.classList.add('hidden');
        if (createSave) createSave.disabled = false;
        if (createDialog) {
            createDialog.showModal();
            if (createInput) createInput.focus();
        }
    }

    ['new-deck-btn', 'new-deck-tile', 'new-deck-row', 'new-deck-empty-grid', 'new-deck-empty-list'].forEach((id) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.addEventListener('click', () => openCreateDialog(false));
    });

    if (createForm) {
        createForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const title = createInput ? createInput.value.trim() : '';
            if (title === '') {
                if (createError) {
                    createError.textContent = 'Deck name cannot be empty.';
                    createError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
                return;
            }
            if (createSave) createSave.disabled = true;
            try {
                const data = await sendDeckAction({ action: 'create', title });

                if (creatingDeckForCard) {
                    window.location.href = 'decks.php?add_card=1&deck_id=' + encodeURIComponent(data.id);
                } else {
                    window.location.reload();
                }
            } catch (err) {
                showFieldError(createError, createInput, err);
                if (createSave) createSave.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    if (createDialog) {
        createDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
            if (creatingDeckForCard && !suppressCardResume) {
                creatingDeckForCard = false;
                if (typeof cardDeckSelect !== 'undefined' && cardDeckSelect) {
                    cardDeckSelect.value = cardDeckId ? String(cardDeckId) : '';
                }
                if (typeof cardDialog !== 'undefined' && cardDialog) {
                    cardDialog.showModal();
                    if (cardFront) cardFront.focus();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Review Button Handler
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action="review"]');
        if (!btn) return;

        const deckId = btn.dataset.deckId;
        if (deckId) {
            window.location.href = 'review.php?deck_id=' + encodeURIComponent(deckId);
        }
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Add Card Modal Handler
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const cardDialog = document.getElementById('card-dialog');
    const cardForm = document.getElementById('card-form');
    const cardDeckSelect = document.getElementById('card-deck-select');
    const cardFront = document.getElementById('card-front');
    const cardBack = document.getElementById('card-back');
    const cardError = document.getElementById('card-error');
    const cardSuccess = document.getElementById('card-success');
    const cardSave = document.getElementById('card-save');

    let cardDeckId = null;
    let cardsAdded = false;

    function openCardDialog(deckId = null) {
        if (!cardDialog) return;
        const selectedId = Number(deckId);
        cardDeckId = Number.isInteger(selectedId) && selectedId > 0 ? selectedId : null;
        cardsAdded = false;

        if (cardDeckSelect) cardDeckSelect.value = cardDeckId ? String(cardDeckId) : '';
        if (cardFront) cardFront.value = '';
        if (cardBack) cardBack.value = '';
        if (cardError) cardError.classList.add('hidden');
        if (cardSuccess) cardSuccess.classList.add('hidden');
        if (cardSave) cardSave.disabled = false;

        cardDialog.showModal();

        if (cardDeckId && cardFront) {
            cardFront.focus();
        } else if (cardDeckSelect) {
            cardDeckSelect.focus();
        }
    }

    if (cardDeckSelect) {
        cardDeckSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
            if (cardDeckSelect.value === '__create__') {
                cardDeckSelect.value = cardDeckId ? String(cardDeckId) : '';
                openCreateDialog(true);
                return;
            }

            const selectedId = Number(cardDeckSelect.value);
            cardDeckId = Number.isInteger(selectedId) && selectedId > 0 ? selectedId : null;
            if (cardError) cardError.classList.add('hidden');
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action="add-card"]');
        if (btn) openCardDialog(btn.dataset.deckId);
    });

    [cardFront, cardBack].forEach((field) => {
        if (field) {
            field.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (cardForm) cardForm.requestSubmit();
                }
            });
        }
    });

    if (cardForm) {
        cardForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const front = cardFront ? cardFront.value.trim() : '';
            const back = cardBack ? cardBack.value.trim() : '';
            const selectedDeckId = cardDeckSelect ? Number(cardDeckSelect.value) : null;

            if (cardSuccess) cardSuccess.classList.add('hidden');

            if (!Number.isInteger(selectedDeckId) || selectedDeckId <= 0) {
                cardDeckId = null;
                if (cardError) {
                    cardError.textContent = 'Please choose a deck before adding the card.';
                    cardError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
                if (cardDeckSelect) cardDeckSelect.focus();
                return;
            }

            cardDeckId = selectedDeckId;

            if (front === '' || back === '') {
                if (cardError) {
                    cardError.textContent = 'Both the front and back are required.';
                    cardError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
                return;
            }
            if (cardError) cardError.classList.add('hidden');

            if (cardSave) cardSave.disabled = true;
            try {
                await sendDeckAction({ action: 'add_card', deck_id: cardDeckId, front, back });
                cardsAdded = true;
                if (cardFront) cardFront.value = '';
                if (cardBack) cardBack.value = '';
                if (cardSuccess) cardSuccess.classList.remove('hidden');
                if (cardFront) cardFront.focus();
            } catch (err) {
                if (cardError) {
                    cardError.textContent = err.message;
                    cardError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            } finally {
                if (cardSave) cardSave.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    function showFieldError(errorEl, input, err) {
        if (!errorEl) return;
        errorEl.textContent = err.message;
        if (err.suggestion && input) {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.className = 'ml-2 underline font-semibold';
            btn.textContent = 'Use "' + err.suggestion + '"';
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                input.value = err.suggestion;
                errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
                input.focus();
            });
            errorEl.appendChild(btn);
        }
        errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    if (cardDialog) {
        cardDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
            if (cardsAdded) {
                const cleanUrl = window.location.pathname;
                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, cleanUrl);
                window.location.reload();
            }
        });
    }

    // Auto-open modals via URL params
    if (config.createRequested) {
        openCreateDialog();
    } else if (config.addCardRequested) {
        openCardDialog(config.requestedDeckId);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // 7. Custom Deck Position Management via LocalStorage
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const ORDER_KEY = 'mempulse_deck_order';
    const gridContainer = document.getElementById('decks-grid-view');
    const listContainer = document.getElementById('decks-list-view');

    const movePosDialog = document.getElementById('move-pos-dialog');
    const movePosForm = document.getElementById('move-pos-form');
    const movePosName = document.getElementById('move-pos-deck-name');
    const movePosInput = document.getElementById('move-pos-input');
    const movePosHint = document.getElementById('move-pos-hint');

    function getDeckElements(container) {
        if (!container) return [];
        return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.deck-card[data-deck-id]'));
    }

    function applySavedDeckOrder(container) {
        if (!container) return;

        let savedOrder = null;
        try {
            savedOrder = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ORDER_KEY));
        } catch (_) { }

        if (!Array.isArray(savedOrder) || savedOrder.length === 0) return;

        const items = getDeckElements(container);
        const itemMap = new Map();
        items.forEach(item => itemMap.set(String(item.dataset.deckId), item));

        savedOrder.forEach(deckId => {
            const el = itemMap.get(String(deckId));
            if (el) {
                container.appendChild(el);
                itemMap.delete(String(deckId));
            }
        });

        const createBtn = container.querySelector('#new-deck-tile, #new-deck-row');
        itemMap.forEach(el => {
            if (createBtn) container.insertBefore(el, createBtn);
            else container.appendChild(el);
        });

        if (createBtn) container.appendChild(createBtn);
    }

    function saveCurrentDeckOrder(container) {
        if (!container) return;
        const items = getDeckElements(container);
        const order = items.map(el => Number(el.dataset.deckId));
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(ORDER_KEY, JSON.stringify(order));
        } catch (_) { }
    }

    function moveDeckToPosition(targetDeckId, newPos) {
        [gridContainer, listContainer].forEach(container => {
            if (!container) return;
            const items = getDeckElements(container);
            const targetEl = container.querySelector(`.deck-card[data-deck-id="${targetDeckId}"]`);
            if (!targetEl || items.length === 0) return;

            const targetIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(newPos - 1, items.length - 1));
            const createBtn = container.querySelector('#new-deck-tile, #new-deck-row');

            const remaining = items.filter(el => String(el.dataset.deckId) !== String(targetDeckId));
            remaining.splice(targetIdx, 0, targetEl);

            remaining.forEach(el => {
                if (createBtn) container.insertBefore(el, createBtn);
                else container.appendChild(el);
            });
            if (createBtn) container.appendChild(createBtn);

            saveCurrentDeckOrder(container);
        });
    }

    // Apply saved order on load
    applySavedDeckOrder(gridContainer);
    applySavedDeckOrder(listContainer);

    // Kebab Menu Handler for Move Position
    if (deckMenu) {
        deckMenu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const item = e.target.closest('[data-menu-action="move-pos"]');
            if (!item || !activeDeckId) return;

            const deckTitle = getDeckTitle(activeDeckId) || 'Deck';
            const currentItems = getDeckElements(gridContainer || listContainer);
            const currentIdx = currentItems.findIndex(el => String(el.dataset.deckId) === String(activeDeckId));

            if (movePosName) movePosName.textContent = `"${deckTitle}"`;
            if (movePosInput) {
                movePosInput.value = currentIdx !== -1 ? currentIdx + 1 : 1;
                movePosInput.max = currentItems.length;
            }
            if (movePosHint) movePosHint.textContent = `Enter position between 1 and ${currentItems.length}.`;

            if (movePosDialog) movePosDialog.showModal();
        });
    }

    if (movePosForm) {
        movePosForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const newPos = parseInt(movePosInput ? movePosInput.value : '1', 10);
            if (!isNaN(newPos) && activeDeckId) {
                moveDeckToPosition(activeDeckId, newPos);
                if (movePosDialog) movePosDialog.close();
            }
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Edit Banner Modal Handler
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    const bannerDialog = document.getElementById('banner-dialog');
    const bannerSave = document.getElementById('banner-save');
    const bannerError = document.getElementById('banner-error');
    let selectedBannerPath = null;

    // Delegate banner image clicks inside the dialog
    if (bannerDialog) {
        bannerDialog.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const optionBtn = e.target.closest('.banner-option');
            if (!optionBtn) return;

            document.querySelectorAll('.banner-option').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('border-primary');
                b.classList.add('border-transparent');
            });

            optionBtn.classList.remove('border-transparent');
            optionBtn.classList.add('border-primary');
            selectedBannerPath = optionBtn.dataset.bannerPath;
        });
    }

    if (bannerSave) {
        bannerSave.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if (selectedBannerPath === null) {
                if (bannerError) {
                    bannerError.textContent = "Please select a banner image or default gradient.";
                    bannerError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
                return;
            }

            bannerSave.disabled = true;
            try {
                await sendDeckAction({
                    action: 'update_cover',
                    deck_id: activeDeckId,
                    cover_image: selectedBannerPath
                });

                if (bannerDialog) bannerDialog.close();
                window.location.reload();
            } catch (err) {
                if (bannerError) {
                    bannerError.textContent = err.message;
                    bannerError.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            } finally {
                bannerSave.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }
});

/**
 * Hero Carousel Management Module
 * Standardized module for managing slide transitions, autoplay timers,
 * keyboard accessibility, and wayfinder dot state synchronization.
 */
(($) => {
    'use strict';

    class HeroCarousel {
        constructor(carouselElement, autoPlayDelay = 7000) {
            if (!carouselElement) return;

            this.carousel = carouselElement;
            this.delay = autoPlayDelay;
            this.slides = Array.from(this.carousel.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide'));
            this.dotGroups = this.slides.map(slide =>
                Array.from(slide.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot'))
            );

            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.timer = null;

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            if (this.slides.length === 0) return;

            this.bindEvents();
            this.goToSlide(0, false);
            this.startAutoplay();
        }

        goToSlide(index, resetTimer = true) {
            this.currentIndex = (index + this.slides.length) % this.slides.length;

            // Update slide visibilities & accessibility attributes
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const isActive = i === this.currentIndex;
                slide.classList.toggle('opacity-100', isActive);
                slide.classList.toggle('z-10', isActive);
                slide.classList.toggle('opacity-0', !isActive);
                slide.classList.toggle('pointer-events-none', !isActive);
                slide.classList.toggle('z-0', !isActive);

                slide.setAttribute('aria-hidden', isActive ? 'false' : 'true');
            });

            // Update wayfinder dot indicators across all duplicated slide footers
            this.dotGroups.forEach((group) => {
                group.forEach((dot, dotIdx) => {
                    const isActive = dotIdx === this.currentIndex;
                    dot.classList.toggle('bg-cyan-400', isActive);
                    dot.classList.toggle('w-6', isActive);
                    dot.classList.toggle('bg-white/30', !isActive);
                    dot.classList.toggle('w-2', !isActive);

                    dot.setAttribute('aria-current', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
                });
            });

            if (resetTimer) {
                this.startAutoplay();
            }
        }

        startAutoplay() {
            this.stopAutoplay();
            this.timer = setInterval(() => {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1, false);
            }, this.delay);
        }

        stopAutoplay() {
            if (this.timer) {
                clearInterval(this.timer);
                this.timer = null;
            }
        }

        bindEvents() {
            // Click handlers on wayfinder dots
            this.dotGroups.forEach((group) => {
                group.forEach((dot) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetIndex = parseInt(dot.dataset.dotIndex, 10);
                        if (!isNaN(targetIndex)) {
                            this.goToSlide(targetIndex);
                        }
                    });
                });
            });

            // Accessibility: Pause autoplay on hover and focus
            this.carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this.stopAutoplay());
            this.carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this.startAutoplay());
            this.carousel.addEventListener('focusin', () => this.stopAutoplay());
            this.carousel.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
                if (!this.carousel.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    this.startAutoplay();
                }
            });
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const carouselEl = document.getElementById('hero-carousel');
        if (carouselEl) {
            new HeroCarousel(carouselEl, 7000);
        }
    });
})(window);

FILE: app\assets\js\mp-tables.js

/**
 * MemPulse read-only Tabulator helper (Tabulator 5.5.0, same build as deck-view.php).
 * Shared by sessions.php and session-details.php.
 *
 * Contains NO Tailwind classes on purpose: every class used in a table cell lives in the
 * PHP view that renders it, so Tailwind always sees it.
 *
 * Usage (from a view, on DOMContentLoaded):
 *   MPTable.applyTokens(document.getElementById('mp-token-probe'));
 *   MPTable.ensure(function () { MPTable.make('#my-table', rows, columns, { rowClick: ... }); });
 */
(function () {
    if (window.MPTable) return;

    var TABULATOR_JS = 'https://unpkg.com/tabulator-tables@5.5.0/dist/js/tabulator.min.js';

    // Structure + responsive layout adjustments
    var CSS = [
        '.mp-table .tabulator { background: transparent; border: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--mp-text, inherit); }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-header { background: var(--mp-head-bg, #f1f1f1) !important; color: var(--mp-head-text, inherit); border-top: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mp-border, #ddd); }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-header .tabulator-col { background: transparent !important; border-right: 0; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-header .tabulator-col .tabulator-col-content { padding: .75rem 1rem; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-header .tabulator-col .tabulator-col-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-tableholder, .mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-tableholder .tabulator-table { background: transparent; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-row, .mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-row.tabulator-row-even, .mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-row.tabulator-row-odd { background: transparent !important; color: inherit; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mp-divider, #eee); min-height: 0; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-row:hover { background: var(--mp-hover, rgba(0,0,0,.03)) !important; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-table > .tabulator-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-row .tabulator-cell { padding: .75rem 1rem; border-right: 0; vertical-align: middle; }',
        '.mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-header .tabulator-col .tabulator-col-resize-handle { display: none; }',
        '@media (max-width: 640px) {',
        '  .mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-header .tabulator-col .tabulator-col-content,',
        '  .mp-table .tabulator .tabulator-row .tabulator-cell { padding: .5rem .625rem; font-size: .8125rem; }',
        '}'
    ].join('\n');

    var styleEl = document.createElement('style');
    styleEl.id = 'mp-table-styles';
    styleEl.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(styleEl);

    // Read the Tailwind design tokens from the probe element and expose them as CSS variables
    function applyTokens(probe) {
        if (!probe) return;
        var q = function (t) { return probe.querySelector('[data-t="' + t + '"]'); };
        var s = document.documentElement.style;
        s.setProperty('--mp-head-bg', getComputedStyle(q('head')).backgroundColor);
        s.setProperty('--mp-head-text', getComputedStyle(q('head')).color);
        s.setProperty('--mp-text', getComputedStyle(q('text')).color);
        s.setProperty('--mp-hover', getComputedStyle(q('hover')).backgroundColor);
        s.setProperty('--mp-border', getComputedStyle(q('border')).borderTopColor);
        s.setProperty('--mp-divider', getComputedStyle(q('divider')).borderTopColor);
    }

    function esc(v) {
        return String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
            return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
        });
    }

    // Load Tabulator only if the page doesn't already have it
    function ensure(done) {
        if (window.Tabulator) return done();
        var sc = document.createElement('script');
        sc.src = TABULATOR_JS;
        sc.onload = done;
        sc.onerror = done;
        document.head.appendChild(sc);
    }

    // Read-only responsive defaults
    var base = {
        layout: 'fitColumns',
        responsiveLayout: 'hide',
        movableColumns: false,
        selectable: false,
        selectableRows: false,
        columnDefaults: { headerSort: false, resizable: false }
    };

    function make(selector, rows, columns, extra) {
        var el = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (!el) return null;
        if (typeof Tabulator === 'undefined') {
            console.error('Tabulator failed to load.');
            el.innerHTML = '<p style="padding:2rem;text-align:center;font-size:.875rem;opacity:.7">Table could not be loaded.</p>';
            return null;
        }
        var cols = columns.map(function (c) { return Object.assign({ headerSort: false, resizable: false }, c); });
        return new Tabulator(el, Object.assign({}, base, { data: rows, columns: cols }, extra || {}));
    }

    window.MPTable = { applyTokens: applyTokens, esc: esc, ensure: ensure, make: make };
})();

/**
 * PDF Reviewer: layout switch, remembered options and print button.
 * Works without a network; nothing is sent to the server.
 *
 * Rules for the layout:
 *   1. ?layout=beside|end in the URL wins (server marks it with data-layout-source="url")
 *   2. otherwise the last choice saved in localStorage
 *   3. otherwise "beside"
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var KEY_LAYOUT = 'mempulse.pdfReviewer.layout';
    var KEY_LINES = 'mempulse.pdfReviewer.lines';

    var sheet = document.getElementById('pr-sheet');
    if (!sheet) return;

    var radios = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="pr-layout"]'));
    var linesBox = document.getElementById('pr-lines');
    var linesWrap = document.getElementById('pr-lines-wrap');
    var printBtn = document.getElementById('pr-print-btn');

    // localStorage can throw (private mode, blocked storage): never let that break the page
    function readStore(key) {
        try { return window.localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; }
    }
    function writeStore(key, value) {
        try { window.localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }

    function applyLayout(layout, persist) {
        if (layout !== 'beside' && layout !== 'end') layout = 'beside';
        sheet.setAttribute('data-layout', layout);

        radios.forEach(function (r) { r.checked = (r.value === layout); });
        if (linesWrap) linesWrap.hidden = (layout === 'beside');   // writing space only matters in "end"

        if (persist) {
            writeStore(KEY_LAYOUT, layout);
            // keep the choice if the student refreshes or shares the link
            try {
                var url = new URL(window.location.href);
                url.searchParams.set('layout', layout);
                window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.toString());
            } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        }
    }

    function applyLines(on, persist) {
        sheet.setAttribute('data-lines', on ? '1' : '0');
        if (linesBox) linesBox.checked = on;
        if (persist) writeStore(KEY_LINES, on ? '1' : '0');
    }

    // ---- initial state -------------------------------------------------------
    var layoutFromUrl = document.body.getAttribute('data-layout-source') === 'url';
    var startLayout = sheet.getAttribute('data-layout');
    if (!layoutFromUrl) {
        var saved = readStore(KEY_LAYOUT);
        if (saved === 'beside' || saved === 'end') startLayout = saved;
    }
    applyLayout(startLayout, false);
    applyLines(readStore(KEY_LINES) !== '0', false);

    // ---- events --------------------------------------------------------------
    radios.forEach(function (r) {
        r.addEventListener('change', function () {
            if (r.checked) applyLayout(r.value, true);
        });
    });

    if (linesBox) {
        linesBox.addEventListener('change', function () {
            applyLines(linesBox.checked, true);
        });
    }

    if (printBtn) {
        printBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { window.print(); });
    }

    // Optional: ?autoprint=1 opens the print dialog once the page is ready
    if (document.body.getAttribute('data-autoprint') === '1') {
        var ready = (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();
        ready.then(function () { window.setTimeout(function () { window.print(); }, 250); });
    }
})();

/**
 * reports-cards.js
 * Cards tab charts: maturity doughnut + interval growth lines.
 * Requires Chart.js and reports.js (core) to load first.
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (!window.RP) return;

    var COLORS = {
        prev: '#94a3b8',
        next: '#3525cd',
        grid: 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)',
        text: '#464555'
    };

    function buildMaturity(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-maturity');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        var total = data.values.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [{ data: data.values, backgroundColor: data.colors, borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#ffffff' }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                cutout: '62%',
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },   // the HTML legend beside the chart is used instead
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function (ctx) {
                                var pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((ctx.parsed / total) * 100) : 0;
                                return ctx.label + ': ' + ctx.parsed + ' (' + pct + '%)';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }));
    }

    function buildInterval(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-interval');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [
                    {
                        label: 'Interval before review', data: data.prev, borderColor: COLORS.prev, backgroundColor: COLORS.prev,
                        borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 3, tension: 0.25, spanGaps: true
                    },
                    {
                        label: 'Interval after review', data: data.new, borderColor: COLORS.next, backgroundColor: COLORS.next,
                        borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 3, tension: 0.25, spanGaps: true
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                plugins: {
                    legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { usePointStyle: true, boxWidth: 8, color: COLORS.text } },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            title: function (items) { return 'Week of ' + items[0].label; },
                            label: function (ctx) {
                                return ctx.parsed.y === null ? null : ctx.dataset.label + ': ' + ctx.parsed.y + ' days';
                            },
                            afterBody: function (items) {
                                var n = data.counts[items[0].dataIndex];
                                return n ? n + ' reviews' : '';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: true, maxTicksLimit: 10 } },
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: COLORS.grid }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, precision: 0 },
                        title: { display: true, text: 'Days', color: COLORS.text }
                    }
                }
            }
        }));
    }

    RP.register('cards', function () {
        if (!window.Chart) {
            console.error('Reports: Chart.js did not load.');
            return;
        }
        var payload = RP.json('rp-cards-data') || {};
        buildMaturity(payload.maturity);
        buildInterval(payload.interval);
    });
})();

/**
 * reports-decks.js
 * Decks tab: sortable deck table + two horizontal bar charts.
 * Requires Chart.js and reports.js (core) to load first.
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (!window.RP) return;

    var COLORS = {
        primarySoft: 'rgba(53, 37, 205, 0.75)',
        teal: '#14b8a6',
        rest: 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55)',
        grid: 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)',
        text: '#464555'
    };

    /* ---------------- Sortable table ---------------- */
    (function initSort() {
        var table = document.getElementById('rp-decks-table');
        if (!table || !table.tBodies.length) return;

        var tbody = table.tBodies[0];
        var headers = Array.prototype.slice.call(table.querySelectorAll('thead th[data-sort]'));

        function cellValue(row, idx, type) {
            var cell = row.cells[idx];
            var v = cell ? cell.getAttribute('data-value') : '';
            if (type === 'num') {
                var n = parseFloat(v);
                return isNaN(n) ? -Infinity : n;
            }
            return (v || '').toString();
        }

        headers.forEach(function (th) {
            var btn = th.querySelector('button');
            if (!btn) return;

            btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                var idx = th.cellIndex;
                var type = th.getAttribute('data-sort');
                // Text columns start ascending, numeric columns start descending.
                var current = th.getAttribute('aria-sort');
                var asc;
                if (current === 'none') asc = (type === 'text');
                else asc = (current === 'descending');

                headers.forEach(function (h) { h.setAttribute('aria-sort', 'none'); });
                th.setAttribute('aria-sort', asc ? 'ascending' : 'descending');

                var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(tbody.rows);
                rows.sort(function (a, b) {
                    var va = cellValue(a, idx, type);
                    var vb = cellValue(b, idx, type);
                    var cmp = (type === 'num') ? (va - vb) : va.localeCompare(vb);
                    if (cmp === 0 || isNaN(cmp)) {
                        cmp = (a.cells[0].getAttribute('data-value') || '').localeCompare(b.cells[0].getAttribute('data-value') || '');
                    }
                    return asc ? cmp : -cmp;
                });
                rows.forEach(function (r) { tbody.appendChild(r); });
            });
        });
    })();

    /* ---------------- Row click -> drill-down ---------------- */
    (function initRowLinks() {
        var table = document.getElementById('rp-decks-table');
        if (!table || !table.tBodies.length) return;

        table.tBodies[0].addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (e.target.closest('a, button')) return;   // let real links work normally
            var row = e.target.closest('tr[data-href]');
            if (row) window.location.href = row.getAttribute('data-href');
        });
    })();

    /* ---------------- Charts ---------------- */
    function truncate(label, max) {
        label = String(label);
        return label.length > max ? label.slice(0, max - 1) + '…' : label;
    }

    function baseOptions() {
        return {
            indexAxis: 'y',
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } }
        };
    }

    function yAxis() {
        return {
            grid: { display: false },
            ticks: { color: COLORS.text, autoSkip: false, callback: function (v) { return truncate(this.getLabelForValue(v), 22); } }
        };
    }

    function buildReviews(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-deck-reviews');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        var opts = baseOptions();
        opts.scales = {
            x: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: COLORS.grid }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, precision: 0 } },
            y: yAxis()
        };
        opts.plugins.tooltip = {
            callbacks: {
                title: function (items) { return data.labels[items[0].dataIndex]; },
                afterLabel: function (ctx) {
                    var acc = data.accuracy[ctx.dataIndex];
                    return acc === null || acc === undefined ? 'Accuracy: n/a' : 'Accuracy: ' + acc + '%';
                }
            }
        };

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [{ label: 'Reviewed', data: data.reviews, backgroundColor: COLORS.primarySoft, borderRadius: 4, maxBarThickness: 22 }]
            },
            options: opts
        }));
    }

    function buildMastery(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-deck-mastery');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        var opts = baseOptions();
        opts.plugins.legend = { display: true, position: 'bottom', labels: { usePointStyle: true, boxWidth: 8, color: COLORS.text } };
        opts.scales = {
            x: { stacked: true, beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: COLORS.grid }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, precision: 0 } },
            y: Object.assign(yAxis(), { stacked: true })
        };
        opts.plugins.tooltip = {
            callbacks: { title: function (items) { return data.labels[items[0].dataIndex]; } }
        };

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [
                    { label: 'Mastered', data: data.mastered, backgroundColor: COLORS.teal, maxBarThickness: 22 },
                    { label: 'Not yet mastered', data: data.rest, backgroundColor: COLORS.rest, maxBarThickness: 22 }
                ]
            },
            options: opts
        }));
    }

    function buildTrend(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-deck-trend');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [
                    {
                        type: 'bar', label: 'Reviewed', data: data.reviewed, backgroundColor: COLORS.primarySoft,
                        borderRadius: 4, maxBarThickness: 28, yAxisID: 'y', order: 2
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'line', label: 'Accuracy', data: data.accuracy, borderColor: COLORS.teal,
                        backgroundColor: COLORS.teal, borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 3, tension: 0.25,
                        spanGaps: true, yAxisID: 'y1', order: 1
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                plugins: {
                    legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { usePointStyle: true, boxWidth: 8, color: COLORS.text } },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function (ctx) {
                                if (ctx.parsed.y === null) return null;
                                return ctx.dataset.label + ': ' + ctx.parsed.y + (ctx.dataset.yAxisID === 'y1' ? '%' : '');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: true, maxTicksLimit: 10 } },
                    y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: COLORS.grid }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, precision: 0 } },
                    y1: {
                        position: 'right', min: 0, max: 100, grid: { drawOnChartArea: false },
                        ticks: { color: COLORS.text, callback: function (v) { return v + '%'; } }
                    }
                }
            }
        }));
    }

    RP.register('decks', function () {
        if (!window.Chart) {
            console.error('Reports: Chart.js did not load.');
            return;
        }
        var payload = RP.json('rp-decks-data') || {};
        buildReviews(payload.reviews);
        buildMastery(payload.mastery);
        buildTrend(payload.trend);
    });
})();

/**
 * reports-overview.js
 * Builds the Overview tab charts. Requires Chart.js and reports.js (core) to load first.
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (!window.RP) return;

    var COLORS = {
        primary: '#3525cd',
        primarySoft: 'rgba(53, 37, 205, 0.75)',
        teal: '#0d9488',
        grid: 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)',
        text: '#464555',
        due: '#ba1a1a'
    };

    function baseOptions() {
        return {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
            plugins: {
                legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { usePointStyle: true, boxWidth: 8, color: COLORS.text } }
            }
        };
    }

    function buildTimeline(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-timeline');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        var opts = baseOptions();
        opts.scales = {
            x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: true, maxTicksLimit: 10 } },
            y: {
                beginAtZero: true,
                grid: { color: COLORS.grid },
                ticks: { color: COLORS.text, precision: 0 },
                title: { display: true, text: 'Cards reviewed', color: COLORS.text }
            },
            y1: {
                position: 'right',
                min: 0,
                max: 100,
                grid: { drawOnChartArea: false },
                ticks: { color: COLORS.text, callback: function (v) { return v + '%'; } },
                title: { display: true, text: 'Accuracy', color: COLORS.text }
            }
        };
        opts.plugins.tooltip = {
            callbacks: {
                label: function (ctx) {
                    if (ctx.parsed.y === null) return null;
                    return ctx.dataset.label + ': ' + ctx.parsed.y + (ctx.dataset.yAxisID === 'y1' ? '%' : '');
                }
            }
        };

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [
                    {
                        type: 'bar',
                        label: 'Reviewed',
                        data: data.reviewed,
                        backgroundColor: COLORS.primarySoft,
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        maxBarThickness: 28,
                        yAxisID: 'y',
                        order: 2
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'line',
                        label: 'Accuracy',
                        data: data.accuracy,          // null = no reviews that bucket (gap in the line)
                        borderColor: COLORS.teal,
                        backgroundColor: COLORS.teal,
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        pointRadius: 3,
                        tension: 0.25,
                        spanGaps: true,
                        yAxisID: 'y1',
                        order: 1
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: opts
        }));
    }

    function buildForecast(data) {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('rp-chart-forecast');
        if (!canvas || !data) return;

        var opts = baseOptions();
        opts.plugins.legend = { display: false };
        opts.scales = {
            x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: false, font: { size: 10 } } },
            y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: COLORS.grid }, ticks: { color: COLORS.text, precision: 0 } }
        };

        // First bar ("Due now") is highlighted.
        var bg = data.values.map(function (_, i) { return i === 0 ? COLORS.due : COLORS.primarySoft; });

        RP.track(new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: data.labels,
                datasets: [{ label: 'Cards due', data: data.values, backgroundColor: bg, borderRadius: 4, maxBarThickness: 36 }]
            },
            options: opts
        }));
    }

    RP.register('overview', function () {
        if (!window.Chart) {
            console.error('Reports: Chart.js did not load.');
            return;
        }
        var payload = RP.json('rp-overview-data') || {};
        buildTimeline(payload.timeline);
        buildForecast(payload.forecast);
    });
})();

/**
 * reports.js (core)
 *
 * - Filter form behaviour (auto-submit, custom date toggle)
 * - Accessible tabs (click, arrow keys, URL ?tab= sync)
 * - Chart registry so each tab builds its charts lazily, and ALL tabs
 *   build/resize their charts before printing.
 *
 * Tab scripts call: RP.register('overview', function () { ...build charts... });
 * and return Chart instances from RP.track(chart).
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var TAB_ORDER = ['overview', 'decks', 'cards', 'sessions'];
    var initFns = {};      // tab -> init function
    var initDone = {};     // tab -> true once initialised
    var charts = [];       // every Chart instance, for resize on print

    var RP = {
        register: function (tab, fn) {
            initFns[tab] = fn;
            // If the tab is already visible when its script loads, init now.
            var panel = document.getElementById('panel-' + tab);
            if (panel && !panel.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                RP.init(tab);
            }
        },
        init: function (tab) {
            if (initDone[tab] || !initFns[tab]) return;
            initDone[tab] = true;
            try { initFns[tab](); } catch (e) { console.error('Reports: init failed for ' + tab, e); }
        },
        track: function (chart) {
            if (chart) charts.push(chart);
            return chart;
        },
        resizeAll: function () {
            charts.forEach(function (c) { try { c.resize(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } });
        },
        json: function (id) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!el) return null;
            try { return JSON.parse(el.textContent); } catch (e) { return null; }
        }
    };
    window.RP = RP;

    /* ---------------- Filters ---------------- */
    var form = document.getElementById('rp-filters');
    if (form) {
        var range = document.getElementById('rp-range');
        var custom = document.getElementById('rp-custom-dates');
        var from = document.getElementById('rp-from');
        var to = document.getElementById('rp-to');

        function setCustomVisible(show) {
            custom.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
            from.disabled = !show;
            to.disabled = !show;
        }

        range.addEventListener('change', function () {
            if (range.value === 'custom') {
                setCustomVisible(true);   // wait for the user to press Apply
            } else {
                setCustomVisible(false);
                form.submit();
            }
        });

        ['rp-deck', 'rp-archived'].forEach(function (id) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.addEventListener('change', function () { form.submit(); });
        });
    }

    /* ---------------- Tabs ---------------- */
    var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"][data-tab]'));
    var panels = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('.rp-panel').forEach(function (p) { panels[p.dataset.tab] = p; });
    var tabInput = document.getElementById('rp-filter-tab');

    var ACTIVE = ['border-primary', 'text-primary'];
    var INACTIVE = ['border-transparent', 'text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface'];

    function showTab(name, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        if (!panels[name]) return;

        tabs.forEach(function (t) {
            var on = t.dataset.tab === name;
            t.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            t.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
            ACTIVE.forEach(function (c) { t.classList.toggle(c, on); });
            INACTIVE.forEach(function (c) { t.classList.toggle(c, !on); });
        });

        Object.keys(panels).forEach(function (key) {
            panels[key].classList.toggle('hidden', key !== name);
        });

        if (tabInput) tabInput.value = name;

        // Keep the URL shareable / refresh-safe without a reload.
        var url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.set('tab', name);
        window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.toString());

        // Build charts the first time a tab is shown; resize otherwise
        // (charts drawn in a hidden panel measure 0px wide).
        RP.init(name);
        RP.resizeAll();

        if (opts.focus) {
            var t = tabs.filter(function (x) { return x.dataset.tab === name; })[0];
            if (t) t.focus();
        }
    }

    tabs.forEach(function (t, i) {
        t.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            showTab(t.dataset.tab);
        });
        t.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            var idx = null;
            if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') idx = (i + 1) % tabs.length;
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') idx = (i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
            else if (e.key === 'Home') idx = 0;
            else if (e.key === 'End') idx = tabs.length - 1;
            if (idx !== null) {
                e.preventDefault();
                showTab(tabs[idx].dataset.tab, { focus: true });
            }
        });
    });

    /* ---------------- CSV export menu ---------------- */
    var exportMenu = document.getElementById('rp-export-menu');
    if (exportMenu) {
        var metaBox = document.getElementById('rp-export-meta');

        exportMenu.querySelectorAll('a[data-export]').forEach(function (a) {
            a.addEventListener('click', function () {
                // Add or remove the optional metadata header before the download starts.
                var url = new URL(a.getAttribute('href'), window.location.href);
                if (metaBox && metaBox.checked) url.searchParams.set('meta', '1');
                else url.searchParams.delete('meta');
                a.href = url.toString();
                exportMenu.removeAttribute('open');
            });
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (!exportMenu.contains(e.target)) exportMenu.removeAttribute('open');
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') exportMenu.removeAttribute('open');
        });
    }


    /* ---------------- Print ---------------- */
    // Print shows every panel. Canvases drawn at screen size (or inside hidden tabs)
    // print badly, so for printing we: reveal all panels, draw every tab's charts
    // without animation, swap each canvas for a scalable <img> snapshot, and force
    // the light theme so cards and text print dark-on-white.
    var printState = null;

    function preparePrint() {
        if (printState) return;

        var prevAnimation = window.Chart ? Chart.defaults.animation : undefined;
        if (window.Chart) Chart.defaults.animation = false;

        var revealed = [];
        Object.keys(panels).forEach(function (key) {
            if (panels[key].classList.contains('hidden')) {
                panels[key].classList.remove('hidden');
                revealed.push(key);
            }
        });

        // Build charts for tabs that were never opened on screen.
        TAB_ORDER.forEach(function (t) { RP.init(t); });

        var imgs = [];
        charts.forEach(function (c) {
            try {
                c.stop();
                c.resize();          // re-measure now that every panel is visible
                c.update('none');    // draw immediately, no animation
                var img = document.createElement('img');
                img.className = 'rp-chart-img';
                img.alt = c.canvas.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Chart';
                img.src = c.toBase64Image();
                c.canvas.parentNode.appendChild(img);
                imgs.push(img);
            } catch (e) { /* skip this chart */ }
        });

        // Dark theme would print dark cards; print in the light theme instead.
        var root = document.documentElement;
        var wasDark = root.classList.contains('dark');
        root.classList.remove('dark');
        root.classList.add('rp-printing');

        printState = { revealed: revealed, imgs: imgs, prevAnimation: prevAnimation, wasDark: wasDark };
    }

    function restorePrint() {
        if (!printState) return;

        var root = document.documentElement;
        printState.imgs.forEach(function (img) { img.remove(); });
        printState.revealed.forEach(function (key) { panels[key].classList.add('hidden'); });
        root.classList.remove('rp-printing');
        if (printState.wasDark) root.classList.add('dark');
        if (window.Chart) Chart.defaults.animation = printState.prevAnimation;
        printState = null;
        RP.resizeAll();
    }

    // Covers Ctrl+P / browser menu as well as the button below.
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', preparePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', restorePrint);

    var printBtn = document.getElementById('rp-print-btn');
    if (printBtn) {
        printBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            // Clear any leftover state if a previous afterprint never fired.
            restorePrint();
            // Wait for web fonts (icons, text) so they are ready for the print snapshot.
            var fontsReady = (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();
            fontsReady.then(function () { window.print(); });
        });
    }
})();
