FILE: app\assets\js\review.js
================================================================================
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const data = window.MemPulseReviewData;
    if (!data.deckId || !data.dueCards || data.dueCards.length === 0) return;

    // PRACTICE MODE: replay cards without saving anything. No saveSession(), no
    // unsaved-changes warning, no endpoint calls. `practice` can also be switched on
    // client-side from a normal review's finished screen ("Practice again").
    const randomPractice = data.mode === 'random';
    let practice = data.mode === 'practice' || randomPractice;
    const cleanCard = c => ({ id: c.id, front: c.front, back: c.back, interval_days: c.interval_days, next_review_at: c.next_review_at });
    let lastSet = data.dueCards.map(cleanCard);   // what "Practice again" replays
    let finishToken = 0;                          // cancels a running stats animation on restart

    let queue = data.dueCards.slice();
    if (randomPractice) {
        for (let i = queue.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
            [queue[i], queue[j]] = [queue[j], queue[i]];
        }
    }
    let currentIndex = 0;

    // State storage: track how the user rated each card ID
    // Format: { cardId: 'remembered' | 'forgotten' }
    let ratings = {};
    let isAnswerShown = false;
    let sessionEnded = false;

    const csrfToken = data.csrfToken || '';
    let sessionStartedAt = Date.now();
    let sessionDuration = 0;
    let unsavedRatings = false;
    let randomPracticeSaved = false;

    // "Again" puts the card back into this session's queue a few cards later.
    // It never writes to `ratings`, so nothing extra is saved for it.
    const AGAIN_OFFSET = 3;
    let uniqueTotal = queue.length;   // cards in this session, ignoring repeats

    // Scheduling rules, same as save-session.php. These defaults are replaced
    // by the user's saved settings as soon as they load (see loadSrsSettings).
    let srs = {
        remember_multiplier: 2,
        forgot_multiplier: 0.5,
        initial_interval_days: 1,
        maximum_interval_days: 365
    };

    function nextInterval(prevDays, status) {
        const multiplier = status === 'remembered' ? srs.remember_multiplier : srs.forgot_multiplier;
        const days = Math.round(prevDays * multiplier);
        return Math.max(srs.initial_interval_days, Math.min(srs.maximum_interval_days, days));
    }

    const formatDays = (d) => `in ${d} ${d === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'}`;

    function updateProjections() {
        if (practice) return;   // Forgot / Remember day labels are hidden in practice
        const card = queue[currentIndex];
        if (!card) return;
        const interval = parseInt(card.interval_days, 10) || 0;
        projForgot.textContent = formatDays(nextInterval(interval, 'forgotten'));
        projRemember.textContent = formatDays(nextInterval(interval, 'remembered'));
    }

    async function loadSrsSettings() {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('../api/settings-actions.php', { credentials: 'same-origin' });
            const body = await res.json();
            if (res.ok && body.success && body.settings) {
                srs = { ...srs, ...body.settings };
                updateProjections();
            }
        } catch (_) { /* keep the defaults */ }
    }

    // DOM Elements
    const elFront = document.getElementById('card-front-content');
    const elBack = document.getElementById('card-back-content');
    const elDivider = document.getElementById('card-divider');
    const btnShow = document.getElementById('show-answer-btn');
    const boxRates = document.getElementById('rate-actions');
    const btnForgot = document.getElementById('rate-forgot-btn');
    const btnRemember = document.getElementById('rate-remember-btn');
    const btnAgain = document.getElementById('rate-again-btn');
    const projForgot = document.getElementById('projected-forgot-date');
    const projRemember = document.getElementById('projected-remember-date');

    const txtProgress = document.getElementById('progress-text');
    const barProgress = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
    const txtRem = document.getElementById('tally-remembered');
    const txtFor = document.getElementById('tally-forgotten');
    const badgeHist = document.getElementById('historical-rating-badge');

    const viewActive = document.getElementById('active-review-container');
    const viewFinished = document.getElementById('review-finished-screen');

    const stage = document.getElementById('flashcard-stage');
    const hintReveal = document.getElementById('hint-reveal');
    const hintRate = document.getElementById('hint-rate');
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    let isAnimating = false;

    const btnMissed = document.getElementById('review-missed-btn');
    const returnLink = document.getElementById('return-hub-link');
    const btnPracticeAgain = document.getElementById('practice-again-btn');
    const practiceBanner = document.getElementById('practice-banner');
    const sumAccuracy = document.getElementById('summary-accuracy');
    const sumRem = document.getElementById('summary-remembered');
    const sumFor = document.getElementById('summary-forgotten');
    let missedCount = 0;
    let statsDone = Promise.resolve();

    const btnPrev = document.getElementById('prev-card-btn');
    const btnNext = document.getElementById('next-card-btn');

    // 1. Core Navigation & Display Logic
    function renderCard() {
        if (currentIndex >= queue.length) {
            endSession();
            return;
        }

        const card = queue[currentIndex];
        elFront.innerHTML = escapeHtml(card.front).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        elBack.innerHTML = escapeHtml(card.back).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');

        txtProgress.textContent = `Card ${currentIndex + 1} of ${queue.length}`;
        barProgress.style.width = `${(Object.keys(ratings).length / uniqueTotal) * 100}%`;

        // Badge: the earlier rating (via Back), or a note on Again / repeated cards
        const prevRating = ratings[card.id];
        badgeHist.classList.remove('hidden', 'bg-emerald-100', 'text-emerald-700',
            'bg-rose-100', 'text-rose-700', 'bg-amber-100', 'text-amber-700');
        if (prevRating === 'remembered') {
            badgeHist.textContent = 'Rated: Remembered';
            badgeHist.classList.add('bg-emerald-100', 'text-emerald-700');
        } else if (prevRating) {
            badgeHist.textContent = 'Rated: Forgotten';
            badgeHist.classList.add('bg-rose-100', 'text-rose-700');
        } else if (card._again) {
            badgeHist.textContent = 'Again: comes back later';
            badgeHist.classList.add('bg-amber-100', 'text-amber-700');
        } else if (card._repeat) {
            badgeHist.textContent = 'Repeat';
            badgeHist.classList.add('bg-amber-100', 'text-amber-700');
        } else {
            badgeHist.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        // Show when this card will come back for each rating
        updateProjections();

        hideAnswer();
        updateNavButtons();
    }

    function showAnswer() {
        if (sessionEnded || isAnimating || isAnswerShown) return;
        isAnswerShown = true;
        elBack.classList.remove('hidden');
        elDivider.classList.remove('hidden');
        btnShow.classList.add('hidden');
        boxRates.classList.remove('hidden');
        hintReveal.classList.add('hidden');
        hintRate.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (!reduceMotion) {
            elBack.animate(
                [{ opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(-6px)' }, { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' }],
                { duration: 200, easing: 'ease-out' });
        }
    }

    function hideAnswer() {
        isAnswerShown = false;
        elBack.classList.add('hidden');
        elDivider.classList.add('hidden');
        btnShow.classList.remove('hidden');
        boxRates.classList.add('hidden');
        hintReveal.classList.remove('hidden');
        hintRate.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // 2. Rating & Tally Logic
    async function rateCard(status) {
        if (sessionEnded || isAnimating) return;
        const card = queue[currentIndex];
        ratings[card.id] = status;
        unsavedRatings = !practice;
        updateTally(status);

        const dir = status === 'remembered' ? 1 : -1;
        const glow = status === 'remembered' ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.35)' : 'rgba(244,63,94,0.35)';
        return advanceCard(dir, glow);
    }

    // Plays the exit animation for the current card, then deals the next one.
    async function advanceCard(dir, glow) {
        if (reduceMotion) {
            currentIndex++;
            renderCard();
            return;
        }

        isAnimating = true;
        const out = stage.animate([
            { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateX(0) rotate(0deg)', boxShadow: `0 0 0 0 ${glow}` },
            { opacity: 0, transform: `translateX(${dir * 64}px) rotate(${dir * 2}deg)`, boxShadow: `0 0 0 6px ${glow}` }
        ], { duration: 220, easing: 'ease-in', fill: 'forwards' });
        await out.finished;

        currentIndex++;
        renderCard();
        out.cancel();

        if (!sessionEnded) {
            stage.animate([
                { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(14px) scale(0.98)' },
                { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0) scale(1)' }
            ], { duration: 240, easing: 'ease-out' });
        }
        isAnimating = false;
    }

    // Again: no rating is saved; a copy of the card comes back a few cards later.
    async function againCard() {
        if (sessionEnded || isAnimating) return;
        const card = queue[currentIndex];

        if (ratings[card.id]) {              // reached with Back: un-rate it
            delete ratings[card.id];
            updateTally();
            unsavedRatings = !practice && Object.keys(ratings).length > 0;
        }

        card._again = true;                  // this slot can be skipped with Next

        // Remove any copy already waiting ahead, then insert a fresh one
        queue = queue.filter((c, i) => i <= currentIndex || c.id !== card.id);
        const insertAt = Math.min(currentIndex + 1 + AGAIN_OFFSET, queue.length);
        queue.splice(insertAt, 0, { ...card, _again: false, _repeat: true });

        return advanceCard(0, 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35)');
    }

    function updateTally(bumpStatus) {
        let rem = 0, forg = 0;
        Object.values(ratings).forEach(r => r === 'remembered' ? rem++ : forg++);
        txtRem.textContent = rem;
        txtFor.textContent = forg;
        if (bumpStatus && !reduceMotion) {
            (bumpStatus === 'remembered' ? txtRem : txtFor).animate(
                [{ transform: 'scale(1)' }, { transform: 'scale(1.4)' }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }],
                { duration: 280, easing: 'ease-out' });
        }
    }

    // 3. Backward/Forward Queue Navigation
    function prevCard() {
        if (sessionEnded || isAnimating || currentIndex === 0) return; {
            currentIndex--;
            renderCard();
            slideIn(-1);
        }
    }

    // Back is available after the first card; Next only once the current card has a rating (or was sent to Again)
    function updateNavButtons() {
        btnPrev.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
        const card = queue[currentIndex];
        btnNext.disabled = !(card && (ratings[card.id] || card._again));
    }

    function slideIn(dir) {
        if (reduceMotion) return;
        stage.animate([
            { opacity: 0, transform: `translateX(${dir * 28}px)` },
            { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateX(0)' }
        ], { duration: 200, easing: 'ease-out' });
    }

    function skipToNext() {
        if (sessionEnded || isAnimating) return;
        const card = queue[currentIndex];
        if (!card || !(ratings[card.id] || card._again)) return;   // only skip cards already rated or sent to Again
        currentIndex++;
        renderCard();
        if (!sessionEnded) slideIn(1);
    }

    // 4. Batch Save & Session End
    async function saveSession() {
        const res = await fetch('../api/save-session.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                deck_id: data.deckId,
                results: ratings,
                csrf_token: csrfToken,
                duration_seconds: sessionDuration
            })
        });
        let body = {};
        try { body = await res.json(); } catch (_) { }
        if (!res.ok || !body.ok) {
            throw new Error(body.error || `Save failed (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
        }
        unsavedRatings = false;
        return body;
    }

    async function saveRandomPractice() {
        if (randomPracticeSaved) return { ok: true, alreadySaved: true };
        const res = await fetch('../api/save-random-practice.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            body: JSON.stringify({
                deck_id: data.deckId,
                label: 'Random Practice',
                results: ratings,
                duration_seconds: sessionDuration,
                csrf_token: csrfToken
            })
        });
        let body = {};
        try { body = await res.json(); } catch (_) { }
        if (!res.ok || !body.ok) throw new Error(body.error || `Save failed (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
        randomPracticeSaved = true;
        return body;
    }

    function showSaveError(message) {
        let box = document.getElementById('save-status');
        if (!box) {
            box = document.createElement('div');
            box.id = 'save-status';
            box.className = 'w-full max-w-sm mb-6 p-4 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 text-sm flex flex-col gap-3';
            viewFinished.insertBefore(box, document.getElementById('finished-actions'));
        }
        box.textContent = '';

        const p = document.createElement('p');
        p.textContent = `Your session wasn't saved: ${message}`;

        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.className = 'px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-semibold';
        btn.textContent = 'Retry save';
        btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            btn.disabled = true;
            try {
                if (randomPractice) await saveRandomPractice(); else await saveSession(); box.remove(); armMissedButton();
            } catch (err) { showSaveError(err.message); }
        });

        box.append(p, btn);
    }

    async function endSession() {
        if (sessionEnded) return;
        sessionEnded = true;
        sessionDuration = Math.round((Date.now() - sessionStartedAt) / 1000);
        viewActive.classList.add('hidden');
        viewFinished.classList.remove('hidden');
        viewFinished.classList.add('flex');   // fixes the off-center completion screen

        if (!reduceMotion) {
            document.getElementById('finished-icon').animate(
                [{ transform: 'scale(0.6)', opacity: 0 }, { transform: 'scale(1.08)', opacity: 1 }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }],
                { duration: 450, easing: 'ease-out' });
        }

        const ratedIds = Object.keys(ratings);
        if (ratedIds.length === 0) {
            if (practice) {
                document.getElementById('finished-headline').textContent = randomPractice ? 'Random Practice Complete' : 'Practice complete';
                showPracticeAgain(false);
                styleFinishedButtons(false);
                if (randomPractice) {
                    try { await saveRandomPractice(); } catch (error) { showSaveError(error.message); }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        const total = ratedIds.length;
        const remCount = Object.values(ratings).filter(r => r === 'remembered').length;
        const forgCount = total - remCount;
        const accuracy = Math.round((remCount / total) * 100);

        // document.getElementById('finished-headline').textContent = headlineFor(accuracy);
        document.getElementById('session-summary-stats').classList.remove('hidden');

        if (forgCount > 0) {
            missedCount = forgCount;
            btnMissed.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (practice) {
                setMissedLabel();            // nothing to wait for: enabled right away
                btnMissed.disabled = false;
            } else {
                btnMissed.disabled = true;
                btnMissed.textContent = 'Saving…';
            }
        }
        // Practice again: in a real review it unlocks once the save has succeeded
        showPracticeAgain(!practice);
        styleFinishedButtons(forgCount > 0);

        // Confetti pop + stats showcase run alongside the save
        // confettiBurst({ x: 0.5, y: 0.35, count: accuracy >= 80 ? 170 : 120, power: 17 });
        statsDone = showStats(remCount, forgCount, accuracy);

        if (practice) {
            if (randomPractice) {
                try { await saveRandomPractice(); armMissedButton(); }
                catch (error) { console.error('Failed to save random practice:', error); showSaveError(error.message); }
            } else {
                armMissedButton(); // replay practice is intentionally not persisted
            }
            return;
        }

        try {
            await saveSession();
            armMissedButton();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Failed to save session batch:", error);
            showSaveError(error.message);
        }
    }

    // 5. Event Listeners
    btnShow.addEventListener('click', showAnswer);
    btnForgot.addEventListener('click', () => rateCard('forgotten'));
    btnRemember.addEventListener('click', () => rateCard('remembered'));
    btnAgain.addEventListener('click', againCard);
    document.getElementById('end-session-btn').addEventListener('click', endSession);
    btnPrev.addEventListener('click', e => { prevCard(); e.currentTarget.blur(); });
    btnNext.addEventListener('click', e => { skipToNext(); e.currentTarget.blur(); });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (sessionEnded || isAnimating) return;

        switch (e.key) {
            case ' ':
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!isAnswerShown) showAnswer();
                else rateCard('remembered'); // Second spacebar defaults to remember & advance
                break;
            case 'a':
            case 'A':
                if (isAnswerShown) againCard();
                break;
            case 'f':
            case 'F':
                if (isAnswerShown) rateCard('forgotten');
                break;
            case 'ArrowLeft':
                prevCard();
                break;
            case 'ArrowRight':
                skipToNext();
                break;
        }
    });

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', (e) => {
        if (unsavedRatings) { e.preventDefault(); e.returnValue = ''; }
    });

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Finished screen: headline, missed-cards button, stats showcase
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const sleep = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

    function headlineFor(accuracy) {
        if (practice) return 'Practice complete';
        if (accuracy >= 80) return 'Solid session';
        if (accuracy >= 50) return 'Good progress';
        return 'Those will come back soon';
    }

    // Real review: enabled only after the save succeeded, so forgotten cards are due again on reload.
    // Practice: nothing is saved, so everything is enabled right away.
    async function armMissedButton() {
        if (!practice) await statsDone;   // don't let the user jump away mid-stamp
        btnPracticeAgain.disabled = false;
        if (missedCount < 1) return;
        setMissedLabel();
        btnMissed.disabled = false;
    }

    function setMissedLabel() {
        const noun = missedCount === 1 ? 'card' : 'cards';
        btnMissed.textContent = practice
            ? `Practice ${missedCount} missed ${noun}`
            : `Review ${missedCount} missed ${noun}`;
    }

    const PRIMARY_BTN = ['bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'shadow-sm', 'hover:bg-primary-container'];
    const SECONDARY_BTN = ['border', 'border-outline-variant', 'text-on-surface', 'hover:bg-surface-container-low'];
    function setPrimary(el, primary) {
        el.classList.remove(...PRIMARY_BTN, ...SECONDARY_BTN);
        el.classList.add(...(primary ? PRIMARY_BTN : SECONDARY_BTN));
    }

    // Missed button is always the main action when shown; otherwise Practice again leads in
    // practice mode and the Back / Return link leads in a real review.
    function styleFinishedButtons(hasMissed) {
        setPrimary(btnPracticeAgain, practice && !hasMissed);
        setPrimary(returnLink, !practice && !hasMissed);
    }

    function showPracticeAgain(disabled) {
        btnPracticeAgain.disabled = disabled;
        btnPracticeAgain.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function setPracticeMode(on) {
        practice = on;
        practiceBanner?.classList.toggle('hidden', !on);
        projForgot.classList.toggle('hidden', on);
        projRemember.classList.toggle('hidden', on);
        if (on) {
            returnLink.href = data.returnUrl || 'review.php';
            returnLink.textContent = 'Back';
        }
    }

    // Deals a fresh set of cards. Shared by "missed" and "practice" restarts.
    function resetSession(cards) {
        queue = cards;
        uniqueTotal = cards.length;
        currentIndex = 0;
        ratings = {};
        isAnswerShown = false;
        sessionEnded = false;
        unsavedRatings = false;
        sessionStartedAt = Date.now();
        sessionDuration = 0;
        randomPracticeSaved = false;
        missedCount = 0;
        finishToken++;

        // Reset header tally and finished screen
        txtRem.textContent = '0';
        txtFor.textContent = '0';
        sumAccuracy.textContent = '0%';
        sumRem.textContent = '0';
        sumFor.textContent = '0';
        document.getElementById('summary-accuracy-bar').style.width = '0%';
        document.getElementById('session-summary-stats').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('finished-headline').textContent = practice ? 'Practice complete' : 'Session Complete!';
        document.getElementById('save-status')?.remove();
        document.getElementById('practice-skipped')?.classList.add('hidden');   // only about the first set
        btnMissed.classList.add('hidden');
        btnPracticeAgain.classList.add('hidden');
        styleFinishedButtons(false);

        // Swap views and deal the first card
        viewFinished.classList.add('hidden');
        viewFinished.classList.remove('flex');
        viewActive.classList.remove('hidden');
        renderCard();
    }

    function startMissedSession() {
        // A card can sit in the queue twice (Again), so keep one entry per card
        const seen = new Set();
        const missed = queue
            .filter(c => ratings[c.id] === 'forgotten' && !seen.has(c.id) && seen.add(c.id))
            .map(c => ({ ...c, _again: false, _repeat: false }));
        if (missed.length === 0) return;

        // Real review: save-session.php just gave these cards their "forgot" interval, so mirror it locally.
        // Practice: the server never changed anything, so leave the intervals alone.
        if (!practice) {
            missed.forEach(c => { c.interval_days = nextInterval(parseInt(c.interval_days, 10) || 0, 'forgotten'); });
        }

        lastSet = missed.map(cleanCard);
        resetSession(missed);
    }

    // Replays a set of cards in practice mode (nothing is saved)
    function startPractice(cards) {
        if (!cards.length) return;
        setPracticeMode(true);
        lastSet = cards.map(cleanCard);
        resetSession(lastSet.map(c => ({ ...c })));
    }
    btnMissed.addEventListener('click', startMissedSession);
    btnPracticeAgain.addEventListener('click', () => startPractice(lastSet));

    // function countUp(el, to, { duration = 900, suffix = '' } = {}) {
    //     if (reduceMotion || to === 0) {
    //         el.textContent = to + suffix;
    //         return Promise.resolve();

    async function showStats(rem, forg, accuracy) {
        const token = finishToken;
        const headline = document.getElementById('finished-headline');
        const bar = document.getElementById('summary-accuracy-bar');
        const tiles = document.querySelectorAll('#session-summary-stats [data-stat-tile]');
        const [tileAcc, tileRem, tileFor] = tiles;   // DOM order: Accuracy, Remembered, Forgotten

        sumAccuracy.textContent = accuracy + '%';
        sumRem.textContent = rem;
        sumFor.textContent = forg;

        if (reduceMotion) {
            bar.style.width = accuracy + '%';
            headline.textContent = headlineFor(accuracy);
            return;
        }

        // Empty frames fade in first; each number stays hidden until its stamp lands
        [sumAccuracy, sumRem, sumFor].forEach(el => { el.style.opacity = '0'; });
        bar.style.width = '0%';
        tiles.forEach(tile => tile.animate(
            [{ opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(12px)' }, { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' }],
            { duration: 350, easing: 'ease-out', fill: 'backwards' }));

        await sleep(500);
        if (token !== finishToken) return;
        await stampStat(sumRem, tileRem, 'border-emerald-400', { scale: 3, duration: 520, shakePx: 4 });
        if (token !== finishToken) return;
        await sleep(300);
        if (token !== finishToken) return;
        await stampStat(sumFor, tileFor, 'border-rose-400', { scale: 3, duration: 520, shakePx: 4 });
        if (token !== finishToken) return;
        await sleep(650);   // beat of suspense before the hero number
        if (token !== finishToken) return;
        await stampStat(sumAccuracy, tileAcc, 'border-primary', { scale: 4.5, duration: 720, shakePx: 10, hero: true });
        if (token !== finishToken) return;

        // Climax: bar fills, headline appears, confetti explodes
        bar.animate([{ width: '0%' }, { width: accuracy + '%' }],
            { duration: 900, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)' });
        bar.style.width = accuracy + '%';

        headline.textContent = headlineFor(accuracy);
        headline.animate(
            [{ opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(10px)' }, { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' }],
            { duration: 350, easing: 'ease-out' });

        celebrate(accuracy, token);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Celebration by accuracy tier
    //   100%    confetti + trophy/star emoji
    //   80-99%  confetti (unchanged)
    //   50-79%  emoji burst instead of confetti
    //   1-49%   emoji float up gently
    //   0%      emoji drift down like light rain
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const EMOJI_SETS = {
        perfect: ['🏆', '⭐', '🎉', '🌟'],
        okay: ['👍', '💪', '🙂', '✨'],
        low: ['🌱', '📚', '🔁', '💡'],
        zero: ['😅', '🫠', '🙈', '💪']
    };

    async function celebrate(accuracy, token) {
        const cancelled = () => token !== finishToken;

        // Classic confetti: 3 bursts (center + both sides)
        const confettiTrio = (big) => {
            confettiBurst({ x: 0.5, y: 0.3, count: big ? 170 : 120, power: 17 });
            const n = big ? 90 : 60;
            confettiBurst({ x: 0, y: 0.75, count: n, angle: -Math.PI / 3, spread: Math.PI / 3, power: 22 });
            confettiBurst({ x: 1, y: 0.75, count: n, angle: -2 * Math.PI / 3, spread: Math.PI / 3, power: 22 });
        };

        if (accuracy >= 100) {
            confettiTrio(true);
            confettiBurst({ x: 0.5, y: 0.3, count: 28, power: 15, emojis: EMOJI_SETS.perfect, size: 30 });
            return;
        }

        if (accuracy >= 80) {
            confettiTrio(true);
            return;
        }

        if (accuracy >= 50) {
            // Emoji burst, same layout as the confetti but fewer and slightly floatier
            confettiBurst({ x: 0.5, y: 0.3, count: 36, power: 15, emojis: EMOJI_SETS.okay, size: 30, gravity: 0.3 });
            confettiBurst({
                x: 0, y: 0.75, count: 16, angle: -Math.PI / 3, spread: Math.PI / 3, power: 20,
                emojis: EMOJI_SETS.okay, size: 28, gravity: 0.3
            });
            confettiBurst({
                x: 1, y: 0.75, count: 16, angle: -2 * Math.PI / 3, spread: Math.PI / 3, power: 20,
                emojis: EMOJI_SETS.okay, size: 28, gravity: 0.3
            });
            return;
        }

        if (accuracy > 0) {
            // Gentle rise: small waves from the bottom, floating up like balloons
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                confettiBurst({
                    x: 0.12 + i * 0.19, y: 1.02, count: 5, angle: -Math.PI / 2, spread: Math.PI / 4,
                    power: 5, gravity: -0.07, emojis: EMOJI_SETS.low, size: 30
                });
                await sleep(180);
                if (cancelled()) return;
            }
            return;
        }

        // 0%: light rain from the top, plus a tiny shake. Kind emoji, no burst.
        shake(viewFinished, 3);
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            confettiBurst({
                x: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.8, y: -0.05, count: 4, angle: Math.PI / 2, spread: Math.PI / 6,
                power: 2, gravity: 0.12, emojis: EMOJI_SETS.zero, size: 30
            });
            await sleep(220);
            if (cancelled()) return;
        }
    }

    // A number slams in from huge and blurry, squashes on impact, then settles.
    // Resolves at the moment of impact so the caller can chain the next beat.
    function stampStat(el, tile, ringClass, { scale = 3, duration = 520, shakePx = 5, hero = false } = {}) {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            el.style.opacity = '1';
            el.animate([
                { opacity: 0, transform: `scale(${scale}) rotate(-14deg)`, filter: 'blur(6px)', offset: 0, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.5,0,1,.6)' },
                { opacity: 1, transform: 'scale(0.9) rotate(2deg)', filter: 'blur(0px)', offset: 0.55 },
                { transform: 'scale(1.06) rotate(-1deg)', offset: 0.75 },
                { transform: 'scale(1) rotate(0deg)', offset: 1 }
            ], { duration, easing: 'linear' });

            setTimeout(() => {
                impactRing(tile, ringClass);
                if (hero) setTimeout(() => impactRing(tile, ringClass), 130);
                tile.animate(
                    [{ transform: 'scale(1)' }, { transform: 'scale(0.96)' }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }],
                    { duration: 260, easing: 'ease-out' });
                shake(viewFinished, shakePx);
                resolve();
            }, duration * 0.55);
        });
    }

    function impactRing(tile, colorClass) {
        tile.classList.add('relative');
        const ring = document.createElement('div');
        ring.className = `absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl border-2 pointer-events-none ${colorClass}`;
        tile.appendChild(ring);
        ring.animate(
            [{ opacity: 0.9, transform: 'scale(1)' }, { opacity: 0, transform: 'scale(1.35)' }],
            { duration: 520, easing: 'ease-out' }
        ).finished.then(() => ring.remove());
    }

    function shake(el, px = 6, duration = 380) {
        el.animate([
            { transform: 'translate(0, 0)' },
            { transform: `translate(${-px}px, ${px * 0.5}px)` },
            { transform: `translate(${px}px, ${-px * 0.5}px)` },
            { transform: `translate(${-px * 0.6}px, 0)` },
            { transform: `translate(${px * 0.4}px, 0)` },
            { transform: 'translate(0, 0)' }
        ], { duration, easing: 'ease-out' });
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Confetti (tiny canvas engine, no dependencies)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const CONFETTI_COLORS = ['#10b981', '#34d399', '#6366f1', '#f59e0b', '#f43f5e', '#38bdf8'];
    let confettiCanvas = null, confettiCtx = null, confettiParts = [], confettiRaf = null;

    // Optional extras: `emojis` (array) draws emoji instead of colored paper,
    // `gravity` (negative = float up), `size` (emoji font size in px).
    function confettiBurst({ x = 0.5, y = 0.4, count = 120, angle = -Math.PI / 2, spread = Math.PI * 2, power = 15,
        emojis = null, gravity = 0.38, size = 28 } = {}) {
        if (reduceMotion) return;

        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        if (!confettiCanvas) {
            confettiCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            confettiCanvas.className = 'fixed inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-[60]';
            document.body.appendChild(confettiCanvas);
            confettiCtx = confettiCanvas.getContext('2d');
        }
        if (confettiCanvas.width !== Math.round(innerWidth * dpr)) {
            confettiCanvas.width = Math.round(innerWidth * dpr);
            confettiCanvas.height = Math.round(innerHeight * dpr);
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const a = angle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread;
            const v = power * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.7);
            confettiParts.push({
                x: x * innerWidth, y: y * innerHeight,
                vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vy: Math.sin(a) * v,
                w: 6 + Math.random() * 6, h: 4 + Math.random() * 5,
                rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
                wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                color: CONFETTI_COLORS[(Math.random() * CONFETTI_COLORS.length) | 0],
                emoji: emojis ? emojis[(Math.random() * emojis.length) | 0] : null,
                size: size * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4),
                g: gravity,
                life: 0, ttl: 110 + Math.random() * 60
            });
        }
        if (!confettiRaf) confettiRaf = requestAnimationFrame(stepConfetti);
    }

    function stepConfetti() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        confettiCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        confettiCtx.clearRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight);

        confettiParts = confettiParts.filter(p => p.life < p.ttl && p.y < innerHeight + 40);
        for (const p of confettiParts) {
            p.life++;
            p.vx *= 0.985;
            p.vy = p.vy * 0.985 + p.g;                  // drag + gravity
            p.wobble += 0.12;
            p.x += p.vx + Math.sin(p.wobble) * 0.6;
            p.y += p.vy;
            p.rot += p.vr;

            confettiCtx.save();
            confettiCtx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (p.ttl - p.life) / 30);
            confettiCtx.translate(p.x, p.y);
            if (p.emoji) {
                confettiCtx.rotate(p.rot * 0.25);                 // gentle tilt, no flutter squash
                confettiCtx.font = `${p.size}px "Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif`;
                confettiCtx.textAlign = 'center';
                confettiCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                confettiCtx.fillText(p.emoji, 0, 0);
            } else {
                confettiCtx.rotate(p.rot);
                confettiCtx.scale(1, Math.abs(Math.cos(p.wobble)));   // flutter
                confettiCtx.fillStyle = p.color;
                confettiCtx.fillRect(-p.w / 2, -p.h / 2, p.w, p.h);
            }
            confettiCtx.restore();
        }

        if (confettiParts.length) {
            confettiRaf = requestAnimationFrame(stepConfetti);
        } else {
            confettiRaf = null;
            confettiCanvas.remove();
            confettiCanvas = null;
        }
    }

    // Utilities
    function escapeHtml(text) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.textContent = text;
        return div.innerHTML;
    }

    // Init
    if (practice) {
        setPracticeMode(true);
        if (randomPractice) {
            const bannerCopy = practiceBanner?.querySelector('p');
            if (bannerCopy) bannerCopy.textContent = 'Random Practice: saved separately and excluded from SRS statistics';
            document.getElementById('finished-headline').textContent = 'Random Practice Complete';
        }
    } else loadSrsSettings();   // practice never needs the interval settings
    renderCard();
});

<?php
/**
 * AdminActivityService
 *
 * Platform-wide study session & review log telemetry for the Admin Activity page.
 * Aggregates retention accuracy, response time (ms), active learners, 90-day trend series,
 * and filterable session history.
 */
class AdminActivityService
{
    public const PER_PAGE = 15;
    public const RANGES   = [7, 30, 90];

    private const SORTS = [
        'started'  => 'rs.started_at',
        'learner'  => 'u.first_name',
        'reviewed' => 'rs.total_reviewed',
        'accuracy' => 'rs.accuracy_percentage',
        'duration' => 'duration_sec',
    ];

    public static function parseFilters(array $get): array
    {
        $str  = fn($k) => is_string($get[$k] ?? null) ? trim($get[$k]) : '';
        $date = function (string $v): string {
            $d = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $v);
            return ($d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $v) ? $v : '';
        };
        $sort  = $str('sort');
        $state = $str('state');

        return [
            'q'     => mb_substr($str('q'), 0, 100),
            'state' => in_array($state, ['completed', 'in_progress', 'high_acc', 'low_acc'], true) ? $state : '',
            'from'  => $date($str('from')),
            'to'    => $date($str('to')),
            'sort'  => isset(self::SORTS[$sort]) ? $sort : 'started',
            'dir'   => $str('dir') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
            'page'  => max(1, (int) ($get['page'] ?? 1)),
        ];
    }

    public static function buildQuery(array $f, array $override = []): string
    {
        $f = array_merge($f, $override);
        $q = array_filter([
            'q'     => $f['q'],
            'state' => $f['state'],
            'from'  => $f['from'],
            'to'    => $f['to'],
            'sort'  => $f['sort'] !== 'started' ? $f['sort'] : '',
            'dir'   => $f['dir'] !== 'desc' ? $f['dir'] : '',
            'page'  => $f['page'] > 1 ? (string) $f['page'] : '',
        ], fn($v) => $v !== '');
        return $q ? '?' . http_build_query($q) : '';
    }

    public static function getSummary(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $out = [
            'sessions30d'    => 0,
            'sessionsToday'  => 0,
            'reviews30d'     => 0,
            'retention30d'   => 0.0,
            'avgResponseSec' => 0.0,
            'activeToday'    => 0,
            'active7d'       => 0,
        ];

        $sql = "SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS sessions_30d,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= CURDATE()) AS sessions_today,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS reviews_30d,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(remembered_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) * 100, 1), 0)
               FROM review_sessions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS retention_30d,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(response_time_ms) / 1000, 2), 0)
               FROM review_logs WHERE response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS avg_resp_sec,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM review_sessions WHERE started_at >= CURDATE()) AS active_today,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM review_sessions WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS active_7d";

        $res = mysqli_query($conn, $sql);
        if ($res) {
            if ($r = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res)) {
                $out['sessions30d']    = (int) $r['sessions_30d'];
                $out['sessionsToday']  = (int) $r['sessions_today'];
                $out['reviews30d']     = (int) $r['reviews_30d'];
                $out['retention30d']   = (float) $r['retention_30d'];
                $out['avgResponseSec'] = (float) $r['avg_resp_sec'];
                $out['activeToday']    = (int) $r['active_today'];
                $out['active7d']       = (int) $r['active_7d'];
            }
            mysqli_free_result($res);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Daily series for the Activity chart (Remembered cards, Forgot cards, Retention %).
     *
     * @param int $days One of self::RANGES (defaults to 90 for client-side slicing).
     * @return array Keys: labels, remembered, forgot, retention.
     */
    public static function getTrend(mysqli $conn, int $days = 90): array
    {
        $days = in_array($days, self::RANGES, true) ? $days : 90;
        $out  = ['labels' => [], 'remembered' => [], 'forgot' => [], 'retention' => []];

        $today = null;
        if ($res = mysqli_query($conn, 'SELECT CURDATE()')) {
            $row   = mysqli_fetch_row($res);
            $today = $row[0] ?? null;
            mysqli_free_result($res);
        }
        if (!$today) {
            return $out;
        }

        $offset = $days - 1;
        $rows = self::fetchRows(
            $conn,
            "SELECT DATE(started_at) AS d,
                    COALESCE(SUM(remembered_count), 0) AS rem,
                    COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(total_reviewed - remembered_count, 0)), 0) AS fgt,
                    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(remembered_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) * 100, 1), 0) AS ret
               FROM review_sessions
              WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ? DAY
              GROUP BY d",
            'i',
            [$offset]
        );

        $byDay = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $byDay[$r['d']] = [
                'rem' => (int) $r['rem'],
                'fgt' => (int) $r['fgt'],
                'ret' => (float) $r['ret'],
            ];
        }

        $end = new DateTimeImmutable($today);
        for ($i = $offset; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $key = $end->modify("-$i days")->format('Y-m-d');
            $out['labels'][]     = $key;
            $out['remembered'][] = $byDay[$key]['rem'] ?? 0;
            $out['forgot'][]     = $byDay[$key]['fgt'] ?? 0;
            $out['retention'][]  = $byDay[$key]['ret'] ?? 0;
        }

        return $out;
    }

    public static function getList(mysqli $conn, array $f, bool $exportAll = false): array
    {
        $empty = [
            'available' => false, 'rows' => [], 'total' => 0,
            'page' => 1, 'pages' => 1, 'first' => 0, 'last' => 0,
        ];

        $where  = ['u.deleted_at IS NULL'];
        $types  = '';
        $params = [];

        if ($f['q'] !== '') {
            $like    = '%' . addcslashes($f['q'], '%_\\') . '%';
            $where[] = "(u.first_name LIKE ? OR u.last_name LIKE ? OR u.email LIKE ? OR CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) LIKE ?)";
            $types  .= 'ssss';
            array_push($params, $like, $like, $like, $like);
        }

        if ($f['state'] === 'completed') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL';
        } elseif ($f['state'] === 'in_progress') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NULL';
        } elseif ($f['state'] === 'high_acc') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND rs.accuracy_percentage >= 85';
        } elseif ($f['state'] === 'low_acc') {
            $where[] = 'rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND rs.total_reviewed > 0 AND rs.accuracy_percentage < 60';
        }

        if ($f['from'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'rs.started_at >= ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = $f['from'] . ' 00:00:00';
        }
        if ($f['to'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'rs.started_at < ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = (new DateTimeImmutable($f['to']))->modify('+1 day')->format('Y-m-d') . ' 00:00:00';
        }

        $whereSql = implode(' AND ', $where);

        $c = self::fetchRows(
            $conn,
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM review_sessions rs JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id WHERE $whereSql",
            $types,
            $params
        );
        if (!$c) {
            return $empty;
        }

        $total  = (int) $c[0]['n'];
        $pages  = max(1, (int) ceil($total / self::PER_PAGE));
        $page   = min($f['page'], $pages);
        $offset = ($page - 1) * self::PER_PAGE;

        $col      = self::SORTS[$f['sort']] ?? 'rs.started_at';
        $dir      = $f['dir'] === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
        $limitSql = $exportAll ? '' : 'LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';

        $sql = "SELECT rs.id, rs.user_id, rs.started_at, rs.ended_at, rs.total_reviewed,
                       rs.remembered_count, rs.accuracy_percentage,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, COALESCE(rs.ended_at, NOW())) AS duration_sec,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, NOW()) AS age_seconds,
                       u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email
                  FROM review_sessions rs
                  JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id
                 WHERE $whereSql
                 ORDER BY $col $dir, rs.id DESC
                 $limitSql";

        $qTypes  = $exportAll ? $types : $types . 'ii';
        $qParams = $exportAll ? $params : array_merge($params, [self::PER_PAGE, $offset]);
        $rows    = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql, $qTypes, $qParams);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $name      = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
            $completed = $r['ended_at'] !== null;
            $durSec    = max(0, (int) $r['duration_sec']);
            $durLabel  = $durSec < 60 ? $durSec . 's' : floor($durSec / 60) . 'm ' . ($durSec % 60) . 's';

            $out[] = [
                'id'         => (int) $r['id'],
                'userId'     => (int) $r['user_id'],
                'name'       => $name !== '' ? $name : (string) $r['email'],
                'email'      => (string) $r['email'],
                'started'    => date('M j, Y g:i A', strtotime($r['started_at'])),
                'startedIso' => (string) $r['started_at'],
                'age'        => AdminOverviewService::timeAgo(max(0, (int) $r['age_seconds'])),
                'completed'  => $completed,
                'reviewed'   => (int) $r['total_reviewed'],
                'remembered' => (int) $r['remembered_count'],
                'forgot'     => max(0, (int) $r['total_reviewed'] - (int) $r['remembered_count']),
                'accuracy'   => (float) $r['accuracy_percentage'],
                'duration'   => $completed ? $durLabel : 'In progress',
            ];
        }

        return [
            'available' => true,
            'rows'      => $out,
            'total'     => $total,
            'page'      => $page,
            'pages'     => $pages,
            'first'     => $total ? $offset + 1 : 0,
            'last'      => $offset + count($out),
        ];
    }

    private static function fetchRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types = '', array $params = []): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return $rows;
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $res = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($res && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res))) {
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $rows;
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * AdminAuditService
 *
 * Read-only query service for the append-only admin_audit_log table.
 * Supports action tabs, admin actor filter, date range, search (target name/email/IP),
 * pagination, and full CSV export.
 */
class AdminAuditService
{
    public const PER_PAGE = 20;

    public const ACTIONS = [
        'user_approved'        => 'Approved User',
        'user_rejected'        => 'Suspended User',
        'user_deleted'         => 'Archived User',
        'user_restored'        => 'Restored User',
        'role_promoted_admin'  => 'Promoted to Admin',
        'role_demoted_user'    => 'Demoted to User',
        'user_created_by_admin'=> 'Created User',
    ];

    private const SORTS = [
        'when'   => 'a.created_at',
        'action' => 'a.action',
        'target' => 'a.target_name',
        'admin'  => 'adm.first_name',
    ];

    /**
     * Validate and normalise GET parameters.
     */
    public static function parseFilters(array $get): array
    {
        $str  = fn($k) => is_string($get[$k] ?? null) ? trim($get[$k]) : '';
        $date = function (string $v): string {
            $d = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $v);
            return ($d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $v) ? $v : '';
        };
        $sort    = $str('sort');
        $adminId = filter_var($get['admin_id'] ?? null, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);

        return [
            'q'        => mb_substr($str('q'), 0, 100),
            'action'   => isset(self::ACTIONS[$str('action')]) ? $str('action') : '',
            'admin_id' => ($adminId && $adminId > 0) ? (int) $adminId : 0,
            'from'     => $date($str('from')),
            'to'       => $date($str('to')),
            'sort'     => isset(self::SORTS[$sort]) ? $sort : 'when',
            'dir'      => $str('dir') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
            'page'     => max(1, (int) ($get['page'] ?? 1)),
        ];
    }

    /** Build URL query string preserving active filters. */
    public static function buildQuery(array $f, array $override = []): string
    {
        $f = array_merge($f, $override);
        $q = array_filter([
            'q'        => $f['q'],
            'action'   => $f['action'],
            'admin_id' => $f['admin_id'] > 0 ? (string) $f['admin_id'] : '',
            'from'     => $f['from'],
            'to'       => $f['to'],
            'sort'     => $f['sort'] !== 'when' ? $f['sort'] : '',
            'dir'      => $f['dir'] !== 'desc' ? $f['dir'] : '',
            'page'     => $f['page'] > 1 ? (string) $f['page'] : '',
        ], fn($v) => $v !== '');
        return $q ? '?' . http_build_query($q) : '';
    }

    /**
     * Summary KPI counts for the Audit Log header cards.
     */
    public static function getSummary(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $out = [
            'total'      => 0,
            'last24h'    => 0,
            'last7d'     => 0,
            'approvals'  => 0,
            'moderation' => 0,
            'roles'      => 0,
        ];

        $sql = "SELECT
                    COUNT(*) AS total,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_24h,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_7d,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('user_approved', 'user_created_by_admin', 'user_restored') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvals,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('user_rejected', 'user_deleted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moderation,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('role_promoted_admin', 'role_demoted_user') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS roles
                FROM admin_audit_log";

        $rows = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql);
        if ($rows) {
            $r = $rows[0];
            $out['total']      = (int) ($r['total'] ?? 0);
            $out['last24h']    = (int) ($r['last_24h'] ?? 0);
            $out['last7d']     = (int) ($r['last_7d'] ?? 0);
            $out['approvals']  = (int) ($r['approvals'] ?? 0);
            $out['moderation'] = (int) ($r['moderation'] ?? 0);
            $out['roles']      = (int) ($r['roles'] ?? 0);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * List of administrators who have recorded audit entries (for the filter dropdown).
     */
    public static function getActors(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email
                  FROM admin_audit_log a
                  JOIN users u ON u.id = a.admin_id
                 ORDER BY u.first_name ASC, u.last_name ASC";
        $rows = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql);
        $out  = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $name = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
            $out[] = [
                'id'   => (int) $r['id'],
                'name' => $name !== '' ? $name : (string) $r['email'],
            ];
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Paginated (or unpaginated for CSV export) audit log records.
     */
    public static function getList(mysqli $conn, array $f, bool $exportAll = false): array
    {
        $empty = [
            'available' => false, 'rows' => [], 'total' => 0,
            'page' => 1, 'pages' => 1, 'first' => 0, 'last' => 0,
        ];

        [$where, $types, $params] = self::buildWhere($f);

        $c = self::fetchRows(
            $conn,
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
               FROM admin_audit_log a
               LEFT JOIN users adm ON adm.id = a.admin_id
              WHERE $where",
            $types,
            $params
        );
        if (!$c) {
            return $empty;
        }

        $total  = (int) $c[0]['n'];
        $pages  = max(1, (int) ceil($total / self::PER_PAGE));
        $page   = min($f['page'], $pages);
        $offset = ($page - 1) * self::PER_PAGE;

        $col = self::SORTS[$f['sort']] ?? 'a.created_at';
        $dir = $f['dir'] === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';

        $limitSql = $exportAll ? '' : 'LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';
        $sql = "SELECT a.id, a.admin_id, a.action, a.target_user_id, a.target_email, a.target_name,
                       a.previous_status, a.new_status, a.ip_address, a.created_at,
                       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, a.created_at, NOW()) AS age_seconds,
                       adm.first_name AS admin_first, adm.last_name AS admin_last, adm.email AS admin_email
                  FROM admin_audit_log a
                  LEFT JOIN users adm ON adm.id = a.admin_id
                 WHERE $where
                 ORDER BY $col $dir, a.id DESC
                 $limitSql";

        $qTypes  = $exportAll ? $types : $types . 'ii';
        $qParams = $exportAll ? $params : array_merge($params, [self::PER_PAGE, $offset]);
        $rows    = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql, $qTypes, $qParams);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $adminName = trim(($r['admin_first'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($r['admin_last'] ?? ''));
            if ($adminName === '') {
                $adminName = (string) ($r['admin_email'] ?? 'System / Deleted Admin');
            }

            $actionKey = (string) $r['action'];
            $out[] = [
                'id'            => (int) $r['id'],
                'adminId'       => $r['admin_id'] !== null ? (int) $r['admin_id'] : null,
                'adminName'     => $adminName,
                'adminEmail'    => (string) ($r['admin_email'] ?? ''),
                'action'        => $actionKey,
                'actionLabel'   => self::ACTIONS[$actionKey] ?? ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', $actionKey)),
                'targetUserId'  => $r['target_user_id'] !== null ? (int) $r['target_user_id'] : null,
                'targetName'    => (string) $r['target_name'],
                'targetEmail'   => (string) $r['target_email'],
                'prevStatus'    => $r['previous_status'] !== null ? (string) $r['previous_status'] : '—',
                'newStatus'     => $r['new_status'] !== null ? (string) $r['new_status'] : '—',
                'ip'            => $r['ip_address'] !== null && $r['ip_address'] !== '' ? (string) $r['ip_address'] : '—',
                'timestamp'     => date('M j, Y g:i A', strtotime($r['created_at'])),
                'timestampIso'  => (string) $r['created_at'],
                'age'           => AdminOverviewService::timeAgo(max(0, (int) $r['age_seconds'])),
            ];
        }

        return [
            'available' => true,
            'rows'      => $out,
            'total'     => $total,
            'page'      => $page,
            'pages'     => $pages,
            'first'     => $total ? $offset + 1 : 0,
            'last'      => $offset + count($out),
        ];
    }

    /** @return array{0:string,1:string,2:array} */
    private static function buildWhere(array $f): array
    {
        $where  = ['1=1'];
        $types  = '';
        $params = [];

        if ($f['q'] !== '') {
            $like    = '%' . addcslashes($f['q'], '%_\\') . '%';
            $where[] = "(a.target_name LIKE ? OR a.target_email LIKE ? OR a.ip_address LIKE ? OR CONCAT(COALESCE(adm.first_name,''), ' ', COALESCE(adm.last_name,'')) LIKE ?)";
            $types  .= 'ssss';
            array_push($params, $like, $like, $like, $like);
        }
        if ($f['action'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'a.action = ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = $f['action'];
        }
        if ($f['admin_id'] > 0) {
            $where[]  = 'a.admin_id = ?';
            $types   .= 'i';
            $params[] = $f['admin_id'];
        }
        if ($f['from'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'a.created_at >= ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = $f['from'] . ' 00:00:00';
        }
        if ($f['to'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'a.created_at < ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = (new DateTimeImmutable($f['to']))->modify('+1 day')->format('Y-m-d') . ' 00:00:00';
        }

        return [implode(' AND ', $where), $types, $params];
    }

    private static function fetchRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types = '', array $params = []): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return $rows;
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $res = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($res && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res))) {
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $rows;
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * AdminContentService
 *
 * Privacy-first platform content analytics for the Admin Content page.
 * Aggregates deck counts, flashcard counts, SRS interval maturity distribution,
 * due queues, and lapse rates per learner without exposing deck titles or card text.
 */
class AdminContentService
{
    public const PER_PAGE = 15;

    private const SORTS = [
        'name'     => 'u.first_name',
        'decks'    => 'active_decks',
        'cards'    => 'active_cards',
        'due'      => 'due_cards',
        'mature'   => 'mature_cards',
        'interval' => 'avg_interval',
        'lapses'   => 'total_lapses',
    ];

    public static function parseFilters(array $get): array
    {
        $str  = fn($k) => is_string($get[$k] ?? null) ? trim($get[$k]) : '';
        $sort = $str('sort');
        $tier = $str('filter');

        return [
            'q'      => mb_substr($str('q'), 0, 100),
            'filter' => in_array($tier, ['has_decks', 'has_due', 'high_lapses', 'empty'], true) ? $tier : '',
            'sort'   => isset(self::SORTS[$sort]) ? $sort : 'cards',
            'dir'    => $str('dir') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
            'page'   => max(1, (int) ($get['page'] ?? 1)),
        ];
    }

    public static function buildQuery(array $f, array $override = []): string
    {
        $f = array_merge($f, $override);
        $q = array_filter([
            'q'      => $f['q'],
            'filter' => $f['filter'],
            'sort'   => $f['sort'] !== 'cards' ? $f['sort'] : '',
            'dir'    => $f['dir'] !== 'desc' ? $f['dir'] : '',
            'page'   => $f['page'] > 1 ? (string) $f['page'] : '',
        ], fn($v) => $v !== '');
        return $q ? '?' . http_build_query($q) : '';
    }

    /**
     * Platform-wide content & SRS maturity metrics.
     */
    public static function getSummary(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $out = [
            'activeDecks'   => 0,
            'archivedDecks' => 0,
            'activeCards'   => 0,
            'archivedCards' => 0,
            'dueNow'        => 0,
            'newCards'      => 0,
            'learningCards' => 0,
            'youngCards'    => 0,
            'matureCards'   => 0,
            'avgInterval'   => 0.0,
            'totalLapses'   => 0,
            'created7d'     => 0,
        ];

        $sql = "SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM decks d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_decks,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM decks d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS archived_decks,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE (f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS archived_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND f.next_review_at <= NOW()) AS due_now,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND f.review_count = 0) AS new_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days <= 3) AS learning_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days BETWEEN 4 AND 20) AS young_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND f.review_count > 0 AND f.interval_days >= 21) AS mature_cards,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(f.interval_days), 1), 0)
               FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS avg_interval,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.lapses), 0)
               FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_lapses,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND f.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS created_7d";

        $res = mysqli_query($conn, $sql);
        if ($res) {
            if ($r = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res)) {
                $out['activeDecks']   = (int) $r['active_decks'];
                $out['archivedDecks'] = (int) $r['archived_decks'];
                $out['activeCards']   = (int) $r['active_cards'];
                $out['archivedCards'] = (int) $r['archived_cards'];
                $out['dueNow']        = (int) $r['due_now'];
                $out['newCards']      = (int) $r['new_cards'];
                $out['learningCards'] = (int) $r['learning_cards'];
                $out['youngCards']    = (int) $r['young_cards'];
                $out['matureCards']   = (int) $r['mature_cards'];
                $out['avgInterval']   = (float) $r['avg_interval'];
                $out['totalLapses']   = (int) $r['total_lapses'];
                $out['created7d']     = (int) $r['created_7d'];
            }
            mysqli_free_result($res);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Per-user content inventory (strictly aggregate metrics, no deck/card text).
     */
    public static function getList(mysqli $conn, array $f, bool $exportAll = false): array
    {
        $empty = [
            'available' => false, 'rows' => [], 'total' => 0,
            'page' => 1, 'pages' => 1, 'first' => 0, 'last' => 0,
        ];

        $where  = ["u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.account_status = 'approved'"];
        $types  = '';
        $params = [];

        if ($f['q'] !== '') {
            $like    = '%' . addcslashes($f['q'], '%_\\') . '%';
            $where[] = "(u.first_name LIKE ? OR u.last_name LIKE ? OR u.email LIKE ? OR CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) LIKE ?)";
            $types  .= 'ssss';
            array_push($params, $like, $like, $like, $like);
        }

        $having = '';
        if ($f['filter'] === 'has_decks') {
            $having = 'HAVING active_decks > 0';
        } elseif ($f['filter'] === 'has_due') {
            $having = 'HAVING due_cards > 0';
        } elseif ($f['filter'] === 'high_lapses') {
            $having = 'HAVING total_lapses >= 10';
        } elseif ($f['filter'] === 'empty') {
            $having = 'HAVING active_decks = 0';
        }

        $whereSql = implode(' AND ', $where);

        $baseSelect = "SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM decks d WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_decks,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM decks d WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS archived_decks,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards fc JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards fc JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND fc.next_review_at <= NOW()) AS due_cards,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards fc JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND fc.review_count > 0 AND fc.interval_days >= 21) AS mature_cards,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(fc.interval_days), 1), 0)
               FROM flashcards fc JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS avg_interval,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fc.lapses), 0)
               FROM flashcards fc JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_lapses
            FROM users u
            WHERE $whereSql
            $having";

        $countRows = self::fetchRows($conn, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ($baseSelect) AS sub", $types, $params);
        if (!$countRows) {
            return $empty;
        }

        $total  = (int) $countRows[0]['n'];
        $pages  = max(1, (int) ceil($total / self::PER_PAGE));
        $page   = min($f['page'], $pages);
        $offset = ($page - 1) * self::PER_PAGE;

        $col      = self::SORTS[$f['sort']] ?? 'active_cards';
        $dir      = $f['dir'] === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
        $limitSql = $exportAll ? '' : 'LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';

        $sql     = "$baseSelect ORDER BY $col $dir, u.id DESC $limitSql";
        $qTypes  = $exportAll ? $types : $types . 'ii';
        $qParams = $exportAll ? $params : array_merge($params, [self::PER_PAGE, $offset]);
        $rows    = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql, $qTypes, $qParams);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $name = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
            $out[] = [
                'id'            => (int) $r['id'],
                'name'          => $name !== '' ? $name : (string) $r['email'],
                'email'         => (string) $r['email'],
                'activeDecks'   => (int) $r['active_decks'],
                'archivedDecks' => (int) $r['archived_decks'],
                'activeCards'   => (int) $r['active_cards'],
                'dueCards'      => (int) $r['due_cards'],
                'matureCards'   => (int) $r['mature_cards'],
                'avgInterval'   => (float) $r['avg_interval'],
                'totalLapses'   => (int) $r['total_lapses'],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'available' => true,
            'rows'      => $out,
            'total'     => $total,
            'page'      => $page,
            'pages'     => $pages,
            'first'     => $total ? $offset + 1 : 0,
            'last'      => $offset + count($out),
        ];
    }

    private static function fetchRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types = '', array $params = []): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return $rows;
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $res = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($res && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res))) {
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $rows;
    }
}
