<?php
/**
 * AdminOverviewService
 *
 * Read-only data for the admin Overview page. Aggregation and clock math happen
 * in SQL (no PHP/MySQL timezone drift). Every method returns a safe empty
 * structure on failure, never null.
 */
class AdminOverviewService
{
    /** Allowed chart ranges in days (fixed allow-list). */
    public const RANGES = [7, 30, 90];

    /**
     * Platform-wide headline numbers. Only approved, non-deleted users are
     * counted; decks and cards belonging to deleted users are excluded.
     *
     * @return array Keys: available, totalUsers, newUsers7d, pendingUsers, activeToday,
     *               active7d, decks, cards, reviews7d, reviewsPrev7d, retention30d.
     */
    public static function getMetrics(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $empty = [
            'available' => false, 'totalUsers' => 0, 'newUsers7d' => 0, 'pendingUsers' => 0,
            'activeToday' => 0, 'active7d' => 0, 'decks' => 0, 'cards' => 0,
            'reviews7d' => 0, 'reviewsPrev7d' => 0, 'retention30d' => 0.0,
        ];

        $live = "deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status = 'approved'";
        $sql = "SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE $live) AS total_users,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE $live AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS new_users_7d,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status = 'pending') AS pending_users,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM review_sessions WHERE started_at >= CURDATE()) AS active_today,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM review_sessions WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS active_7d,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM decks d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS decks,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards f JOIN decks d ON d.id = f.deck_id JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
              WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS cards,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) FROM review_sessions
              WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS reviews_7d,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) FROM review_sessions
              WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
                AND started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS reviews_prev_7d,
            (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(remembered_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_reviewed), 0) * 100, 1), 0)
               FROM review_sessions
              WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS retention_30d";

        $res = mysqli_query($conn, $sql); // static SQL, no user input
        if (!$res) {
            return $empty;
        }
        $r = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res);
        mysqli_free_result($res);
        if (!$r) {
            return $empty;
        }

        return [
            'available'     => true,
            'totalUsers'    => (int) $r['total_users'],
            'newUsers7d'    => (int) $r['new_users_7d'],
            'pendingUsers'  => (int) $r['pending_users'],
            'activeToday'   => (int) $r['active_today'],
            'active7d'      => (int) $r['active_7d'],
            'decks'         => (int) $r['decks'],
            'cards'         => (int) $r['cards'],
            'reviews7d'     => (int) $r['reviews_7d'],
            'reviewsPrev7d' => (int) $r['reviews_prev_7d'],
            'retention30d'  => (float) $r['retention_30d'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Daily series with empty days filled so the chart axis is continuous.
     *
     * @param int $days One of self::RANGES (anything else falls back to 30).
     * @return array Keys: labels (Y-m-d), reviews, activeUsers, signups (parallel int arrays).
     */
    public static function getTrend(mysqli $conn, int $days = 30): array
    {
        $days = in_array($days, self::RANGES, true) ? $days : 30;
        $out = ['labels' => [], 'reviews' => [], 'activeUsers' => [], 'signups' => []];

        $today = null;
        if ($res = mysqli_query($conn, 'SELECT CURDATE()')) {
            $row = mysqli_fetch_row($res);
            $today = $row[0] ?? null;
            mysqli_free_result($res);
        }
        if (!$today) {
            return $out;
        }

        $offset = $days - 1;
        $sessions = self::fetchRows($conn,
            "SELECT DATE(started_at) AS d, SUM(total_reviewed) AS reviews, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active
             FROM review_sessions
             WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ? DAY
             GROUP BY d", 'i', [$offset]);
        $signups = self::fetchRows($conn,
            "SELECT DATE(created_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS signups
             FROM users
             WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ? DAY
             GROUP BY d", 'i', [$offset]);

        $byDay = [];
        foreach ($sessions as $s) {
            $byDay[$s['d']]['reviews'] = (int) $s['reviews'];
            $byDay[$s['d']]['active']  = (int) $s['active'];
        }
        foreach ($signups as $s) {
            $byDay[$s['d']]['signups'] = (int) $s['signups'];
        }

        $end = new DateTimeImmutable($today);
        for ($i = $offset; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $key = $end->modify("-$i days")->format('Y-m-d');
            $out['labels'][]      = $key;
            $out['reviews'][]     = $byDay[$key]['reviews'] ?? 0;
            $out['activeUsers'][] = $byDay[$key]['active'] ?? 0;
            $out['signups'][]     = $byDay[$key]['signups'] ?? 0;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Newest accounts (any status), for the sign-ups feed.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{id:int,name:string,email:string,role:string,status:string,age:string}>
     */
    public static function getRecentSignups(mysqli $conn, int $limit = 6): array
    {
        return self::userRows($conn, '', 'u.created_at DESC', $limit);
    }

    /**
     * Accounts waiting for approval, oldest first (the longest-waiting person is first in the queue).
     *
     * @return array<int, array{id:int,name:string,email:string,role:string,status:string,age:string}>
     */
    public static function getPendingUsers(mysqli $conn, int $limit = 5): array
    {
        return self::userRows($conn, "AND u.account_status = 'pending'", 'u.created_at ASC', $limit);
    }

    /**
     * Latest completed sessions platform-wide. Aggregates only: no deck titles or card content.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{name:string,cardsReviewed:int,accuracy:int,age:string}>
     */
    public static function getRecentSessions(mysqli $conn, int $limit = 6): array
    {
        $limit = max(1, min($limit, 50));
        $rows = self::fetchRows($conn,
            "SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, rs.total_reviewed, rs.accuracy_percentage,
                    TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rs.started_at, NOW()) AS age_seconds
             FROM review_sessions rs
             JOIN users u ON u.id = rs.user_id
             WHERE rs.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
             ORDER BY rs.started_at DESC LIMIT ?", 'i', [$limit]);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $out[] = [
                'name'          => self::displayName($r),
                'cardsReviewed' => (int) $r['total_reviewed'],
                'accuracy'      => (int) round((float) $r['accuracy_percentage']),
                'age'           => self::timeAgo((int) $r['age_seconds']),
            ];
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Percentage change chip data, or null when there is nothing to compare.
     *
     * @return array{text:string,tone:string}|null tone is up, down or flat.
     */
    public static function percentChip(int $current, int $previous, string $suffix): ?array
    {
        if ($previous === 0) {
            return $current > 0 ? ['text' => 'New activity', 'tone' => 'up'] : null;
        }
        $pct = (int) round((($current - $previous) / $previous) * 100);
        if ($pct === 0) {
            return ['text' => '0% ' . $suffix, 'tone' => 'flat'];
        }
        return ['text' => ($pct > 0 ? '+' : '') . $pct . '% ' . $suffix, 'tone' => $pct > 0 ? 'up' : 'down'];
    }

    /** Human-friendly relative time from a seconds-ago value computed in SQL. */
    public static function timeAgo(int $seconds): string
    {
        if ($seconds < 60)    return 'Just now';
        if ($seconds < 3600)  return floor($seconds / 60) . ' min ago';
        if ($seconds < 86400) return floor($seconds / 3600) . ' hr ago';
        $d = (int) floor($seconds / 86400);
        return $d . ($d === 1 ? ' day ago' : ' days ago');
    }

    // ---- internals --------------------------------------------------------

    private static function userRows(mysqli $conn, string $extraWhere, string $order, int $limit): array
    {
        $limit = max(1, min($limit, 50));
        // $extraWhere and $order are fixed strings from the two callers above, never user input.
        $rows = self::fetchRows($conn,
            "SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.role, u.account_status,
                    TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, u.created_at, NOW()) AS age_seconds
             FROM users u
             WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL $extraWhere
             ORDER BY $order LIMIT ?", 'i', [$limit]);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $out[] = [
                'id'     => (int) $r['id'],
                'name'   => self::displayName($r),
                'email'  => (string) $r['email'],
                'role'   => (string) $r['role'],
                'status' => (string) $r['account_status'],
                'age'    => self::timeAgo((int) $r['age_seconds']),
            ];
        }
        return $out;
    }

    private static function displayName(array $r): string
    {
        $n = trim(($r['first_name'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($r['last_name'] ?? ''));
        return $n !== '' ? $n : (string) ($r['email'] ?? 'Unknown user');
    }

    private static function fetchRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types = '', array $params = []): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return $rows;
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $res = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($res && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res))) {
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $rows;
    }
}

FILE: admin\api\AdminUserActionsService.php

<?php
/**
 * AdminUserActionsService
 *
 * Server-enforced user management mutations:
 *  - Single & bulk actions: approve, reject, delete (soft-delete), restore, make_admin, make_user
 *  - Direct user creation by an admin
 *  - Prevents self-lockout / self-modification
 *  - Writes every action atomically to admin_audit_log
 */
class AdminUserActionsService
{
    public const ACTIONS = [
        'approve',
        'reject',
        'delete',
        'restore',
        'make_admin',
        'make_user',
    ];

    private const AUDIT_NAMES = [
        'approve'    => 'user_approved',
        'reject'     => 'user_rejected',
        'delete'     => 'user_deleted',
        'restore'    => 'user_restored',
        'make_admin' => 'role_promoted_admin',
        'make_user'  => 'role_demoted_user',
        'create'     => 'user_created_by_admin',
    ];

    /**
     * Standard failure response.
     */
    private static function fail(int $code, string $message): array
    {
        return ['ok' => false, 'code' => $code, 'message' => $message];
    }

    /**
     * Allowed actions for a user row (shared between UI and server enforcement).
     */
    public static function allowedActions(string $role, string $status, bool $isDeleted = false): array
    {
        if ($isDeleted || $status === 'deleted') {
            return ['restore'];
        }

        $actions = [];
        switch ($status) {
            case 'pending':
                $actions = ['approve', 'reject', 'delete'];
                break;
            case 'approved':
                $actions = ['reject', 'delete'];
                break;
            case 'rejected':
                $actions = ['approve', 'delete'];
                break;
        }

        if ($status === 'approved') {
            $actions[] = ($role === 'admin') ? 'make_user' : 'make_admin';
        }

        return $actions;
    }

    /**
     * Perform an action on a single user.
     */
    public static function perform(mysqli $conn, int $actorId, int $targetId, string $action, string $ip = ''): array
    {
        if (!in_array($action, self::ACTIONS, true) || $targetId <= 0) {
            return self::fail(400, 'That request is not valid.');
        }
        if ($targetId === $actorId) {
            return self::fail(403, 'You cannot change or delete your own account.');
        }

        try {
            mysqli_begin_transaction($conn);

            $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn,
                'SELECT first_name, last_name, email, role, account_status, deleted_at
                   FROM users WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE'
            );
            if (!$stmt) {
                throw new RuntimeException('prepare failed (select)');
            }
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $targetId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $first, $last, $email, $role, $status, $deletedAt);
            $found = mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt);
            mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);

            if (!$found) {
                mysqli_rollback($conn);
                return self::fail(404, 'That account does not exist.');
            }

            $isDeleted = ($deletedAt !== null);
            $allowed   = self::allowedActions((string) $role, (string) $status, $isDeleted);

            if (!in_array($action, $allowed, true)) {
                mysqli_rollback($conn);
                return self::fail(409, 'This action is not valid for the account\'s current state. Refresh the page.');
            }

            // Prevent deleting or rejecting the last approved admin
            if ($role === 'admin' && in_array($action, ['reject', 'delete', 'make_user'], true)) {
                $admRes = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' AND account_status = 'approved' AND deleted_at IS NULL");
                $admRow = $admRes ? mysqli_fetch_row($admRes) : [0];
                if ($admRes) mysqli_free_result($admRes);
                if ((int) ($admRow[0] ?? 0) <= 1) {
                    mysqli_rollback($conn);
                    return self::fail(409, 'Cannot remove the last active administrator.');
                }
            }

            $prevState = $isDeleted ? 'deleted' : (string) $status;
            $newState  = $prevState;

            if ($action === 'delete') {
                $sql      = 'UPDATE users SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?';
                $newState = 'deleted';
            } elseif ($action === 'restore') {
                $sql      = 'UPDATE users SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = ?';
                $newState = (string) $status;
            } elseif ($action === 'approve' || $action === 'reject') {
                $newState = $action === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
                $sql      = "UPDATE users SET account_status = '$newState' WHERE id = ?";
            } elseif ($action === 'make_admin' || $action === 'make_user') {
                $newRole   = $action === 'make_admin' ? 'admin' : 'user';
                $prevState = 'role:' . $role;
                $newState  = 'role:' . $newRole;
                $sql       = "UPDATE users SET role = '$newRole' WHERE id = ?";
            }

            $up = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
            if (!$up) {
                throw new RuntimeException('prepare failed (update)');
            }
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($up, 'i', $targetId);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($up);
            mysqli_stmt_close($up);

            $name      = trim($first . ' ' . $last);
            $name      = $name !== '' ? $name : $email;
            $auditName = self::AUDIT_NAMES[$action];
            $ip        = mb_substr($ip, 0, 45);

            $log = mysqli_prepare($conn,
                'INSERT INTO admin_audit_log
                    (admin_id, action, target_user_id, target_email, target_name, previous_status, new_status, ip_address)
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
            );
            if (!$log) {
                throw new RuntimeException('prepare failed (audit)');
            }
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($log, 'isisssss', $actorId, $auditName, $targetId, $email, $name, $prevState, $newState, $ip);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($log);
            mysqli_stmt_close($log);

            mysqli_commit($conn);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            @mysqli_rollback($conn);
            error_log('AdminUserActionsService::perform failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return self::fail(500, 'Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Please try again.');
        }

        $messages = [
            'approve'    => "Approved {$name}.",
            'reject'     => "Suspended {$name}.",
            'delete'     => "Archived {$name}.",
            'restore'    => "Restored {$name}.",
            'make_admin' => "Promoted {$name} to Admin.",
            'make_user'  => "Changed {$name} to regular User.",
        ];
        return ['ok' => true, 'code' => 200, 'message' => $messages[$action], 'status' => $newState];
    }

    /**
     * Perform a bulk action on multiple user IDs.
     */
    public static function performBulk(mysqli $conn, int $actorId, array $targetIds, string $action, string $ip = ''): array
    {
        if (!in_array($action, ['approve', 'reject', 'delete', 'restore'], true)) {
            return self::fail(400, 'Invalid bulk action.');
        }

        $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(
            array_map('intval', $targetIds),
            fn($id) => $id > 0 && $id !== $actorId
        )));
        if (!$ids) {
            return self::fail(400, 'No valid accounts selected (you cannot modify your own account).');
        }

        $succeeded = 0;
        foreach ($ids as $id) {
            $res = self::perform($conn, $actorId, $id, $action, $ip);
            if ($res['ok']) {
                $succeeded++;
            }
        }

        if ($succeeded === 0) {
            return self::fail(409, 'None of the selected accounts could be updated.');
        }

        $verb = [
            'approve' => 'Approved',
            'reject'  => 'Suspended',
            'delete'  => 'Archived',
            'restore' => 'Restored',
        ][$action];

        return [
            'ok'      => true,
            'code'    => 200,
            'message' => "{$verb} {$succeeded} " . ($succeeded === 1 ? 'account.' : 'accounts.'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Create a new user account directly from the Admin Users page.
     */
    public static function createUser(mysqli $conn, int $actorId, array $data, string $ip = ''): array
    {
        $first    = trim((string) ($data['first_name'] ?? ''));
        $last     = trim((string) ($data['last_name'] ?? ''));
        $email    = trim((string) ($data['email'] ?? ''));
        $password = (string) ($data['password'] ?? '');
        $role     = in_array($data['role'] ?? 'user', ['admin', 'user'], true) ? $data['role'] : 'user';
        $status   = in_array($data['status'] ?? 'approved', ['approved', 'pending'], true) ? $data['status'] : 'approved';

        if ($first === '' || $last === '' || $email === '' || $password === '') {
            return self::fail(400, 'All fields are required.');
        }
        if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            return self::fail(400, 'Please enter a valid email address.');
        }
        if (strlen($password) < 8) {
            return self::fail(400, 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.');
        }

        try {
            mysqli_begin_transaction($conn);

            $chk = mysqli_prepare($conn, 'SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ? LIMIT 1');
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($chk, 's', $email);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($chk);
            mysqli_stmt_store_result($chk);
            if (mysqli_stmt_num_rows($chk) > 0) {
                mysqli_stmt_close($chk);
                mysqli_rollback($conn);
                return self::fail(409, 'An account with that email already exists.');
            }
            mysqli_stmt_close($chk);

            $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT);
            $ins  = mysqli_prepare($conn,
                'INSERT INTO users (first_name, last_name, email, password_hash, role, account_status)
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
            );
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($ins, 'ssssss', $first, $last, $email, $hash, $role, $status);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($ins);
            $newId = (int) mysqli_insert_id($conn);
            mysqli_stmt_close($ins);

            $set = mysqli_prepare($conn, 'INSERT IGNORE INTO user_settings (user_id) VALUES (?)');
            if ($set) {
                mysqli_stmt_bind_param($set, 'i', $newId);
                mysqli_stmt_execute($set);
                mysqli_stmt_close($set);
            }

            $name      = trim($first . ' ' . $last);
            $auditName = self::AUDIT_NAMES['create'];
            $ip        = mb_substr($ip, 0, 45);
            $prev      = null;

            $log = mysqli_prepare($conn,
                'INSERT INTO admin_audit_log
                    (admin_id, action, target_user_id, target_email, target_name, previous_status, new_status, ip_address)
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
            );
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($log, 'isisssss', $actorId, $auditName, $newId, $email, $name, $prev, $status, $ip);
            mysqli_stmt_execute($log);
            mysqli_stmt_close($log);

            mysqli_commit($conn);
            return ['ok' => true, 'code' => 200, 'message' => "Created account for {$name}."];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            @mysqli_rollback($conn);
            error_log('AdminUserActionsService::createUser failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return self::fail(500, 'Unable to create the account.');
        }
    }
}

FILE: admin\api\AdminUsersService.php

<?php
/**
 * AdminUsersService
 *
 * Industry-standard read & query service for the Admin Users page.
 * Supports active & soft-deleted accounts, role/status/date/search filters,
 * multi-column sorting, per-user SRS aggregate metrics, and per-user audit history.
 */
class AdminUsersService
{
    public const PER_PAGE = 15;
    public const STATUSES = ['pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'deleted'];
    public const ROLES    = ['admin', 'user'];

    /** Sort key => SQL expression (strict allow-list). */
    private const SORTS = [
        'name'    => 'u.first_name',
        'email'   => 'u.email',
        'role'    => 'u.role',
        'status'  => 'u.account_status',
        'decks'   => 'decks',
        'reviews' => 'reviews',
        'joined'  => 'u.created_at',
    ];

    /**
     * Validate and normalise GET input.
     */
    public static function parseFilters(array $get): array
    {
        $str  = fn($k) => is_string($get[$k] ?? null) ? trim($get[$k]) : '';
        $date = function (string $v): string {
            $d = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $v);
            return ($d && $d->format('Y-m-d') === $v) ? $v : '';
        };
        $sort = $str('sort');

        return [
            'q'      => mb_substr($str('q'), 0, 100),
            'status' => in_array($str('status'), self::STATUSES, true) ? $str('status') : '',
            'role'   => in_array($str('role'), self::ROLES, true) ? $str('role') : '',
            'from'   => $date($str('from')),
            'to'     => $date($str('to')),
            'sort'   => isset(self::SORTS[$sort]) ? $sort : 'joined',
            'dir'    => $str('dir') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
            'page'   => max(1, (int) ($get['page'] ?? 1)),
        ];
    }

    /** Query string builder keeping only non-default parameters. */
    public static function buildQuery(array $f, array $override = []): string
    {
        $f = array_merge($f, $override);
        $q = array_filter([
            'q'      => $f['q'],
            'status' => $f['status'],
            'role'   => $f['role'],
            'from'   => $f['from'],
            'to'     => $f['to'],
            'sort'   => $f['sort'] !== 'joined' ? $f['sort'] : '',
            'dir'    => $f['dir'] !== 'desc' ? $f['dir'] : '',
            'page'   => $f['page'] > 1 ? $f['page'] : '',
        ], fn($v) => $v !== '');
        return $q ? '?' . http_build_query($q) : '';
    }

    /**
     * Account counts per status tab + headline KPIs.
     */
    public static function getStatusCounts(mysqli $conn): array
    {
        $out = [
            'all'      => 0,
            'pending'  => 0,
            'approved' => 0,
            'rejected' => 0,
            'deleted'  => 0,
            'admins'   => 0,
            'active7d' => 0,
        ];

        $rows = self::fetchRows(
            $conn,
            "SELECT
                SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_live,
                SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending,
                SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved,
                SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL AND account_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected,
                SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted,
                SUM(CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL AND role = 'admin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS admins,
                (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rs.user_id)
                   FROM review_sessions rs
                   JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = rs.user_id
                  WHERE u2.deleted_at IS NULL AND rs.started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS active_7d
             FROM users"
        );

        if ($rows) {
            $r = $rows[0];
            $out['all']      = (int) ($r['all_live'] ?? 0);
            $out['pending']  = (int) ($r['pending'] ?? 0);
            $out['approved'] = (int) ($r['approved'] ?? 0);
            $out['rejected'] = (int) ($r['rejected'] ?? 0);
            $out['deleted']  = (int) ($r['deleted'] ?? 0);
            $out['admins']   = (int) ($r['admins'] ?? 0);
            $out['active7d'] = (int) ($r['active_7d'] ?? 0);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /**
     * Paginated (or unpaginated for CSV export) user list with per-user aggregates.
     */
    public static function getList(mysqli $conn, array $f, bool $exportAll = false): array
    {
        $empty = [
            'available' => false, 'rows' => [], 'total' => 0,
            'page' => 1, 'pages' => 1, 'first' => 0, 'last' => 0,
        ];

        [$where, $types, $params] = self::buildWhere($f);

        $c = self::fetchRows($conn, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users u WHERE $where", $types, $params);
        if (!$c) {
            return $empty;
        }
        $total  = (int) $c[0]['n'];
        $pages  = max(1, (int) ceil($total / self::PER_PAGE));
        $page   = min($f['page'], $pages);
        $offset = ($page - 1) * self::PER_PAGE;

        $col  = self::SORTS[$f['sort']] ?? 'u.created_at';
        $dir  = $f['dir'] === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
        $done = "s.user_id = u.id AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL";

        $limitSql = $exportAll ? '' : 'LIMIT ? OFFSET ?';
        $sql = "SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.role, u.account_status,
                       u.created_at, u.deleted_at,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM decks d WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS decks,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards fc JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
                    WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS cards,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_sessions s WHERE $done) AS sessions,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_reviewed), 0) FROM review_sessions s WHERE $done) AS reviews,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.remembered_count) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_reviewed), 0) * 100, 1), 0)
                     FROM review_sessions s WHERE $done) AS accuracy,
                  (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MAX(s.started_at), NOW())
                     FROM review_sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS last_active_seconds
                FROM users u
                WHERE $where
                ORDER BY $col $dir, u.id DESC
                $limitSql";

        $queryTypes  = $exportAll ? $types : $types . 'ii';
        $queryParams = $exportAll ? $params : array_merge($params, [self::PER_PAGE, $offset]);
        $rows        = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql, $queryTypes, $queryParams);

        // Fetch recent audit logs for the returned users in one query
        $userIds   = array_map(fn($r) => (int) $r['id'], $rows);
        $auditByUser = self::getAuditHistoryForUsers($conn, $userIds);

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $id        = (int) $r['id'];
            $name      = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
            $isDeleted = $r['deleted_at'] !== null;
            $effStatus = $isDeleted ? 'deleted' : (string) $r['account_status'];

            $out[] = [
                'id'         => $id,
                'firstName'  => (string) $r['first_name'],
                'lastName'   => (string) $r['last_name'],
                'name'       => $name !== '' ? $name : (string) $r['email'],
                'email'      => (string) $r['email'],
                'role'       => (string) $r['role'],
                'status'     => $effStatus,
                'rawStatus'  => (string) $r['account_status'],
                'isDeleted'  => $isDeleted,
                'joined'     => date('M j, Y', strtotime($r['created_at'])),
                'joinedIso'  => date('Y-m-d', strtotime($r['created_at'])),
                'deletedAt'  => $isDeleted ? date('M j, Y', strtotime($r['deleted_at'])) : null,
                'decks'      => (int) $r['decks'],
                'cards'      => (int) $r['cards'],
                'sessions'   => (int) $r['sessions'],
                'reviews'    => (int) $r['reviews'],
                'accuracy'   => (float) $r['accuracy'],
                'lastActive' => $r['last_active_seconds'] === null
                    ? 'Never'
                    : AdminOverviewService::timeAgo((int) $r['last_active_seconds']),
                'audit'      => $auditByUser[$id] ?? [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'available' => true,
            'rows'      => $out,
            'total'     => $total,
            'page'      => $page,
            'pages'     => $pages,
            'first'     => $total ? $offset + 1 : 0,
            'last'      => $offset + count($out),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Fetch up to 8 recent audit events per user for the drawer timeline.
     */
    private static function getAuditHistoryForUsers(mysqli $conn, array $userIds): array
    {
        if (!$userIds) {
            return [];
        }
        $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($userIds), '?'));
        $types        = str_repeat('i', count($userIds));
        $sql          = "SELECT a.target_user_id, a.action, a.previous_status, a.new_status, a.created_at,
                                CONCAT(COALESCE(adm.first_name,''), ' ', COALESCE(adm.last_name,'')) AS admin_name
                           FROM admin_audit_log a
                           LEFT JOIN users adm ON adm.id = a.admin_id
                          WHERE a.target_user_id IN ($placeholders)
                          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC";

        $rows = self::fetchRows($conn, $sql, $types, $userIds);
        $map  = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $uid = (int) $r['target_user_id'];
            if (count($map[$uid] ?? []) >= 6) {
                continue;
            }
            $adminName = trim((string) $r['admin_name']);
            $map[$uid][] = [
                'action' => (string) $r['action'],
                'from'   => $r['previous_status'],
                'to'     => $r['new_status'],
                'by'     => $adminName !== '' ? $adminName : 'Admin',
                'when'   => date('M j, Y g:i A', strtotime($r['created_at'])),
            ];
        }
        return $map;
    }

    /** @return array{0:string,1:string,2:array} */
    private static function buildWhere(array $f): array
    {
        $where  = [];
        $types  = '';
        $params = [];

        if ($f['status'] === 'deleted') {
            $where[] = 'u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL';
        } else {
            $where[] = 'u.deleted_at IS NULL';
            if ($f['status'] !== '') {
                $where[]  = 'u.account_status = ?';
                $types   .= 's';
                $params[] = $f['status'];
            }
        }

        if ($f['q'] !== '') {
            $like    = '%' . addcslashes($f['q'], '%_\\') . '%';
            $where[] = "(u.first_name LIKE ? OR u.last_name LIKE ? OR u.email LIKE ? OR CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) LIKE ?)";
            $types  .= 'ssss';
            array_push($params, $like, $like, $like, $like);
        }
        if ($f['role'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'u.role = ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = $f['role'];
        }
        if ($f['from'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'u.created_at >= ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = $f['from'] . ' 00:00:00';
        }
        if ($f['to'] !== '') {
            $where[]  = 'u.created_at < ?';
            $types   .= 's';
            $params[] = (new DateTimeImmutable($f['to']))->modify('+1 day')->format('Y-m-d') . ' 00:00:00';
        }

        return [implode(' AND ', $where), $types, $params];
    }

    private static function fetchRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql, string $types = '', array $params = []): array
    {
        $rows = [];
        $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);
        if (!$stmt) {
            return $rows;
        }
        if ($types !== '') {
            mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);
        }
        if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
            $res = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
            while ($res && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($res))) {
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
        }
        mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
        return $rows;
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/guard.php';

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');

if (!isset($conn) || !($conn instanceof mysqli)) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Database connection unavailable.']);
    exit;
}

$q = isset($_GET['q']) && is_string($_GET['q'])
    ? trim($_GET['q'])
    : '';

$q = mb_substr($q, 0, 100);

if (mb_strlen($q) < 2) {
    echo json_encode([
        'users' => [],
        'content' => [],
        'activity' => [],
        'audit' => [],
    ]);
    exit;
}

$like = '%' . $q . '%';

function globalSearchRows(
    mysqli $conn,
    string $sql,
    string $types,
    array $params
): array {
    $rows = [];
    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql);

    if (!$stmt) {
        error_log('Global search prepare failed: ' . mysqli_error($conn));
        return [];
    }

    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, $types, ...$params);

    if (mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt)) {
        $result = mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);

        while ($result && ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result))) {
            $rows[] = $row;
        }

        if ($result) {
            mysqli_free_result($result);
        }
    } else {
        error_log('Global search execute failed: ' . mysqli_stmt_error($stmt));
    }

    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
    return $rows;
}

$term = rawurlencode($q);

/*
 * 1. USERS
 * Search by first name, last name, or email.
 */
$userRows = globalSearchRows(
    $conn,
    "SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, role,
            account_status, deleted_at
       FROM users
      WHERE first_name LIKE ?
         OR last_name LIKE ?
         OR email LIKE ?
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        first_name ASC
      LIMIT 8",
    'sss',
    [$like, $like, $like]
);

$users = [];

foreach ($userRows as $r) {
    $name = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
    $name = $name !== '' ? $name : $r['email'];

    $status = $r['deleted_at'] !== null
        ? 'Archived'
        : (string) $r['account_status'];

    $users[] = [
        'title' => $name,
        'detail' => $r['email'] . ' · ' . $r['role'] . ' · ' . $status,
        'url' => 'views/users.php?q=' . $term,
        'icon' => 'group',
    ];
}

/*
 * 2. CONTENT
 * Search learners and show their active deck/card counts.
 * Deck titles and flashcard text are intentionally not exposed.
 */
$contentRows = globalSearchRows(
    $conn,
    "SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email,
            (SELECT COUNT(*)
               FROM decks d
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id
                AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS deck_count,
            (SELECT COUNT(*)
               FROM flashcards fc
               JOIN decks d ON d.id = fc.deck_id
              WHERE d.user_id = u.id
                AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND fc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS card_count
       FROM users u
      WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (
            u.first_name LIKE ?
            OR u.last_name LIKE ?
            OR u.email LIKE ?
        )
      ORDER BY u.first_name ASC
      LIMIT 8",
    'sss',
    [$like, $like, $like]
);

$content = [];

foreach ($contentRows as $r) {

    $name = $name !== '' ? $name : $r['email'];

      WHERE u.first_name LIKE ?
         OR u.last_name LIKE ?
         OR u.email LIKE ?
         OR CAST(rs.id AS CHAR) LIKE ?
      ORDER BY rs.started_at DESC, rs.id DESC
      LIMIT 8",

);

$activity = [];

foreach ($activityRows as $r) {
    $name = trim($r['first_name'] . ' ' . $r['last_name']);
    $name = $name !== '' ? $name : $r['email'];

    $state = $r['ended_at'] === null
        ? 'In progress'
        : 'Completed';

    $activity[] = [
        'title' => $name,
        'detail' => 'Session #' . (int) $r['id']
            . ' · ' . $state

<?php
/**
 * POST /admin/api/user-actions.php
 * Supports:
 *  1. Single action: { "action": "approve"|"reject"|"delete"|"restore"|"make_admin"|"make_user", "user_id": 123 }
 *  2. Bulk action:   { "action": "approve"|"reject"|"delete"|"restore", "user_ids": [1, 2, 3] }
 *  3. Create user:   { "action": "create_user", "first_name": "...", "last_name": "...", "email": "...", "password": "...", "role": "user", "status": "approved" }
 */
define('ADMIN_JSON', true);
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/guard.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AdminUserActionsService.php';

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

function userActionsRespond(int $status, array $body): void
{
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($body);
    exit;
}

if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
    header('Allow: POST');
    userActionsRespond(405, ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Method not allowed.']);
}

adminRequireCsrf();

$input = json_decode((string) file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if (!is_array($input)) {
    $input = $_POST;
}

$action = is_string($input['action'] ?? null) ? $input['action'] : '';
$ip     = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '');

if ($action === 'create_user') {
    $result = AdminUserActionsService::createUser($conn, $adminUser['id'], $input, $ip);
} elseif (!empty($input['user_ids']) && is_array($input['user_ids'])) {
    $result = AdminUserActionsService::performBulk($conn, $adminUser['id'], $input['user_ids'], $action, $ip);
} else {
    $targetId = filter_var($input['user_id'] ?? null, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
    $targetId = $targetId === false ? 0 : (int) $targetId;
    $result   = AdminUserActionsService::perform($conn, $adminUser['id'], $targetId, $action, $ip);
}

userActionsRespond($result['code'], [
    'success' => $result['ok'],
    'message' => $result['message'],
    'status'  => $result['status'] ?? null,
]);

FILE: admin\includes\guard.php

<?php
/**
 * Admin guard. Include FIRST on every admin page and endpoint, before any output.
 *
 * What it does:
 *  1. Defines URL constants (admin, app, login).
 *  2. Loads the database connection.
 *  3. Verifies the user EVERY request against the database (never trusts a cached role).
 *  4. Exposes $adminUser, $displayName, $displayRole, $adminTheme to the page.
 *  5. Provides CSRF helpers for state-changing requests.
 *
 * JSON endpoints: define('ADMIN_JSON', true) BEFORE including this file so that
 * failures return a JSON 401/403 instead of a redirect.
 */

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

define('APP_URL', '/mempulse/app/');
define('ADMIN_URL', '/mempulse/admin/');
define('LOGIN_URL', '/mempulse/authentication/login.php');

// config/db.php defines BASE_URL as the *app* path when it is not already set.
// Claim it for the admin area BEFORE loading the connection.
if (!defined('BASE_URL')) {
    define('BASE_URL', ADMIN_URL);
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/db.php';

// Admin pages must never be cached (stops the Back button showing them after logout).
header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
header('Pragma: no-cache');
header('X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow');

/**
 * Stop the request. Pages redirect; JSON endpoints answer with a status code.
 */
function adminDeny(int $status, string $message, string $redirect): void
{
    if (defined('ADMIN_JSON') && ADMIN_JSON) {
        http_response_code($status);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $message]);
    } else {
        header('Location: ' . $redirect);
    }
    exit;
}

/** Escape a value for HTML output. */
function adminEsc($value): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars((string) $value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

// ---- 1. Must have a logged-in session ------------------------------------
if (empty($_SESSION['logged_in']) || $_SESSION['logged_in'] !== true || empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    adminDeny(401, 'Please log in.', LOGIN_URL);
}

$userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

// ---- 2. Verify the account and role against the database -------------------
$sql = "SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.role, u.account_status, s.theme
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN user_settings s ON s.user_id = u.id
        WHERE u.id = ? AND u.deleted_at IS NULL";

$row = null;
if ($stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, $sql)) {
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, 'i', $userId);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    mysqli_stmt_bind_result($stmt, $firstName, $lastName, $email, $role, $accountStatus, $theme);
    if (mysqli_stmt_fetch($stmt)) {
        $row = [
            'firstName' => $firstName,
            'lastName'  => $lastName,
            'email'     => $email,
            'role'      => $role,
            'status'    => $accountStatus,
            'theme'     => $theme,
        ];
    }
    mysqli_stmt_close($stmt);
}

// Account missing, soft-deleted, or not approved: treat as logged out.
if ($row === null || $row['status'] !== 'approved') {
    adminDeny(401, 'Your session is no longer valid.', LOGIN_URL);
}

// Logged in, but not an admin: send back to the student app.
if ($row['role'] !== 'admin') {
    adminDeny(403, 'You do not have access to this area.', APP_URL . 'views/index.php');
}

// ---- 3. Values shared with pages and includes ----------------------------
$fullName = trim($row['firstName'] . ' ' . $row['lastName']);

$adminUser = [
    'id'    => $userId,
    'name'  => $fullName !== '' ? $fullName : 'Administrator',
    'email' => $row['email'],
    'role'  => 'admin',
];

$displayName = $adminUser['name'];
$displayRole = 'Admin';
$adminTheme  = in_array($row['theme'], ['light', 'dark', 'system'], true) ? $row['theme'] : 'system';

// ---- 4. CSRF (separate token from the student settings token) -------------
if (empty($_SESSION['admin_csrf'])) {
    $_SESSION['admin_csrf'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
}

function adminCsrfToken(): string
{
    return $_SESSION['admin_csrf'];
}

/**
 * Call at the top of every state-changing endpoint, after the method check.
 * Accepts the token from the X-CSRF-Token header or a csrf_token POST field.
 */
function adminRequireCsrf(): void
{
    $sent = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? ($_POST['csrf_token'] ?? '');
    if (!is_string($sent) || $sent === '' || !hash_equals($_SESSION['admin_csrf'], $sent)) {
        adminDeny(403, 'Invalid security token. Refresh the page and try again.', ADMIN_URL . 'views/index.php');
    }
}

<?php
// Expects admin/includes/guard.php to be included already ($adminTheme, APP_URL, ADMIN_URL).
$pageTitle = $pageTitle ?? 'Overview';

// Shared styles live in app/ so the two areas can never drift apart.
$sharedCss = __DIR__ . '/../../app/assets/css/';
$cssVersion = function (string $file) use ($sharedCss) {
    return @filemtime($sharedCss . $file) ?: time();
};
?>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">

    <script>
        (function () {
            var root = document.documentElement;

            // The saved preference lives in the database; mirror it into localStorage
            // so a fresh browser starts with the right theme (same key the app uses).
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('mempulseTheme', <?= json_encode($adminTheme) ?>);
            } catch (e) {}

            // Apply the theme before first paint (identical to app/includes/head.php).
            var pref = 'system';
            try {
                pref = localStorage.getItem('mempulseTheme') || 'system';
            } catch (e) {}

            var dark = pref === 'dark' ||
                (pref === 'system' &&
                window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);

            root.classList.toggle('dark', dark);
            root.style.colorScheme = dark ? 'dark' : 'light';

            // Apply the sidebar preference before first paint.
            try {
                var collapsed =
                    window.innerWidth >= 768 &&
                    localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true';
                root.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed', collapsed);
            } catch (e) {
                root.classList.remove('sidebar-collapsed');
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <title><?= adminEsc($pageTitle) ?> | MemPulse Admin</title>

    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect" />
    <link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect" />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&amp;family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

    <!-- Shared design system, loaded from the app folder -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="<?= APP_URL ?>assets/css/app.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="<?= APP_URL ?>assets/css/tailwind.css?v=<?= $cssVersion('tailwind.css') ?>">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="<?= APP_URL ?>assets/css/theme.css?v=<?= $cssVersion('theme.css') ?>">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js" defer></script>
</head>

</dialog>

<script>
    window.MemPulseAdminSearch = {
        adminUrl: <?= json_encode(ADMIN_URL) ?>,
        endpoint: <?= json_encode(ADMIN_URL . 'api/global-search.php') ?>,
        pages: <?= json_encode($adminSearchPages, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>
    };

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const sidebar = document.querySelector("#sidebar");
        const mainContent = document.querySelector("main");
        const toggleBtn = document.querySelector("#sidebar-toggle");

        // Mobile elements (trigger inside the header)
        const floatingToggleBtn = document.querySelector("#floating-mobile-toggle");
        const mobileToggleIcon = document.querySelector("#mobile-toggle-icon");
        const mobileOverlay = document.querySelector("#mobile-sidebar-overlay");

        if (!sidebar) return;

        // Body-level fixed tooltip for collapsed desktop sidebar
        let floatingTooltip = document.getElementById("sidebar-floating-tooltip");
        if (!floatingTooltip) {
            floatingTooltip = document.createElement("div");
            floatingTooltip.id = "sidebar-floating-tooltip";
            floatingTooltip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
            document.body.appendChild(floatingTooltip);
        }

        let tooltipTarget = null;
        function hideSidebarTooltip() {
            floatingTooltip.classList.remove("is-visible");
            tooltipTarget = null;
        }
        function showSidebarTooltip(target) {
            const label = target.getAttribute("data-tooltip") || target.getAttribute("aria-label");
            if (!label || !sidebar.classList.contains("collapsed") || window.innerWidth < 768) {
                hideSidebarTooltip();
                return;
            }
            tooltipTarget = target;
            floatingTooltip.textContent = label;
            floatingTooltip.style.left = "0px";
            floatingTooltip.style.top = "0px";
            floatingTooltip.classList.add("is-visible");
            const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
            const tipRect = floatingTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
            const gap = 12;
            let left = rect.right + gap;
            if (left + tipRect.width > window.innerWidth - 8) {
                left = Math.max(8, rect.left - tipRect.width - gap);
                floatingTooltip.classList.add("tooltip-left");
            } else {
                floatingTooltip.classList.remove("tooltip-left");
            }
            const top = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 8, Math.max(8, rect.top + rect.height / 2));
            floatingTooltip.style.left = `${left}px`;
            floatingTooltip.style.top = `${top}px`;
        }

        sidebar.querySelectorAll(".sidebar-tooltip").forEach((item) => {
            item.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showSidebarTooltip(item));
            item.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideSidebarTooltip);
            item.addEventListener("focus", () => showSidebarTooltip(item));
            item.addEventListener("blur", hideSidebarTooltip);
        });
        sidebar.addEventListener("scroll", hideSidebarTooltip, true);
        window.addEventListener("resize", hideSidebarTooltip);
        window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
            if (tooltipTarget) showSidebarTooltip(tooltipTarget);
        }, true);

        const toggleIcon = toggleBtn ? toggleBtn.querySelector(".material-symbols-outlined") : null;

        // Apply visual collapsed state on desktop (state is shared with the app via localStorage)
        const sidebarCollapsed = localStorage.getItem("sidebarCollapsed") === "true";
        if (sidebarCollapsed && window.innerWidth >= 768) {
            sidebar.classList.add("collapsed");
            if (mainContent) mainContent.classList.add("collapsed");
            if (toggleIcon) toggleIcon.textContent = "left_panel_open";
        }

        // Desktop border toggle
        if (toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
                const isCollapsed = sidebar.classList.toggle("collapsed");

                document.documentElement.classList.toggle("sidebar-collapsed", isCollapsed);

                hideSidebarTooltip();
                if (mainContent) {
                    mainContent.classList.toggle("collapsed", isCollapsed);
                }
                if (toggleIcon) {
                    toggleIcon.textContent = isCollapsed ? "left_panel_open" : "left_panel_close";
                }
                localStorage.setItem("sidebarCollapsed", isCollapsed);
            });
        }

        // Mobile sidebar drawer (button inside the header)
        function isMobileSidebarOpen() {
            return !sidebar.classList.contains("-translate-x-full");
        }

        function openMobileSidebar() {
            sidebar.classList.remove("-translate-x-full", "collapsed");
            mobileOverlay.classList.remove("hidden");
            if (floatingToggleBtn) floatingToggleBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
            if (mobileToggleIcon) mobileToggleIcon.textContent = "close";
            setTimeout(() => mobileOverlay.classList.remove("opacity-0"), 10);
        }

        function closeMobileSidebar() {
            sidebar.classList.add("-translate-x-full");
            mobileOverlay.classList.add("opacity-0");
            if (floatingToggleBtn) floatingToggleBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            if (mobileToggleIcon) mobileToggleIcon.textContent = "menu";
            setTimeout(() => mobileOverlay.classList.add("hidden"), 300);
        }

        if (floatingToggleBtn) {
            floatingToggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
                if (isMobileSidebarOpen()) {
                    closeMobileSidebar();
                } else {
                    openMobileSidebar();
                }
            });
        }
        if (mobileOverlay) mobileOverlay.addEventListener("click", closeMobileSidebar);

        // --- Header Search Dropdown Logic ---
        // Quick links are matched in the browser; users/content/activity/audit come
        // from api/global-search.php (min 2 characters, debounced).
        const searchContainer = document.getElementById('header-search-container');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('header-search-input');
        const searchClear = document.getElementById('header-search-clear');
        const searchDropdown = document.getElementById('header-search-dropdown');
        const searchResults = document.getElementById('header-search-results');

        const searchCfg = window.MemPulseAdminSearch || { adminUrl: '/mempulse/admin/', endpoint: '', pages: [] };
        const quickPages = Array.isArray(searchCfg.pages) ? searchCfg.pages : [];

        const serverSections = [
            { key: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: 'group' },
            { key: 'content', label: 'Content', icon: 'library_books' },
            { key: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: 'monitoring' },
            { key: 'audit', label: 'Audit log', icon: 'history' }
        ];

        let activeSearchIndex = -1;
        let serverResult = null;      // { query, data }
        let serverState = 'idle';     // idle | loading | error | done
        let debounceTimer = null;
        let requestController = null;
        let requestNumber = 0;

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = str ?? '';
            return div.innerHTML;
        }

        // Only same-origin links returned by the admin API are used.
        function safeAdminHref(url) {
            try {
                const base = window.location.origin + searchCfg.adminUrl;
                const dest = new URL(url, base);
                if (dest.origin !== window.location.origin) return null;
                return dest.pathname + dest.search;
            } catch (_) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function closeSearchDropdown() {
            if (!searchDropdown || !searchInput) return;
            searchDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
            searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            activeSearchIndex = -1;
        }

        function openSearchDropdown() {
            if (!searchDropdown || !searchInput) return;
            renderSearchResults(searchInput.value.trim());
            searchDropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
            searchInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }

        function resultRow({ href, action, icon, title, meta }) {
            return `
                <a href="${href ? escapeHtml(href) : '#'}" role="option"
                   ${action ? `data-search-settings="${escapeHtml(action)}"` : ''}
                   class="search-result-item flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-low hover:text-on-surface transition-colors">
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] flex-shrink-0">${escapeHtml(icon)}</span>
                    <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 truncate">${escapeHtml(title)}</span>
                    ${meta ? `<span class="text-xs font-normal text-on-surface-variant/80 truncate max-w-[40%] flex-shrink-0">${escapeHtml(meta)}</span>` : ''}
                </a>
            `;
        }

        function resultGroup(label, rows) {
            if (rows.length === 0) return '';
            return `
                <div>
                    <p class="px-4 pt-1.5 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold text-on-surface-variant/70">${escapeHtml(label)}</p>
                    ${rows.join('')}
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderSearchResults(query) {
            if (!searchResults) return;
            const q = query.toLowerCase();
            activeSearchIndex = -1;

            const matchedPages = q === ''
                ? quickPages.slice(0, 5)
                : quickPages.filter(p =>
                    p.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (p.subtitle || '').toLowerCase().includes(q));

            const groups = [
                resultGroup(q === '' ? 'Quick links' : 'Pages', matchedPages.map(p => resultRow({
                    href: p.href, action: p.action, icon: p.icon, title: p.title
                })))
            ];

            let serverRowCount = 0;
            if (q.length >= 2 && serverResult && serverResult.query === query && serverResult.data) {
                serverSections.forEach(section => {
                    const items = Array.isArray(serverResult.data[section.key]) ? serverResult.data[section.key] : [];
                    const rows = [];
                    items.forEach(item => {
                        if (!item || typeof item.title !== 'string' || typeof item.url !== 'string') return;
                        const href = safeAdminHref(item.url);
                        if (!href) return;
                        rows.push(resultRow({
                            href,
                            icon: section.icon,
                            title: item.title,
                            meta: typeof item.detail === 'string' ? item.detail : ''
                        }));
                    });
                    serverRowCount += rows.length;
                    groups.push(resultGroup(section.label, rows));
                });
            }

            const visibleGroups = groups.filter(Boolean);
            let note = '';
            if (q.length >= 2) {
                if (serverState === 'loading') note = 'Searching...';
                else if (serverState === 'error') note = 'Search could not be completed.';
            }

            if (visibleGroups.length === 0 && !note) {
                searchResults.innerHTML = `
                    <p class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                        No results for "${escapeHtml(query)}"
                    </p>
                `;
                return;
            }

            searchResults.innerHTML =
                visibleGroups.join('<div class="h-px bg-outline-variant/20 my-1"></div>') +
                (note ? `<p class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs text-on-surface-variant">${escapeHtml(note)}</p>` : '');

            searchResults.querySelectorAll('[data-search-settings]').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    const tab = el.getAttribute('data-search-settings');
                    closeSearchDropdown();
                    // Click the real opener so account-settings.js also loads the profile data.
                    const opener = document.querySelector(`[data-open-settings="${tab}"]`);
                    if (opener) {
                        opener.click();
                    } else {
                        openSettingsModal(tab);
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        async function runServerSearch() {
            const query = searchInput.value.trim();
            const currentRequest = ++requestNumber;

            if (requestController) requestController.abort();

            if (query.length < 2 || !searchCfg.endpoint) {
                serverResult = null;
                serverState = 'idle';
                return;
            }

            requestController = new AbortController();
            serverState = 'loading';
            renderSearchResults(query);

            try {
                const url = new URL(searchCfg.endpoint, window.location.origin);
                url.searchParams.set('q', query);
                if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) throw new Error('Invalid search endpoint.');

                const response = await fetch(url.href, {
                    method: 'GET',
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
                    signal: requestController.signal
                });
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Search request failed.');

                const data = await response.json();
                if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;
                if (data.error) throw new Error(data.error);

                serverResult = { query, data };
                serverState = 'done';
            } catch (error) {
                if (error.name === 'AbortError') return;
                if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;
                serverResult = null;
                serverState = 'error';
            }

            if (currentRequest === requestNumber && !searchDropdown.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderSearchResults(searchInput.value.trim());
            }
        }

        function updateSearchHighlight(items) {
            items.forEach((el, idx) => {
                if (idx === activeSearchIndex) {
                    el.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low');
                    el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
                } else {
                    el.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low');
                }
            });
        }

        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.addEventListener('focus', openSearchDropdown);
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
                const val = searchInput.value;
                searchClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', val.length === 0);
                openSearchDropdown();
                clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
                debounceTimer = setTimeout(runServerSearch, 250);
            });

            searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (!searchDropdown || searchDropdown.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
                const items = Array.from(searchResults.querySelectorAll('.search-result-item'));
                if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (items.length > 0) {
                        activeSearchIndex = (activeSearchIndex + 1) % items.length;
                        updateSearchHighlight(items);
                    }
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (items.length > 0) {
                        activeSearchIndex = (activeSearchIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
                        updateSearchHighlight(items);
                    }
                } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && activeSearchIndex >= 0 && items[activeSearchIndex]) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    items[activeSearchIndex].click();
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeSearchDropdown();
                    searchInput.blur();
                }
            });
        }

        if (searchClear) {
            searchClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
                searchInput.value = '';
                searchClear.classList.add('hidden');
                searchInput.focus();
                clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
                if (requestController) requestController.abort();
                requestNumber++;
                serverResult = null;
                serverState = 'idle';
                renderSearchResults('');
            });
        }

        // Global CTRL+K / CMD+K shortcut to focus header search
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
                e.preventDefault();
                searchInput?.focus();
                searchInput?.select();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (searchContainer && !searchContainer.contains(e.target)) {
                closeSearchDropdown();
            }
        });

        // --- Sidebar menu (gear icon): Settings + Student app + Logout ---
        const sidebarMenuBtn = document.getElementById('sidebar-menu-btn');
        const sidebarMenu = document.getElementById('sidebar-menu');

        function setSidebarMenuOpen(isOpen) {
            if (!sidebarMenu || !sidebarMenuBtn) return;
            if (isOpen) {
                closeSearchDropdown();
                hideSidebarTooltip();
                const rect = sidebarMenuBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
                const railMode = sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed') && window.innerWidth >= 768;
                sidebarMenu.style.left = (railMode ? rect.right + 12 : Math.max(8, rect.left)) + 'px';
                sidebarMenu.style.bottom = (railMode
                    ? Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - rect.bottom)
                    : window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8) + 'px';
            }
            sidebarMenu.classList.toggle('hidden', !isOpen);
            sidebarMenuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
        }

        sidebarMenuBtn?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setSidebarMenuOpen(sidebarMenu?.classList.contains('hidden'));
        });
        sidebarMenu?.addEventListener('click', () => setSidebarMenuOpen(false));
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (sidebarMenu && !sidebarMenu.contains(e.target) && !sidebarMenuBtn?.contains(e.target)) {
                setSidebarMenuOpen(false);
            }
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') setSidebarMenuOpen(false);
        });
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => setSidebarMenuOpen(false));

        // --- Settings Modal Logic ---
        const settingsDialog = document.getElementById('settings-dialog');
        const settingsClose = document.getElementById('settings-close');
        const settingsCancel = document.getElementById('settings-cancel');

        const settingsTabs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings-tab]');
        const settingsOpeners = document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-settings]');

        function switchSettingsTab(tabName) {
            document.getElementById('settings-save')?.classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'system');
            settingsTabs.forEach((tab) => {
                const active = tab.dataset.settingsTab === tabName;

                tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
                tab.classList.toggle('border-primary', active);
                tab.classList.toggle('text-primary', active);
                tab.classList.toggle('font-semibold', active);
                tab.classList.toggle('border-transparent', !active);
                tab.classList.toggle('text-on-surface-variant', !active);
                tab.classList.toggle('font-medium', !active);

                const panel = document.getElementById(
                    `settings-panel-${tab.dataset.settingsTab}`
                );

                if (panel) {
                    panel.classList.toggle('hidden', !active);
                }
            });
        }

        const settingsSave = document.getElementById('settings-save');
        const settingsStatus = document.getElementById('settings-status');

        const settingsFields = {
            remember_multiplier: document.getElementById('remember-multiplier'),
            forgot_multiplier: document.getElementById('forgot-multiplier'),
            initial_interval_days: document.getElementById('initial-interval'),
            maximum_interval_days: document.getElementById('maximum-interval')
        };

        // Learning settings use the app's endpoint (same session, same settings_csrf token)
        const settingsApi = <?= json_encode(APP_URL . 'api/settings-actions.php') ?>;

        function showSettingsStatus(message, isError = false) {
            if (!settingsStatus) return;

            settingsStatus.textContent = message;
            settingsStatus.classList.toggle('text-error', isError);
            settingsStatus.classList.toggle('text-primary', !isError);
        }

        function displaySettings(settings) {
            Object.entries(settingsFields).forEach(([key, input]) => {
                if (input) input.value = settings[key];
            });
        }

        async function loadSettings() {
            showSettingsStatus('Loading settings...');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(settingsApi, {
                    credentials: 'same-origin'
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                    throw new Error(result.message || 'Could not load settings.');
                }

                displaySettings(result.settings);
                showSettingsStatus('');
            } catch (error) {
                showSettingsStatus(error.message, true);
            }
        }

        async function saveSettings() {
            const payload = {};

            for (const [key, input] of Object.entries(settingsFields)) {
                if (!input || !input.checkValidity()) {
                    input?.reportValidity();
                    return;
                }

                payload[key] = input.value;
            }

            const initialValue = Number(payload.initial_interval_days);
            const maximumValue = Number(payload.maximum_interval_days);
            if (maximumValue < initialValue) {
                settingsFields.maximum_interval_days.setCustomValidity('Maximum interval must be at least the initial interval.');
                settingsFields.maximum_interval_days.reportValidity();
                settingsFields.maximum_interval_days.setCustomValidity('');
                return;
            }

            settingsSave.disabled = true;
            showSettingsStatus('Saving settings...');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(settingsApi, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-Token': settingsDialog.dataset.csrf
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                    throw new Error(result.message || 'Could not save settings.');
                }

                displaySettings(result.settings);
                showSettingsStatus(result.message);
            } catch (error) {
                showSettingsStatus(error.message, true);
            } finally {
                settingsSave.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        settingsSave?.addEventListener('click', saveSettings);

        function openSettingsModal(tabName) {
            switchSettingsTab(tabName);

            if (settingsDialog) {
                if (!settingsDialog.open) {
                    settingsDialog.showModal();
                }
                loadSettings();
            }
        }

        settingsOpeners.forEach((button) => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (window.innerWidth < 768) closeMobileSidebar();
                openSettingsModal(button.dataset.openSettings);
            });
        });

        settingsTabs.forEach((tab) => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                switchSettingsTab(tab.dataset.settingsTab);
            });
        });

        function closeSettings() {
            if (settingsDialog?.open) {
                settingsDialog.close();
            }
        }

        settingsClose?.addEventListener('click', closeSettings);
        settingsCancel?.addEventListener('click', closeSettings);

        settingsDialog?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            if (event.target === settingsDialog) {
                closeSettings();
            }
        });

        // Logout Dialog Logic
        const logoutBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-logout]');
        const logoutDialog = document.getElementById('logout-dialog');
        const logoutCancel = document.getElementById('logout-cancel');

        if (logoutBtns.length && logoutDialog) {
            logoutBtns.forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (window.innerWidth < 768) closeMobileSidebar();
                logoutDialog.showModal();
            }));

            if (logoutCancel) {
                logoutCancel.addEventListener('click', () => logoutDialog.close());
            }

            logoutDialog.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const rect = logoutDialog.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (e.clientX < rect.left || e.clientX > rect.right || e.clientY < rect.top || e.clientY > rect.bottom) {
                    logoutDialog.close();
                }
            });
        }
    });
</script>

        <script>
        (function () {
            var region = document.getElementById('activity-sessions');
            if (!region) return;

            var controller = null;
            history.replaceState({ actAjax: true }, '', location.href);

            function load(url, push) {
                if (controller) controller.abort();
                var ctrl = controller = new AbortController();
                region.classList.add('is-loading');

                fetch(url, {
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'fetch' },
                    signal: ctrl.signal
                })
                    .then(function (res) {
                        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                        return res.text();
                    })
                    .then(function (html) {
                        var doc   = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
                        var fresh = doc.getElementById('activity-sessions');
                        if (!fresh) throw new Error('Section not found');

                        var nav = region.querySelector('[data-tabs]');
                        var tabScroll = nav ? nav.scrollLeft : 0;

                        region.innerHTML = fresh.innerHTML;

                        var newNav = region.querySelector('[data-tabs]');
                        if (newNav) newNav.scrollLeft = tabScroll;

                        if (push) history.pushState({ actAjax: true }, '', url);
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') window.location.href = url; // fall back to a normal page load
                    })
                    .finally(function () {
                        if (controller === ctrl) {
                            controller = null;
                            region.classList.remove('is-loading');
                        }
                    });
            }

            // Tabs, sort headers, pagination, Reset
            region.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var a = e.target.closest('a[href]');
                if (!a || !region.contains(a)) return;
                if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;

                var url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
                if (url.origin !== location.origin || !/activity\.php$/.test(url.pathname)) return; // skip users.php links

                e.preventDefault();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Filter form
            region.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                var form = e.target;
                if (!form.hasAttribute('data-ajax')) return;
                e.preventDefault();

                var url = new URL(form.getAttribute('action'), location.href);
                url.search = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form)).toString();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Back / forward buttons
            window.addEventListener('popstate', function (e) {
                if (e.state && e.state.actAjax) load(location.href, false);
            });
        })();
        </script>

    </div>
</div>
