        <script>
        (function () {
            var region = document.getElementById('audit-log');
            if (!region) return;

            var controller = null;
            history.replaceState({ auditAjax: true }, '', location.href);

            function load(url, push) {
                if (controller) controller.abort();
                var ctrl = controller = new AbortController();
                region.classList.add('is-loading');

                fetch(url, {
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'fetch' },
                    signal: ctrl.signal
                })
                    .then(function (res) {
                        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                        return res.text();
                    })
                    .then(function (html) {
                        var doc   = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
                        var fresh = doc.getElementById('audit-log');
                        if (!fresh) throw new Error('Section not found');

                        region.innerHTML = fresh.innerHTML;
                        if (push) history.pushState({ auditAjax: true }, '', url);
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') window.location.href = url; // fall back to a normal page load
                    })
                    .finally(function () {
                        if (controller === ctrl) {
                            controller = null;
                            region.classList.remove('is-loading');
                        }
                    });
            }

            // Sort headers, pagination, Reset
            region.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var a = e.target.closest('a[href]');
                if (!a || !region.contains(a)) return;
                if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;

                var url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
                if (url.origin !== location.origin || !/audit\.php$/.test(url.pathname)) return; // skip users.php links

                e.preventDefault();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Filter form
            region.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                var form = e.target;
                if (!form.hasAttribute('data-ajax')) return;
                e.preventDefault();

                var url = new URL(form.getAttribute('action'), location.href);
                url.search = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form)).toString();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Action / admin dropdowns apply immediately, without a full reload
            region.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
                var el = e.target;
                if (!el.matches || !el.matches('[data-autosubmit]') || !el.form) return;
                if (el.form.requestSubmit) el.form.requestSubmit(); else el.form.submit();
            });

            // Back / forward buttons
            window.addEventListener('popstate', function (e) {
                if (e.state && e.state.auditAjax) load(location.href, false);
            });
        })();
        </script>

    </div>
</div>

        <script>
        (function () {
            function init() {
                var canvas  = document.getElementById('maturity-chart');
                var section = document.getElementById('maturity-section');
                if (!canvas || !section || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;

                var labels = <?= json_encode(array_column($tiers, 'label'), JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?>;
                var counts = <?= json_encode(array_map('intval', array_column($tiers, 'count'))) ?>;
                var total  = counts.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);

                // Read the segment colors from the legend dots so the chart follows your theme (incl. bg-primary)
                var colors = Array.prototype.map.call(section.querySelectorAll('[data-swatch]'), function (el) {
                    return getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor;
                });
                var gap = getComputedStyle(section).backgroundColor;

                var empty = total === 0;
                var chart = new Chart(canvas, {
                    type: 'doughnut',
                    data: {
                        labels: labels,
                        datasets: [{
                            data: empty ? [1] : counts,
                            backgroundColor: empty ? ['#e2e8f0'] : colors,
                            borderColor: gap,
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            hoverOffset: 6
                        }]
                    },
                    options: {
                        cutout: '68%',
                        maintainAspectRatio: false,
                        animation: { duration: 600 },
                        plugins: {
                            legend: { display: false },
                            tooltip: {
                                enabled: !empty,
                                callbacks: {
                                    label: function (ctx) {
                                        var v   = ctx.parsed;
                                        var pct = total ? Math.round(v / total * 100) : 0;
                                        return ' ' + v.toLocaleString() + ' cards (' + pct + '%)';
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });

                // Hovering a tier card highlights its segment
                if (!empty) {
                    section.querySelectorAll('[data-tier]').forEach(function (card) {
                        var i = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-tier'), 10);
                        card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
                            chart.setActiveElements([{ datasetIndex: 0, index: i }]);
                            chart.update();
                        });
                        card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
                            chart.setActiveElements([]);
                            chart.update();
                        });
                    });
                }
            }

            // `defer` scripts run before DOMContentLoaded, so this is safe whether Chart.js is in head.php or already loaded
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
            } else {
                init();
            }
        })();
        </script>

                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[36px] text-outline mb-2">library_books</span>
                    <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">No learner content matches these filters.</span>
                </div>

        <script>
        (function () {
            var region = document.getElementById('content-inventory');
            if (!region) return;

            var controller = null;
            history.replaceState({ ajax: true }, '', location.href);

            function load(url, push) {
                if (controller) controller.abort();
                var ctrl = controller = new AbortController();
                region.classList.add('is-loading');

                fetch(url, {
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'fetch' },
                    signal: ctrl.signal
                })
                    .then(function (res) {
                        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                        return res.text();
                    })
                    .then(function (html) {
                        var doc   = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
                        var fresh = doc.getElementById('content-inventory');
                        if (!fresh) throw new Error('Section not found');

                        var nav = region.querySelector('[data-tabs]');
                        var tabScroll = nav ? nav.scrollLeft : 0;

                        region.innerHTML = fresh.innerHTML;

                        var newNav = region.querySelector('[data-tabs]');
                        if (newNav) newNav.scrollLeft = tabScroll;

                        if (push) history.pushState({ ajax: true }, '', url);
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') window.location.href = url; // fall back to a normal page load
                    })
                    .finally(function () {
                        if (controller === ctrl) {
                            controller = null;
                            region.classList.remove('is-loading');
                        }
                    });
            }

            // Tabs, sort headers, pagination, Reset
            region.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var a = e.target.closest('a[href]');
                if (!a || !region.contains(a)) return;
                if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;

                var url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
                if (url.origin !== location.origin || !/content\.php$/.test(url.pathname)) return; // e.g. skip users.php links

                e.preventDefault();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Search form
            region.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                var form = e.target;
                if (!form.hasAttribute('data-ajax')) return;
                e.preventDefault();

                var url = new URL(form.getAttribute('action'), location.href);
                url.search = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form)).toString();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Back / forward buttons
            window.addEventListener('popstate', function (e) {
                if (e.state && e.state.ajax) load(location.href, false);
            });
        })();
        </script>

    </div>
</div>

            var REGIONS = ['users-filter', 'users-table'];
            var tableEl = document.getElementById('users-table');
            if (!tableEl) return;

            var controller = null;
            history.replaceState({ usersAjax: true }, '', location.href);

            function load(url, push) {
                if (controller) controller.abort();
                var ctrl = controller = new AbortController();
                tableEl.classList.add('is-loading');

                fetch(url, {
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'fetch' },
                    signal: ctrl.signal
                })
                    .then(function (res) {
                        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                        return res.text();
                    })
                    .then(function (html) {
                        var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
                        var fresh = REGIONS.map(function (id) { return doc.getElementById(id); });
                        if (fresh.some(function (el) { return !el; })) throw new Error('Region not found');

                        // Keep the tab bar's horizontal scroll position
                        var nav = document.querySelector('#users-filter nav');
                        var tabScroll = nav ? nav.scrollLeft : 0;

                        REGIONS.forEach(function (id, i) {
                            document.getElementById(id).innerHTML = fresh[i].innerHTML;
                        });

                        var newNav = document.querySelector('#users-filter nav');
                        if (newNav) newNav.scrollLeft = tabScroll;

                        if (push) history.pushState({ usersAjax: true }, '', url);

                        // Lets your existing JS re-bind to the new rows (see note below)
                        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('users:refreshed'));
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        if (err.name !== 'AbortError') window.location.href = url; // fall back to a normal page load
                    })
                    .finally(function () {
                        if (controller === ctrl) {
                            controller = null;
                            tableEl.classList.remove('is-loading');
                        }
                    });
            }

            // Tabs, sort headers, pagination, Reset links
            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var a = e.target.closest('a[href]');
                if (!a) return;
                if (!a.closest('#users-filter, #users-table')) return;
                if (e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
                if (a.target && a.target !== '_self') return;

                var url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
                if (url.origin !== location.origin || !/users\.php$/.test(url.pathname)) return;

                e.preventDefault();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Search / filter form
            document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                var form = e.target;
                if (!form.matches || !form.matches('form[data-ajax]')) return;
                e.preventDefault();

                var url = new URL(form.getAttribute('action'), location.href);
                url.search = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form)).toString();
                load(url.href, true);
            });

            // Role dropdown (data-autosubmit): submit through the AJAX path instead of a full reload.
            // Capture phase so it runs before any existing listener that calls form.submit().
            document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
                var el = e.target;
                if (!el.matches || !el.matches('[data-autosubmit]')) return;
                var form = el.form;
                if (!form || !form.hasAttribute('data-ajax')) return;
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (form.requestSubmit) form.requestSubmit(); else form.submit();
            }, true);

            // Back / forward buttons
            window.addEventListener('popstate', function (e) {
                if (e.state && e.state.usersAjax) load(location.href, false);
            });
        })();
        </script>
    </div>
</div>

/**
 * Admin Activity: recall & retention chart (Chart.js) with 7/30/90-day toggle.
 * Mirrors admin-overview.js for visual and behavioral consistency.
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var data = window.MemPulseAdminActivity;
    var canvas = document.getElementById('activity-chart');
    if (!data || !data.trend || !canvas) return;

    var loading = document.getElementById('activity-chart-loading');
    var status = document.getElementById('activity-chart-status');
    var statusTitle = document.getElementById('activity-chart-status-title');
    var statusText = document.getElementById('activity-chart-status-text');
    var buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-range]'));
    var seriesButtons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-series]'));
    var seriesIndex = { remembered: 0, forgot: 1, retention: 2 };
    var seriesEnabled = { remembered: true, forgot: true, retention: true };

    var ON = ['bg-primary-fixed', 'text-on-primary-fixed-variant', 'shadow-sm'];
    var OFF = ['text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:bg-surface-container-high'];
    var SERIES_ON = ['shadow-sm'];
    var SERIES_OFF = ['opacity-50'];

    var COLORS = { remembered: '#14b8a6', forgot: '#f59e0b', retention: '#0ea5e9' };

    function showStatus(title, text, hideCanvas) {
        loading.classList.add('hidden');
        statusTitle.textContent = title;
        statusText.textContent = text;
        status.classList.remove('hidden');
        status.classList.add('flex');
        canvas.classList.toggle('invisible', !!hideCanvas);
    }

    function hideStatus() {
        loading.classList.add('hidden');
        status.classList.add('hidden');
        status.classList.remove('flex');
        canvas.classList.remove('invisible');
    }

    if (typeof window.Chart === 'undefined') {
        showStatus("Chart couldn't load", 'Check your connection and refresh the page.', true);
        return;
    }

    var t = data.trend;
    var chart = null;

    function tail(arr, n) { return arr.slice(-n); }

    function fmtDate(iso) {
        var d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');
        return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
    }

    function sum(arr) { return arr.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0); }

    function slice(n) {
        return {
            labels: tail(t.labels, n).map(fmtDate),
            remembered: tail(t.remembered, n),
            forgot: tail(t.forgot, n),
            retention: tail(t.retention, n)
        };
    }

    function setButtons(range) {
        buttons.forEach(function (b) {
            var on = Number(b.getAttribute('data-range')) === range;
            b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            ON.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, on); });
            OFF.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, !on); });
        });
    }

    function setSeriesButtons() {
        seriesButtons.forEach(function (b) {
            var key = b.getAttribute('data-series');
            var on = !!seriesEnabled[key];
            b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            SERIES_ON.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, on); });
            SERIES_OFF.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, !on); });
        });
    }

    function applySeriesVisibility() {
        if (!chart) return;
        Object.keys(seriesIndex).forEach(function (key) {
            chart.data.datasets[seriesIndex[key]].hidden = !seriesEnabled[key];
        });
        chart.update();
    }

    function render(range) {
        var s = slice(range);
        setButtons(range);

        if (sum(s.remembered) + sum(s.forgot) === 0) {
            if (chart) { chart.destroy(); chart = null; }
            showStatus('No completed reviews in this period yet', 'Completed study sessions will be charted here.', true);
            return;
        }
        hideStatus();

        if (chart) {
            chart.data.labels = s.labels;
            chart.data.datasets[0].data = s.remembered;
            chart.data.datasets[1].data = s.forgot;
            chart.data.datasets[2].data = s.retention;
            Object.keys(seriesIndex).forEach(function (key) {
                chart.data.datasets[seriesIndex[key]].hidden = !seriesEnabled[key];
            });
            chart.update();
            return;
        }

        var text = getComputedStyle(document.body).color || '#64748b';
        var grid = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)';

        chart = new Chart(canvas, {
            data: {
                labels: s.labels,
                datasets: [
                    {
                        type: 'bar', label: 'Remembered', data: s.remembered, yAxisID: 'y',
                        backgroundColor: COLORS.remembered + '66', borderColor: COLORS.remembered, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 4, order: 2
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'bar', label: 'Forgot', data: s.forgot, yAxisID: 'y',
                        backgroundColor: COLORS.forgot + '66', borderColor: COLORS.forgot, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 4, order: 3
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'line', label: 'Retention %', data: s.retention, yAxisID: 'y1',
                        borderColor: COLORS.retention, backgroundColor: COLORS.retention, tension: 0.35, pointRadius: 0, pointHoverRadius: 4, borderWidth: 2, order: 1
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: { padding: 10, cornerRadius: 10 }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: text, maxTicksLimit: 8, maxRotation: 0, font: { size: 10 } } },
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true, position: 'left', grid: { color: grid }, border: { display: false },
                        ticks: { color: text, precision: 0, font: { size: 10 } }
                    },
                    y1: {
                        beginAtZero: true, max: 100, position: 'right', grid: { display: false }, border: { display: false },
                        ticks: {
                            color: text, precision: 0, font: { size: 10 },
                            callback: function (v) { return v + '%'; }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        Object.keys(seriesIndex).forEach(function (key) {
            chart.data.datasets[seriesIndex[key]].hidden = !seriesEnabled[key];
        });
        chart.update();
    }

    seriesButtons.forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var key = b.getAttribute('data-series');
            if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(seriesEnabled, key)) return;
            seriesEnabled[key] = !seriesEnabled[key];
            setSeriesButtons();
            applySeriesVisibility();
        });
    });

    buttons.forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener('click', function () { render(Number(b.getAttribute('data-range'))); });
    });

    setSeriesButtons();
    render(Number(data.defaultRange) || 30);
})();

/**
 * Admin Overview: activity chart (Chart.js) with 7/30/90-day toggle.
 * Reads window.MemPulseAdminOverview = { trend: {labels, reviews, activeUsers, signups}, defaultRange }.
 * Chart.js is loaded before this file (both deferred, in order).
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var data = window.MemPulseAdminOverview;
    var canvas = document.getElementById('overview-chart');
    if (!data || !data.trend || !canvas) return;

    var loading = document.getElementById('overview-chart-loading');
    var status = document.getElementById('overview-chart-status');
    var statusTitle = document.getElementById('overview-chart-status-title');
    var statusText = document.getElementById('overview-chart-status-text');
    var buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-range]'));
    var seriesButtons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-series]'));
    var seriesIndex = { reviews: 0, active: 1, signups: 2 };
    var seriesEnabled = { reviews: true, active: true, signups: true };

    var ON = ['bg-primary-fixed', 'text-on-primary-fixed-variant', 'shadow-sm'];
    var OFF = ['text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:bg-surface-container-high'];
    var SERIES_ON = ['shadow-sm'];
    var SERIES_OFF = ['opacity-50'];

    // Series colors (chart.js needs real color values; these match the app's accents).
    var COLORS = { reviews: '#0ea5e9', active: '#14b8a6', signups: '#f59e0b' };

    function showStatus(title, text, hideCanvas) {
        loading.classList.add('hidden');
        statusTitle.textContent = title;
        statusText.textContent = text;
        status.classList.remove('hidden');
        status.classList.add('flex');
        canvas.classList.toggle('invisible', !!hideCanvas);
    }

    function hideStatus() {
        loading.classList.add('hidden');
        status.classList.add('hidden');
        status.classList.remove('flex');
        canvas.classList.remove('invisible');
    }

    if (typeof window.Chart === 'undefined') {
        showStatus("Chart couldn't load", 'Check your connection and refresh the page.', true);
        return;
    }

    var t = data.trend;
    var chart = null;

    function tail(arr, n) { return arr.slice(-n); }

    function fmtDate(iso) {
        var d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');
        return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
    }

    function sum(arr) { return arr.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0); }

    function slice(n) {
        return {
            labels: tail(t.labels, n).map(fmtDate),
            reviews: tail(t.reviews, n),
            active: tail(t.activeUsers, n),
            signups: tail(t.signups, n)
        };
    }

    function setButtons(range) {
        buttons.forEach(function (b) {
            var on = Number(b.getAttribute('data-range')) === range;
            b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            ON.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, on); });
            OFF.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, !on); });
        });
    }

    function setSeriesButtons() {
        seriesButtons.forEach(function (b) {
            var key = b.getAttribute('data-series');
            var on = !!seriesEnabled[key];
            b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            SERIES_ON.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, on); });
            SERIES_OFF.forEach(function (c) { b.classList.toggle(c, !on); });
        });
    }

    function applySeriesVisibility() {
        if (!chart) return;
        Object.keys(seriesIndex).forEach(function (key) {
            chart.data.datasets[seriesIndex[key]].hidden = !seriesEnabled[key];
        });
        chart.update();
    }

    function render(range) {
        var s = slice(range);
        setButtons(range);

        if (sum(s.reviews) + sum(s.active) + sum(s.signups) === 0) {
            if (chart) { chart.destroy(); chart = null; }
            showStatus('No activity in this period yet', 'Reviews and sign-ups will be charted here.', true);
            return;
        }
        hideStatus();

        if (chart) {
            chart.data.labels = s.labels;
            chart.data.datasets[0].data = s.reviews;
            chart.data.datasets[1].data = s.active;
            chart.data.datasets[2].data = s.signups;
            Object.keys(seriesIndex).forEach(function (key) {
                chart.data.datasets[seriesIndex[key]].hidden = !seriesEnabled[key];
            });
            chart.update();
            return;
        }

        var text = getComputedStyle(document.body).color || '#64748b';
        var grid = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)';

        chart = new Chart(canvas, {
            data: {
                labels: s.labels,
                datasets: [
                    {
                        type: 'bar', label: 'Cards reviewed', data: s.reviews, yAxisID: 'y',
                        backgroundColor: COLORS.reviews + '55', borderColor: COLORS.reviews, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 4, order: 3
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'line', label: 'Active learners', data: s.active, yAxisID: 'y1',
                        borderColor: COLORS.active, backgroundColor: COLORS.active, tension: 0.35, pointRadius: 0, pointHoverRadius: 4, borderWidth: 2, order: 1
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'line', label: 'New sign-ups', data: s.signups, yAxisID: 'y1',
                        borderColor: COLORS.signups, backgroundColor: COLORS.signups, tension: 0.35, pointRadius: 0, pointHoverRadius: 4, borderWidth: 2, order: 2
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: { padding: 10, cornerRadius: 10 }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: text, maxTicksLimit: 8, maxRotation: 0, font: { size: 10 } } },
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true, position: 'left', grid: { color: grid }, border: { display: false },
                        ticks: { color: text, precision: 0, font: { size: 10 } }
                    },
                    y1: {
                        beginAtZero: true, position: 'right', grid: { display: false }, border: { display: false },
                        ticks: { color: text, precision: 0, font: { size: 10 } }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        Object.keys(seriesIndex).forEach(function (key) {
            chart.data.datasets[seriesIndex[key]].hidden = !seriesEnabled[key];
        });
        chart.update();
    }

    seriesButtons.forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var key = b.getAttribute('data-series');
            if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(seriesEnabled, key)) return;
            seriesEnabled[key] = !seriesEnabled[key];
            setSeriesButtons();
            applySeriesVisibility();
        });
    });

    buttons.forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener('click', function () { render(Number(b.getAttribute('data-range'))); });
    });

    setSeriesButtons();
    render(Number(data.defaultRange) || 30);
})();



================================================================================
FILE: admin\assets\js\admin-users.js
================================================================================
/**
 * Admin Users: detail drawer, audit log history, single & bulk actions,
 * role promotion/demotion, and admin user creation modal.
 */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var data = window.MemPulseAdminUsers || { users: {}, order: [] };
    var ui = window.MemPulseAdminUsersUI || { statusBadge: {}, roleBadge: {} };
    var FLASH_KEY = 'adminUsersFlash';

    var drawer = document.getElementById('user-drawer');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('user-drawer-overlay');
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('user-drawer-close');
    var dialog = document.getElementById('user-action-dialog');
    var createDialog = document.getElementById('create-user-dialog');
    var createForm = document.getElementById('create-user-form');
    var toastEl = document.getElementById('admin-toast');

    var opener = null;
    var currentId = null;
    var busy = false;
    var toastTimer = null;
    var pending = null;

    // ---- Toast --------------------------------------------------------------
    function toast(message, ok) {
        if (!toastEl) return;
        toastEl.textContent = message;
        toastEl.className = (ui.toastBase || '') + ' ' + (ok ? ui.toastOk : ui.toastErr);
        clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toastEl.className = 'hidden'; }, 4500);
    }

    try {
        var flash = sessionStorage.getItem(FLASH_KEY);
        if (flash) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem(FLASH_KEY);
            toast(flash, true);
        }
    } catch (e) { }

    // ---- Auto-submit select filters -----------------------------------------
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-autosubmit]').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('change', function () { el.form.submit(); });
    });

    // ---- Bulk Selection Checkboxes ------------------------------------------
    var selectAllBox = document.getElementById('select-all-users');
    var bulkBar = document.getElementById('bulk-action-bar');
    var bulkCountEl = document.getElementById('bulk-selected-count');

    function getSelectedIds() {
        var ids = [];
        document.querySelectorAll('.user-row-checkbox:checked').forEach(function (cb) {
            ids.push(Number(cb.value));
        });
        return ids;
    }

    function syncBulkBar() {
        var ids = getSelectedIds();
        if (!bulkBar) return;
        if (ids.length > 0) {
            bulkBar.classList.remove('hidden');
            bulkBar.classList.add('flex');
            if (bulkCountEl) bulkCountEl.textContent = String(ids.length);
        } else {
            bulkBar.classList.add('hidden');
            bulkBar.classList.remove('flex');
        }
    }

    if (selectAllBox) {
        selectAllBox.addEventListener('change', function () {
            document.querySelectorAll('.user-row-checkbox').forEach(function (cb) {
                cb.checked = selectAllBox.checked;
            });
            syncBulkBar();
        });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.user-row-checkbox').forEach(function (cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', syncBulkBar);
    });

    // ---- Drawer -------------------------------------------------------------
    function field(name) { return drawer ? drawer.querySelector('[data-field="' + name + '"]') : null; }
    function setText(name, value) { var el = field(name); if (el) el.textContent = value; }
    // `value` is the text shown; `key` (optional) is the raw value used to look up the badge colours.
    function setBadge(name, value, map, key) {
        var el = field(name);
        if (!el) return;
        el.textContent = value;
        el.className = (ui.badgeBase || '') + ' ' + (map[key || value] || '');
    }
    function num(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString(); }

    var AUDIT_LABELS = {
        user_approved: 'Approved account',
        user_rejected: 'Suspended account',
        user_deleted: 'Archived account',
        user_restored: 'Restored account',
        role_promoted_admin: 'Promoted to Admin',
        role_demoted_user: 'Changed role to User',
        user_created_by_admin: 'Created by Admin'
    };

    function renderAudit(items) {
        var container = document.getElementById('drawer-audit-list');
        if (!container) return;
        container.textContent = '';

        if (!items || items.length === 0) {
            var empty = document.createElement('p');
            empty.className = 'text-xs text-on-surface-variant italic py-2';
            empty.textContent = 'No admin actions recorded for this account yet.';
            container.appendChild(empty);
            return;
        }

        items.forEach(function (item) {
            var row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low border border-outline-variant/20 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs';

            var left = document.createElement('div');
            left.className = 'flex flex-col min-w-0';

            var title = document.createElement('span');
            title.className = 'font-bold text-on-surface truncate';
            title.textContent = AUDIT_LABELS[item.action] || item.action;

            var sub = document.createElement('span');
            sub.className = 'text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant truncate';
            sub.textContent = 'By ' + (item.by || 'Admin');

            left.appendChild(title);
            left.appendChild(sub);

            var right = document.createElement('span');
            right.className = 'text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant whitespace-nowrap';
            right.textContent = item.when || '';

            row.appendChild(left);
            row.appendChild(right);
            container.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

    function fill(u) {
        setText('initial', (u.name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase());
        setText('name', u.name);
        setText('email', u.email);
        setBadge('status', (ui.statusLabels && ui.statusLabels[u.status]) || u.status, ui.statusBadge, u.status);
        setBadge('role', u.role, ui.roleBadge);
        var selfEl = field('self');
        if (selfEl) selfEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !u.isSelf);

        setText('decks', num(u.decks));
        setText('cards', num(u.cards));
        setText('sessions', num(u.sessions));
        setText('reviews', num(u.reviews) + (u.accuracy ? ' (' + u.accuracy + '%)' : ''));
        setText('lastActive', u.lastActive);
        setText('joined', u.joined);

        renderAudit(u.audit || []);

        var allowed = u.actions || ['approve', 'reject', 'delete', 'restore', 'make_admin', 'make_user'];
        drawer.querySelectorAll('#drawer-actions [data-action]').forEach(function (b) {
            b.classList.toggle('hidden', u.isSelf || allowed.indexOf(b.getAttribute('data-action')) === -1);
            b.disabled = false;
        });

        var locked = field('locked');
        if (locked) {
            if (u.isSelf) {
                locked.textContent = 'You cannot modify or archive your own account.';
                locked.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                locked.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }
    }

    function openDrawer(id, trigger) {
        if (!drawer || !overlay) return;
        var u = data.users[id];
        if (!u) return;
        opener = trigger || null;
        currentId = id;
        fill(u);
        drawer.classList.remove('hidden');
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            drawer.classList.add('is-open');
            overlay.classList.remove('opacity-0');
        });
        if (closeBtn) closeBtn.focus();
    }

    function closeDrawer() {
        if (!drawer || !overlay) return;
        drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
        overlay.classList.add('opacity-0');
        setTimeout(function () {
            drawer.classList.add('hidden');
            overlay.classList.add('hidden');
        }, 250);
        if (opener) opener.focus();
        currentId = null;
    }

    // ---- Server Requests ----------------------------------------------------
    function postJson(payload) {
        return fetch(data.endpoint, {
            method: 'POST',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Accept': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRF-Token': data.csrf
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        }).then(function (res) {
            return res.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (body) {
                return { ok: res.ok && body.success === true, status: res.status, message: body.message };
            });
        });
    }

    function setBusy(on, trigger) {
        busy = on;
        if (trigger) trigger.disabled = on;
        var confirmBtn = document.getElementById('user-action-confirm');
        if (confirmBtn) confirmBtn.disabled = on;
    }

    function showDialogError(message) {
        var el = document.getElementById('user-action-error');
        if (!el) return;
        el.textContent = message || '';
        el.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
    }

    function executePayload(payload, trigger) {
        if (busy) return;
        setBusy(true, trigger);
        postJson(payload).then(function (r) {
            if (r.ok) {
                try { sessionStorage.setItem(FLASH_KEY, r.message || 'Saved.'); } catch (e) { }
                window.location.reload();
                return;
            }
            setBusy(false, trigger);
            var msg = r.status === 401
                ? 'Your session has ended. Refresh the page and sign in again.'
                : (r.message || 'That action could not be completed.');
            if (dialog && dialog.open) { showDialogError(msg); } else { toast(msg, false); }
        }).catch(function () {
            setBusy(false, trigger);
            var msg = 'Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.';
            if (dialog && dialog.open) { showDialogError(msg); } else { toast(msg, false); }
        });
    }

    var COPY = {
        reject: {
            title: 'Suspend this account?',
            message: function (n) { return n + ' will not be able to sign in.'; },
            button: 'Suspend'
        },
        delete: {
            title: 'Archive this account?',
            message: function (n) { return n + ' will be archived and hidden from active lists.'; },
            button: 'Archive'
        },
        make_admin: {
            title: 'Promote to Administrator?',
            message: function (n) { return n + ' will have full access to the MemPulse Admin dashboard.'; },
            button: 'Promote to Admin'
        },
        make_user: {
            title: 'Demote to regular User?',
            message: function (n) { return n + ' will lose administrator privileges.'; },
            button: 'Change to User'
        }
    };

    function handleSingleAction(action, id, trigger) {
        var u = data.users[id];
        if (!u) return;

        if (action === 'approve' || action === 'restore' || !dialog || !COPY[action]) {
            executePayload({ action: action, user_id: Number(id) }, trigger);
            return;
        }

        pending = { payload: { action: action, user_id: Number(id) }, trigger: trigger };
        document.getElementById('user-action-title').textContent = COPY[action].title;
        document.getElementById('user-action-message').textContent = COPY[action].message(u.name);
        document.getElementById('user-action-confirm').textContent = COPY[action].button;
        showDialogError('');
        dialog.showModal();
    }

    function handleBulkAction(action, trigger) {
        var ids = getSelectedIds();
        if (ids.length === 0) return;

        if (action === 'approve' || action === 'restore' || !dialog) {
            executePayload({ action: action, user_ids: ids }, trigger);
            return;
        }

        var label = ids.length + (ids.length === 1 ? ' selected account' : ' selected accounts');
        pending = { payload: { action: action, user_ids: ids }, trigger: trigger };
        document.getElementById('user-action-title').textContent = COPY[action].title;
        document.getElementById('user-action-message').textContent = COPY[action].message(label);
        document.getElementById('user-action-confirm').textContent = COPY[action].button;
        showDialogError('');
        dialog.showModal();
    }

    if (dialog) {
        document.getElementById('user-action-cancel').addEventListener('click', function () { dialog.close(); });
        document.getElementById('user-action-confirm').addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (pending) executePayload(pending.payload, pending.trigger);
        });
        dialog.addEventListener('close', function () { pending = null; showDialogError(''); });
    }

    // ---- Create User Modal --------------------------------------------------
    var openCreateBtn = document.getElementById('open-create-user-btn');
    var createErrorEl = document.getElementById('create-user-error');

    if (openCreateBtn && createDialog) {
        openCreateBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (createForm) createForm.reset();
            if (createErrorEl) createErrorEl.classList.add('hidden');
            createDialog.showModal();
        });
        document.getElementById('create-user-close')?.addEventListener('click', function () { createDialog.close(); });
        document.getElementById('create-user-cancel')?.addEventListener('click', function () { createDialog.close(); });

        createForm?.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (busy) return;
            var submitBtn = document.getElementById('create-user-submit');
            var payload = {
                action: 'create_user',
                first_name: document.getElementById('cu-first').value.trim(),
                last_name: document.getElementById('cu-last').value.trim(),
                email: document.getElementById('cu-email').value.trim(),
                password: document.getElementById('cu-password').value,
                role: document.getElementById('cu-role').value,
                status: document.getElementById('cu-status').value
            };
            setBusy(true, submitBtn);
            postJson(payload).then(function (r) {
                if (r.ok) {
                    try { sessionStorage.setItem(FLASH_KEY, r.message || 'User created.'); } catch (err) { }
                    window.location.reload();
                    return;
                }
                setBusy(false, submitBtn);
                if (createErrorEl) {
                    createErrorEl.textContent = r.message || 'Could not create user.';
                    createErrorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            }).catch(function () {
                setBusy(false, submitBtn);
                if (createErrorEl) {
                    createErrorEl.textContent = 'Network error. Please try again.';
                    createErrorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // ---- Event Delegation ---------------------------------------------------
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var bulkBtn = e.target.closest('[data-bulk-action]');
        if (bulkBtn) {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleBulkAction(bulkBtn.getAttribute('data-bulk-action'), bulkBtn);
            return;
        }

        var actBtn = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
        if (actBtn) {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleSingleAction(
                actBtn.getAttribute('data-action'),
                actBtn.getAttribute('data-user-id') || currentId,
                actBtn
            );
            return;
        }

        var manageBtn = e.target.closest('[data-user-id]');
        if (manageBtn) {
            e.preventDefault();
            openDrawer(manageBtn.getAttribute('data-user-id'), manageBtn);
            return;
        }

        var row = e.target.closest('[data-row-user-id]');
        if (row && !e.target.closest('button, a, input, label, [data-no-row]')) {
            openDrawer(row.getAttribute('data-row-user-id'), row);
        }
    });

    closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
    overlay?.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && drawer && !drawer.classList.contains('hidden') && !(dialog && dialog.open)) {
            closeDrawer();
        }
    });
})();
